title: FP2: Equipping Robotic Foundation Models with Force Control
org: FORTE Lab; Noematrix; Flexiv; SJTU et al.
one_line: Action-regulation split: a task-adapted robot foundation model generates actions while a plug-in force-control policy predicts force-control parameters from its context plus wrench history. Real arm, four backbones, four contact-rich tasks: every backbone's average score improves, by up to 65 points.

title: Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video
one_line: TRACC imitates the usable motion prefix of a failed human video, then trains with a VLM-proposed task-completion reward to reach the intended goal; evaluated in simulation (Unitree G1, Isaac Gym) on six Oops! failures.

title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
short: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
one_line: PRISM expands a few human videos into hundreds of counterfactual interactions, reconstructs physically plausible simulation trajectories, and trains depth-based humanoid policies for joystick-controlled picking, carrying and dropping, transferred zero-shot to real hardware.

title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
one_line: Coding agent reads demo evidence packs (keyframes, gripper events, trajectories), refines a policy program without seeing the success signal, then freezes it; LIBERO-PRO 96.3% (3 demos) vs 89.3% for ASPIRE rerun with the same LLM; real bimanual tasks.

title: T²Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
one_line: Test-time training compresses observation history into fast weights inside a pretrained VLA; RoboMME 16-task success rises from 17.93% to 56.83%, with 3x+ faster inference than explicit memory.

title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
one_line: LucidWM applies Subjective Logic to categorical latent transitions, giving each a doubt degree and multiplying trust along imagined rollouts without extra parameters; trust-based action selection cuts navigation steps-to-goal from 362 to 190.

title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
one_line: Closed-loop RL post-training of E2E driving policies inside video world models, keeping only rollouts an inverse-dynamics evaluator deems action-faithful; cuts safety violations 27.6% (DiffusionDrive, nuScenes).

title: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness
short: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data
one_line: Theory of RE(S), REINFORCE with rollouts refreshed every S steps, in softmax bandits: global convergence, Θ(1/T) rate, and moderate off-policyness escaping weak-initialization traps faster.

title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
one_line: RoboSkill: multimodal agent loop that explores, executes with vision/tactile feedback, and evolves a reusable code-skill library; LIBERO-10 first-episode success +12.5-25.0 points, real robot +8.3 points.

title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
one_line: Agentic Real2Sim2Real: reconstructs simulation gyms from videos; an agent writes stage-level manipulation code and distills successes and failures into reusable skills without weight updates; zero-shot real Franka 9/12 trials vs 5/12 for GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode.

title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
one_line: ContextProgress-Bench (24 manipulation tasks, 120 episodes) shows progress reward models get lost even with full history; given the right context their error drops 77-82%, and an agentic VLM loop supplying it cuts a frozen PRM's error 63%.

title: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
short: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
one_line: Signed credit from action-induced observation changes trains an action reranker around a frozen navigation policy at test time; a separate memory verifies candidate reranker updates and rolls back unsupported changes.

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
one_line: Stabilizes PPO's critic for LLM RL via actor-only truncation filtering, noise-normalized critic regression and smaller critic minibatches; relative gains of 14.89% coding, 2.28% math, 9.47% search over PPO.

title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Dual-loop harness evolves task- and action-level knowledge from rollouts with the VLM agent frozen; up to +24.2 points on RMBench; held-out success 70.0% to 88.3% (GPT-6) and 48.3% to 75.0% (GPT-5.5) after 80 rollouts.

title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
one_line: Learns rewards by regressing task progress from tactile deformation maps of successful and failed demos; lifts nut threading 34% to 56% (sim) and real cube pickup 37% to 97%.

title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
one_line: A VLM turns observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic specs, with thresholds grounded from successful robot trajectories, as dense and progress rewards for PPO; four ManiSkill3 sim tasks: 85.8%/67.0% success-once/at-end vs 81.5%/59.5% native dense reward.

title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
one_line: Policy runs autonomously; a VLM monitors in parallel and intervenes only on detected errors. With GPT: Cosmos Policy +5.6 and pi0.5 +7.5 pts on RoboCasa; pi0.5 47.2% to 57.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 Hard, 53% to 83% real robot.

title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
one_line: Open-weights dual-arm VLA family (YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, FR3 Duo) with embodiment-specific midtraining; a latent policy adapts online from as few as 15 corrected episodes.

title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Action-driven visual simulator learned from 10,000+ h action-free robot video and grounded with 2,000+ h action trajectories; 74% trajectory-success prediction accuracy (strongest baseline 73%); best-of-32 selection with its rollouts beats direct execution by 19.1-21.4 points on RoboTwin, zero-shot.

title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
short: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors
one_line: Deployment-time adaptation updates a VLA online from the commanded-vs-executed motion residual, without rewards or labels; adds RoboStress sim benchmark (friction, backlash, compliance, gravity-comp error); >30-point real success gains on two Piper arms (one new, one used a year).

title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
one_line: World action model adapts to unseen tasks from its own generated video-action rollouts (never executed), training on VLM-selected task-completing prefixes verified by inverse dynamics; Cosmos3 on seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks 26.9% to 68.0%, three real tasks 20.0% to 76.7%.

title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
one_line: DEWO: post-deployment world-action-model learning from successful and failed futures for classifier-free guidance, activated by a progress value head when progress stalls; four real dexterous tasks: two rounds lift success 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success.

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
short: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
one_line: Three-stage RL fine-tuning for multi-robot VLAs: initialization-aware data collection, credit-filtered offline tuning, online latent-noise RL (DSRL) on the frozen VLA. Average success over the CHORUS SFT baseline: +23.1% RoboTwin, +16.4% RoboFactory, +44% on real dual-Franka tasks.

title: BlenDAgger: Blended Shared Control for Interactive Imitation Learning
one_line: Keeps the policy running during corrections, blending human and policy actions per DoF group and giving the human more control when they push hard, disagree, or the policy is uncertain. Final round, real Almond Scooping: 50% vs HG-DAgger 15%.

title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
org: Tsinghua University; UC Berkeley; Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute
one_line: A learned value model halts a pi0.5-class policy when its score drops below zero; Gemini 2.5 Pro picks and checks a repair skill; successful repairs become training data. Real Coffee mean progress: 71.25% vs 46.25% with extra human demos.

title: PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions
one_line: Pairs each human takeover window with a frozen pi0.5 chunk from the same state, trains a small Bradley-Terry scorer on the pairs, and uses it to guide sampling. Four real Franka insertion tasks: 90.5% vs frozen 69.0%, intervention BC 84.5%.

title: ReF-HIL: Shaping the Critic around Human Action Neighborhoods for Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Guides the online critic with an IQL value reference learned from successful human data, plus a learned human-action 'fence': no imitation penalty inside it, constrained updates outside. Real plug insertion: 91.7% vs 5% or less for HG-DAgger, HIL-SERL and SiLRI.

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
one_line: Agentic pipeline with property-specific verifiers and a self-evolving tool library turns a single egocentric human video into sim-generated robot trajectories for training pi0.5; 63.6% average success over 11 real dexterous tasks, about 3.5x SPIDER's.

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
one_line: Training-free harness for lifelong navigation that carries maps, task records and house knowledge across sessions, checking them against new observations; on GOAT-Bench with GPT-6 Astra, +18.6 s-SR points over context-only independent sessions and a reported state-of-the-art 83.7 s-SR (SLAM poses).

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
one_line: Shows policy-gradient stabilization succeeds with zeroth-order (configuration) reward terms alone; adding velocity reward terms can introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows, while velocity remains necessary in the policy observation (low-dissipation assumption).

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
org: Cambridge / MIT / Basis / Cornell / Princeton et al.
one_line: Agent runs experiments to learn residual world models (physics engine plus code for missing forces/constraints/hidden state) with Bayesian inference; solves more tasks with fewer interactions than baselines.

title: QAMM: Adjoint MeanFlow Matching for Few-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Turns the critic's adjoint-matching signal into supervision for MeanFlow average velocity, yielding two-call flow policies competitive with flow-policy baselines on ten HumanoidMaze offline RL tasks.

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
one_line: Training-free: keeps executing the normally discarded tail of each action chunk until action velocity starts to fluctuate; 1.2-1.7x fewer policy calls with no loss in success rate across three VLAs and one World Action Model, in sim and real.

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
one_line: Training-free NUDGE injects signed-distance-field gradients, via a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder, into the denoising loop of diffusion/flow policies and VLAs to steer action chunks around obstacles; real UR5 with a moving obstacle: 75.6% contact-free completion (62/82) vs 16.7% (3/18) unguided pi0.

title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
short: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
one_line: OLIVE: DAgger-like online LLM distillation; student generates prefix, teacher continues it, student trains by cross-entropy. +13% over offline SFT on ScienceWorld; async cuts training time 23.8%.

title: Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity
short: Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity
one_line: BFM-QD runs quality-diversity search in a behavioral foundation model's compact latent space, giving a gradient-free, critic-free improvement operator that beats parameter-space QD on sparse/deceptive continuous control (NeurIPS 2026).

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
short: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
one_line: TeAR: a lightweight Transformer rectifies a frozen policy's actions from live actuator telemetry (temperature, current, voltage); on a real SO-101 arm under heating, Lift success 85% vs 75% and 70% for the frozen base (20 trials each), no on-robot fine-tuning.

title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
one_line: SCOUT meta-learns a belief latent shared by policy and forward dynamics model; at test time it updates the belief from dynamics prediction error, enabling fast adaptation and sim-to-real transfer (CoRL 2026).

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
short: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
one_line: PPO with a chunked actor and a standard state-value critic; ACPPO-Corr adds a stepwise feedback corrector inside each chunk. 25 IsaacGym/Bi-DexHands tasks: best aggregate IQM, +30.4% over PPO; per task vs best baseline, 13 wins, 8 ties, 4 losses.

title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
one_line: Simulator-state failure diagnosis retrieves corrections from a human trajectory bank; correction SFT precedes safety-reward GRPO. Driving VLA: NAVSIM v1 PDMS 87.7→91.7; the same checkpoint scores 89.4 EPDMS on original NAVTEST scenes under v2 metrics.

title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
one_line: Latent world model pretrained on successful and failed trajectories, then contrastively tuned on matched success-failure pairs, gives a differentiable reward for VLA training and is dropped at deployment; LIBERO average 98.4% vs 97.1% for OpenVLA-OFT; SimplerEnv Google Robot 72.0%.

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
one_line: On-policy distillation of task-specific teachers into a pretrained world action model via prefix-weighted trajectory replay over a fixed rollout pool, improving target tasks without extra environment interaction.

title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
one_line: Turns group-standardized rewards into a target distribution and matches it by forward KL over trajectory log-probs instead of maximizing reward; for VLAs, on average +8.0/+4.8 points over the best reward-maximizing baselines on simulated task/scene OOD (MetaWorld/CALVIN).

title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
one_line: Prerequisite-gated, paced rewards from simulator-verified subtask predicates (not a learned model); RoboCasa365 GR00T-N1.5 49.1% vs 41.5% for the best terminal-reward baseline, and it beats Robometer on LIBERO-Long (96.6 vs 94.2).

title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies (AGF)
one_line: Lightweight guidance net regressed onto the adjoint costate replaces per-step critic backprop for a frozen flow VLA; 3.6x faster per step than QGF. Real YAM arm, pooled (n=75): base 66.7%, QGF 68.0%, AGF 84.0%.

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Offline, supervised hidden-space residual expert bank with a Null route, trained on logged failures of a frozen pi0.5. RoboTwin average 49.50 → 60.50, vs PPO 55.75.

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
one_line: An agentic VLM builds verified event timelines as offline progress labels; LIBERO-Long 57.9 vs 44.2 vanilla BC; exposes reward models that credit the wrong object.

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
org: Nanyang Technological University; Xi'an Jiaotong University; Dexmal
one_line: A VLM diagnoses real pi0.5 failures, the scene is rebuilt in Isaac Sim, and the policy is co-trained on failure-conditioned sim data, then PPO-refined and redeployed. Real OOD success: 26.25% → 90.0%, vs 71.25% for budget-matched Targeted BC.

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
short: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
one_line: PolicyWeave: shared-action-interface LoRA post-training plus context-guided sparse merging of VLA task experts; 18 RoboCasa365 tasks: 74.1% merging RL experts vs 60.7% joint RL.

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
one_line: DPP: training-free; the WAM's rollout estimates interaction timing, tracked target motion gives the future position, and a counterfactual observation lets the WAM reuse static skills; real robot, grasping a moving object: 76.7% vs 0% for reactive replanning (30 trials).

title: Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning
one_line: RECON: model-based IL splitting a conservative main policy from an explorer that seeks epistemically uncertain yet recoverable states (via multi-step imagination); improves interaction efficiency on locomotion, navigation, manipulation.

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: Uses glove tactile signals as RL guidance to steer policy search toward human contact patterns when retargeting mocap to robot hands; learns marker/hammer use, beats distance-based rewards.

title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
org: USTC; CAS Institute of AI for Industries; Shenzhen University
one_line: Compensatory force fields from human demos plus robot contact state condition a PPO residual policy correcting retargeted dexterous-hand motions on articulated objects. Vs DexMachina over four simulated hands, overall completion ratio 0.606 → 0.772; real runs are open-loop replays.

title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
one_line: Recurrent residual PPO policy over a classical anti-swing prior, plus an age-aware world model for delayed or lost sensing, for robot-arm cable-suspended payload insertion onto rebar pins. Hardest sim setting: 69.5% strict success; physical rig: 18/20 with no real fine-tuning.

title: Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Off-policy actor-critic diffusion policy with a two-branch score target gated by an HJ reachability critic: Q-score matching when feasible, recovery denoising otherwise; tested on quadrotor, fixed-wing, Safety-Gymnasium.

title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
one_line: Training-free Feynman-Kac particle reweighting steers a frozen grasp diffusion model with deployment-specific rewards, shifting samples from infeasible to feasible grasp modes for single- and dual-arm setups.

title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
one_line: PARS perturbs proprioceptive state and anchors only the later predicted trajectory to the demo, teaching recovery without extra interaction or expert queries; improves robustness on 51 RLBench tasks.

title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
one_line: Evolution strategies search a contrastively learned genome of freeform manipulator bodies, with RL training each design; printed prototypes run zero-shot, and the real didactyl rotator turns unseen objects at 1.39 rad/s vs 0.74 for Fay et al.'s best design.

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
short: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
one_line: Simify reconstructs sim-ready 3D assets from RGB-D and optimizes object placements in massively parallel physics simulation at test time for unseen-object rearrangement; IROS 2026.

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
one_line: Single-view image-to-3D meshes feed massively parallel sim RL with a contact-state-sampling action space; no demos or pretraining, 87% real-world success after ~119 s training.

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
one_line: Builds 3D Gaussian-splat + SAM3D scenes from RGB-D for simulation-before-execution, filtering infeasible action sequences; validated on rigid, soft and deformable object manipulation.

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
short: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
one_line: A strong agent distills its VLA-intervention experience into a playbook for a light agent, refined recursively from the light agent's execution feedback; real world (3 tasks): 64.0% vs 37.3% for pi0.5 alone; SimplerEnv Bridge: 66.7% vs 41.7% GR00T-only.

title: Schrödinger–Föllmer Actor–Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis
one_line: SFAC: offline-to-online diffusion policy improvement via Doob h-transform drift correction estimated with paired self-normalized importance sampling and a minimax Bellman critic; finite-sample bounds, six continuous-control tasks.

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
one_line: Training-free neuro-symbolic layer wrapping frozen VLAs: a phase FSM applies rule-based corrections and an inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term adds dynamics; on 10 LIBERO-Spatial sim tasks, up to +6 pts success and +19.3 pts stability; <1 ms overhead.

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
one_line: Frozen action-conditioned world model scores whether a WAM's actions match its visual plan and goal; Flow Policy Optimization tunes the action head without online robot interaction or task-specific reward models; four real UR5 tasks: 43.4% to 75.1% mean (pi0.5: 61.4%).

title: TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement
one_line: Robot-gated DAgger: asks for takeover when a PCA residual on VLA features exceeds a threshold that the expert's first post-takeover actions raise or lower. pi0.5 StackCube-Green (ManiSkill sim, oracle expert): 81 vs HG-DAgger 29, offline BC 49.

title: Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies (PSS)
one_line: Finds the few noise directions that most move a frozen diffusion or flow policy's actions (finite-difference probing at 64 states) and lets SAC steer only those. Sim RoboMimic Diffusion-Square, final success, one seed: 0.878 vs 0.716 steering the full latent.

title: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Replay-free continual VLA fine-tuning as constrained optimization: method-of-multipliers dual penalty plus selective anchoring of parameters critical to earlier tasks; after three sequential LIBERO tasks, replay-free baselines score 0% on the first task, SAMBAR 84%.

title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
one_line: Flow-matching VLA carries a shared fast-weight policy state, updated at deployment from its own action-generation features without expert labels; +10.68 pts mean success over a matched policy without test-time training on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean; also tested on 12 real-robot tasks.

title: Timestep Weighting: A Hidden Key to Effective ELBO-Based Flow-Matching RL
one_line: Studies timestep weighting in ELBO-based flow-matching RL (CIFAR fine-tuning, from-scratch simulated robot control): the best weighting is task- and stage-dependent, motivating a policy-reward-gap hypothesis; dynamic schedules beat the best tested fixed weighting, by small margins on some robot tasks.

title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
one_line: Coordination head predicts a residual denoiser over frozen single-agent diffusion policies, trained on few collaborative demos plus self-distilled data. Sim: higher coordination success than baselines; real two-xArm7 task: ties full fine-tuning on coordination while retaining single-arm skills better.

title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
short: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: NeurIPS 2026 position paper: offline RL should produce adaptive policy priors that keep improving online via memory, exploration and self-correction (AORL); Bayesian offline RL as one route.

title: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing |Q| Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic
short: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing |Q| Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value…
one_line: In high-UTD SAC, rank collapse is survivable, but how far log|Q| has climbed by step 15k ranks runs by how soon the training guard flags them (out-of-sample AUC 0.78 Walker2d, 0.98 Ant, at UTD 4), enabling early aborts.

title: Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View
one_line: RAFALE: off-policy safe-RL actor-critic that differentiates an augmented objective through a flow policy's generation process, framed as a constrained Schrödinger bridge; cost within budget on seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks.

title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
one_line: Online fine-tunes flow-matching-pretrained cooperative multi-agent policies via explicit action likelihoods and shared team advantages; average relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest offline baselines (30 settings) and 29.8% over purely online learning (38 matched-budget comparisons).

title: Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization
one_line: ARBO: an LLM agent builds its reward-search strategy at run time from a persistent evaluation history; with 128 reward samples, ten simulated Bi-DexHands tasks average 0.918 success vs 0.792 for the best baseline (Eureka).

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
one_line: Teacher gives local corrections on the student's own failure histories; only environment-verified corrections become on-policy distillation supervision (RE-OPD), with a per-round gain lower bound.

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
one_line: Treats the embodied agent's supporting system (context/memory management, hierarchical skills) as a policy evolved from execution traces; lifts GPT-5.5 on EmbodiedBench from 56.9% to 72.7% (27.8% relative) and beats CaP-Agent0 under all LIBERO-PRO perturbations.

title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
one_line: Splits long-horizon tasks into atomic skills, picks the most-failing ones, restores simulator states captured just before them, and RL-updates shared per-family LoRA adapters with LLM-written success checks. LIBERO average (GR00T N1.5) 53.1% → 65.4% after three rounds, no extra demos.

title: Causeway: Restoring Task Accessibility for Instruction Switching in VLA Policies
one_line: Training-free inference-time steering: backpropagates through frozen VLA decoding to apply state-directed action-stream edits that recover from 'task islands'; instruction-switch success rises from 3-26% to 47-65% on LIBERO-Goal, plus xArm validation.

title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
one_line: A multi-agent world-action model predicts team return for candidate joint actions so a frozen multi-agent flow policy can rank them at test time; +22.0% mean relative gain over direct execution across 30 offline MARL settings; scoring takes 12.1 ms (A100).

title: G2MAF: Test-Time Gradient Guidance for Multi-Agent Flow Policies
one_line: Refines frozen offline multi-agent flow-policy actions at test time with one globally normalized, projected critic gradient; improves 20 of 24 MPE/SMAC settings, with mean relative gains of 9.2% (MPE) and 8.9% (SMAC) at ~6% extra inference latency.

title: Learning to Leverage Compliance: A Policy-Admittance Learning Framework for Robotic Insertion
one_line: LeCo: multirate contact feedback becomes conflict and high-force reward costs so the policy cooperates with a fixed admittance controller; 94% aggregate success on four real connector tasks, ~30% lower successful-trial force peaks than the comparison baseline.

title: Multi-Objective Human-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization of a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton
short: Multi-Objective Human-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization of a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton
one_line: MO-HILBO: multi-objective human-in-the-loop Bayesian optimization inferring personalized Pareto-optimal exoskeleton controllers over metabolic cost and comfort; Pareto orderings consistent with validation trials; open-source mohilo package.

title: Generate, Track, Improve: Perceptive Multi-Skill Humanoid Locomotion with RL-Fine-Tuned Motion Generators
one_line: Off-policy RL (structured search plus advantage-weighted regression) fine-tunes a depth-conditioned flow-matching motion generator feeding a tracking policy; in simulation vs the pre-fine-tuned generator, up to +25 points terrain traversal and +80 skill selection; G1 hardware shown qualitatively.

title: Precision at Speed: Sample-Efficient Online Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Hydraulic Excavator Control
one_line: Online MBRL with a probabilistic dynamics ensemble and sampling-based MPC learned from scratch on an 11.5-ton excavator; sub-centimeter mean path error after 40 minutes of real interaction.

title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
one_line: Learned interactive world simulator that predicts joint torques and renders haptic feedback to teleoperators; 1.6x data-collection throughput, policies from generated demos reach 54/60 real vs 19/60 vision-only.

title: Learning Robot Policies from Sparse Success Signals via STL-Guided Stein Variational Policy Gradient
one_line: STL-SVPG: population-based Stein variational policy gradient using smooth STL robustness as a trajectory-level objective; best success on 5 of 6 quadcopter/manipulator benchmarks, with sim-to-real transfer.

title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
one_line: Concept paper (no experiments yet) proposing a JEPA-style world model trained in a VLA's vision-encoder embedding space, to test whether those embeddings predict action outcomes and to plan short horizons by sampling VLA actions toward goal images.

title: RoboMonitor: Label-Efficient Runtime Monitoring of Robot Task Execution via Predictive Representation Learning
one_line: Runtime execution monitor pretrained with action-conditioned future-feature prediction, inverse dynamics and masked prediction; 93.1% phase accuracy from 52 labeled episodes, 35/40 real trials with zero false recoveries.

title: PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
one_line: IRL framework calibrating learned rewards with task-progress annotations; higher return and task success with only 20% of demonstrations annotated, and robust to reward hacking.

title: Kintsugi-VLA: Turning Failed Robot Rollouts into Recovery Data through Interventional Recoverability
one_line: Restores simulator states along failed rollouts to estimate recoverability and generate targeted recovery data; SmolVLA recovery success 34.6-38.4%, 5.8-6.7 points over uniform sampling.

title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL
one_line: Sim-trained TD3 residual that reads the VLA's own latent, aligned sim-to-real with an OT mapper. Real Flower: button 67.5% → 100%, block push 22.5% → 50%.

title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models (FIND)
org: TU Darmstadt; Hessian.AI; U Augsburg; Tongji University; Shanghai Research Institute for Intelligent Autonomous Systems
one_line: Real RL without per-episode scene resets: a VLM picks feasible, weakest tasks and judges success for a critic-gated residual on a frozen pi0.5. 8-task human-assessed success 55% → 71.9%; a 456-episode run needed 30 scene-recovery interventions.

title: Training-free Behavior Cloning
one_line: Behavior Predictive Control: action-aware retrieval over a demo bank, a Hankel-based action-continuation prior and a closed-form residual correction replace policy training; competitive with pi0.5 (better in some cases), fits in seconds, runs 75+ Hz on Jetson Orin Nano.

title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
one_line: VLM agent harness with contact views, imagined action rehearsal and in-view correction plus demo-derived skills; 75.6% on LIBERO-Pro; its traces lift a small model's OOD success from 1.7% to 43.3%.

title: Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think
one_line: Anchored Planning: training-free fix for frozen latent world-model planners that retrieves offline trajectory segments and plans toward intermediate anchor observations, beating final-goal search on long-range goals across four tasks.

title: RACaP: Agentic Reasoning, Acting, and Coding as Policies for Evolvable Robot Learning
one_line: Two-phase offline evolution (capability curriculum, then self-evolution) improves typed Policy APIs, a ReAct harness and long-term experience memory; at deployment ReAct calls the frozen APIs; 46.0% on LIBERO-Long vs at most 4.0% for Code-as-Policies baselines.

title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
one_line: Evolves a program-level harness across rollouts from execution feedback without retraining the wrapped action model; LIBERO-PRO 96.5% vs 34.9% for pi0.5 alone (+61.6 points); fine-tuning pi0.5 on harness-collected rollouts lifts it to 73.7%.

title: AdaHVLA: Adaptive Harnesses for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Execution
one_line: Multi-agent loop (analyze, revise, assess) refines the code harness around frozen VLAs from rollout experience via a stateful revision graph; in simulation, NaVILA-LH test success 22.5% to 31.7-57.5% across six adaptation LLMs, manipulation up to +30.8 points.

title: Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling
short: Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling
one_line: OSRAM: meta-trains a closed-loop dynamics model in randomized sim, fine-tunes on limited real data, then optimizes reference commands online for a frozen controller; reduces bipedal tracking error on hardware.

title: Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search for Robotic Control
short: Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search for Robotic Control
one_line: LLM-as-optimizer policy search that sends only encoded policy parameters and scaled rewards to cloud LLMs; beats the baseline prompted search on 7 of 10 control tasks.

title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
one_line: Joint-embedding latent world model with residual dynamics plus action-recovery regularization (heads dropped at test time) keeps candidate actions distinguishable for MPC; OGBench-Cube hard-start success 52.0% vs 3.7% for a matched LeWM baseline; zero-shot Franka pick-and-place 42.2% to 71.1%.

title: Policy-Calibrated DAgger: Offline Calibrated Noise Injection for Imitation Learning
one_line: Calibrates DAgger-style noise injection offline from a diffusion policy's own action spread along expert trajectories; beats un-noised DAgger and matches hindsight-optimal noise without sweeps.

title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
one_line: Post-trains a VLA with a plug-in context encoder that turns its own failed rollouts into an AdaLN context token; summing tokens across retries lifts average success under actuation bias from 7.5% to 72.5% within 6 trials (nominal 88.8%), four tasks.

title: Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation
one_line: IQL chunk critic with future latent supervision conditions a diffusion actor on high-value chunks, then selects best-of-N; real Franka StackCup improves from 18/25 to 25/25 trials.

title: Res-HIL: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: Zero-initialized TD3 residual on a 20-demo ACT. Human takeovers become regression targets plus penalties on the steps just before them. After 10 min: 100/64/50/66/92% vs HIL-SERL 90/30/10/0/0 and ResFiT 0/0/0/0/0.

title: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
short: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
one_line: CCPL: a Gaussian-process preference model shares feedback across nearby exoskeleton operating contexts; retrospective analyses of ankle/elbow data (nine adults) estimate ~37%/17% fewer exposures than independent learning for equal reconstruction accuracy; online benefit not yet shown.

title: RegenHarness: A Robot Agent Harness with Evidence-Gated Recursive Self-Improvement
one_line: Robot agent harness with isolated planning/supervision/verification/recovery contexts and a commit gate; evidence-gated self-improvement revises harness configuration from execution records without weight updates; quadruped warehouse demo.

title: BrickCraft-Duo: Efficient Dual-Arm Skill Learning and Refinement for Compositional Long-Horizon Assembly
one_line: Learns reusable dual-arm brick-assembly skills from demos, composes them with stability-aware reasoning, and refines them with human-in-the-loop correction; at least 95% step-level and at least 60% long-horizon success on five real tasks (up to nine steps).

title: Banana Kick: Response-Informed Skill Evolution for Humanoid Soccer
one_line: RISE ranks bounded objective changes by response sensitivity from cached rollouts and accepts only verified progress, evolving a G1 humanoid's ordinary kick into a curved one. Sim joint target attainment 50.9% vs 15.2% for a learning-progress curriculum; 30 hardware trials.

title: An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics
short: An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics
one_line: After pretraining, streaming deep RL adapts quadruped policies online to unforeseen changes, improving task success up to 90% over the pretrained policy and beating batch on-policy; manipulation only partially succeeds.

title: TANDEM: Task and Motion Planning with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Fine-tuning
one_line: TAMP with VLM-added predicates asks for teleoperation only on steps it cannot plan; on one task it collects 2.9x the demos of full teleop in equal human time; 20 demos/task lift pi0.5-DROID's average success 0% to 60% (five real tasks).

title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
short: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic…
one_line: Agent writes/integrates new manipulation skills over 123 improvement rounds; gains fail to compound due to relational perception limits, skill chains stuck on early steps, and flawed evaluators.

title: Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy
one_line: Contact-aware morphometric retargeting of human hand motion, RL refinement for dynamic feasibility, then visuomotor distillation; 89.3% zero-shot success over 300 real trials on 30 objects.

title: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
short: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
one_line: TD-MPC2-based world model from wrist-camera depth and proprioception, trained on up to 90 insertion tasks; in simulation, 56% zero-shot success on unseen part geometries vs 7% for a model-free baseline; finetuning on held-out parts is more data-efficient than from scratch.

title: CereVLA: Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Execution
one_line: Flow-based residual refinement on a frozen action-chunked VLA, gated by a recurrent consequence predictor that suppresses unfavorable corrections. Real SO-101 pick-and-place, 40 trials: success 57.5% → 90.0% vs frozen SmolVLA, 19.6% fewer control steps on successful trials.

title: Dissecting Advantage-Guided Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Policies
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Xiaomi Robotics
one_line: Ablates separately how critic-derived advantages are built, calibrated and used; n-step TD, per-value-bin normalization and soft exponential weights on the pi0.5 loss worked best. Real bimanual, 4-task mean success: SFT 0.11, source-weighted DAgger 0.45, continuous weighting 0.74.

title: BEE: Intervention-Adaptive Real-World Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Residual actor on a frozen pi0.5, constrained toward human corrections by a learned per-dimension Gaussian correction model (Mahalanobis constraint). Matched online-data budget, 3 real + 1 sim task: average success 91.2% vs RLT 57.5%, DSRL 42.1%, SFT base 38.8%.

title: Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy
one_line: Novelty/competence-gated exploration-noise controller for PPO fine-tuning of SmolVLA on LIBERO-10. No task collapses (pooled definition) in its 3 seeds, vs 2 of 3 seeds for fixed noise and every learned-noise seed run to iteration 200; no arm beats BC.

title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
one_line: Hill climbing with a frozen LLM: resamples programs conditioned on the best verified solution so far; beats repeated sampling and test-time ES, and sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods (not robotics).

title: Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
one_line: Training-free best-of-N: sample 8 text-to-motion candidates, simulate each under the pretrained SONIC tracker on Unitree G1, keep the best-executed; upright execution rises from 80.5% (first sample) to 89.5% on 4,184 HumanML3D test prompts.

title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
one_line: Closed-loop driving simulator built on a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model; under its new FDpi fidelity metric it beats the strongest prior closed-loop simulator 1.6x on nuScenes and 4.7x on NAVSIM; its Navhard-CL benchmark exposes missing recovery behaviors.

title: Know Your Body: A Harness for Direct and Self-Improving Robot Control with VLMs
one_line: KnowBody: frozen-VLM control harness with an explicit, revisable body model seeded from one trajectory and refined by interaction; 75% vs 25% completion for native harness on four real-robot tasks.

title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
one_line: GC-VLA predicts multiview geometry-change tokens, then adds Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow learned from closed-loop feedback; LIBERO success rises from 95.20% to 99.55%.

title: Imperfection for Precision: Upcycling Imperfect Data for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
one_line: ε4P co-trains a flow-matching VLA on imperfect data by noise level (low-precision target-task data at high noise, high-precision mismatched-task data at low noise); real robot: up to +31.7 points; replacing equal high-quality data costs 4.2 points on average.

title: DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation
one_line: Planner plus object-centric IK with a residual RL policy and implicit curriculum lifts sim demo-generation success 41.30% → 78.37%; DP3 policies trained on its data reach 30-60% on three real tasks vs 0-10% with DOMINO data.

title: SafeLoop: Risk-Aware Rollback for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
one_line: Non-invasive wrapper predicts collision/object-failure risk from vision and proprioception, then checkpoints or rolls back and re-queries the frozen VLA; ~70% fewer hazards on 24 LIBERO and 3 real tasks.

title: PAKT: Physically-Aligned Kinesthetic Teaching for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Operators correct HIL-SERL-style real-world RL by hand-guiding the arm via admittance control sharing the policy's action space, limits and impedance tracker. Vs HIL-SERL, four real insertion tasks: 62%-86% fewer interventions; 23%-48% lower cycle time, mostly from the new controller stack.

title: HiRE: Hindsight Reward Editing for Policy Finetuning
one_line: Training-free reward: a vMF-kernel density log-ratio of foundation-model features (DINOv2, SigLIP) from success vs failure buffers, added via potential-based shaping; real bottle pick-and-place rises 20% to 67% (30 trials), while sparse and Robometer baselines nearly fail early in training.

title: RouteRLT: Learning When and Which RL Specialist Should Control a Vision-Language-Action Policy
one_line: A learned router decides when a per-phase RL specialist (RL-Token-style readout) takes over from a frozen SmolVLA. Full-task success on three LIBERO-Object tasks 85.00% → 92.22%; real cable insertion 6.7% → 35.0% (operator-aligned handoff).

title: Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate
short: Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate
one_line: GLIDE infers task failure modes as executable guardrails, refined from trajectory feedback, that filter teleop and policy commands; data-collection success 0-10% to 70-90%, guarded policies 60-70%.

title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
one_line: Joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion world-model simulator with streaming rollouts, 24 FPS after optimization, and multi-embodiment/multi-camera support; code and weights released.

title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
short: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Hybrid PPO mixing offline motion-planner demos with online sim rollouts trains an optical-flow visuomotor pruning policy; 49.9%/46.0% sim success (apples/cherries), zero-shot transfer in 38 physical trials, and 7/15 vs 4/15 for point-cloud RRT-Connect in the lab.

title: GraspTune: Tactile-Driven Execution Refinement for Robust Grasping
one_line: Diffusion-pretrained residual policy, aligned with PPO, applies bounded tactile-driven TCP corrections during grasp execution. Sim stable-grasp success +9.55 to +20.70 pts across four proposal generators; real UR5e GraspNet 71.0% → 84.3% (600 trials each).

title: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting and Residual Policy Learning
short: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting…
one_line: Residual RL repairs human mocap in sim (MANO hand); contact-anchored retargeting plus a second residual policy adapt it to robot hands. Sim replay success 7.3% → 59.3% (single-hand), 16.0% → 62.4% (dual-hand); four hardware tasks use no real-robot training data.

title: InsertAnything: Generalizable Contact-Rich Precision Insertion from Simulation to Reality
one_line: Sim-only RL insertion policy using 3D fingertip force feedback and a decoupled gated reward; real insertion down to 0.02 mm nominal clearance, 20/20 on ManipulationNet peg-in-hole (Human-in-the-Loop protocol, autonomous insertion motions), and 95.0% (152/160) zero-shot on eight unseen real tasks.

title: Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering
short: Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering
one_line: Applies DSRL to social navigation: trains only the latent-noise policy over a frozen diffusion policy distilled from multi-seed RL policies, adapting to new social conventions; hardware-in-the-loop validated.

title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
one_line: Latent world model learning ordinal relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes via a permutation-equivariant operator; lifts VLA success on four RoboTwin tasks from 61.72% to 76.76% and a V-JEPA 2-AC planner's on two real tasks from 64.0% to 81.0%.

title: Beyond Visual Quality: A Study of Test-Time Planning with World Action Models
one_line: Studies picking among sampled actions by their imagined futures in world action models: an oracle pick raises same-state success from 68.9% (random pick) to 79.2%, but tested selectors leave much of that gain unrecovered; opportunity concentrates in few decisions.

title: Imagine-RL: Residual-Confidence-Guided Cross-Attention for World-Model-Augmented VLA Reinforcement Learning
one_line: DSRL over a frozen pi0; its critic imagines 10-step visual/torque futures with confidence weighting. Four real tasks, 50 trials each, 100 RL trajectories including 50 warm-up: success improves 23.6% relative over DSRL and 60% relative over pi0.

title: ReVeal: A Reconstruction-Aware Real-to-Sim Framework for VLA Policy Evaluation
one_line: Scores phone-video reconstructions with view and planar-geometry fidelity metrics for VLA evaluation; the authors' depth-supervised PGSR-D vs 2DGS raises real-sim Pearson r 0.773 to 0.960 and cuts MAE 0.246 to 0.050 (GR00T, SmolVLA, pi0.5; 8 humanoid tasks).

title: Anatomy of a Closed-Loop Collapse: A Causal Case Study of a Compressed VLA Policy
one_line: An 8-layer Octo-Base distillation passes offline checks but scores 0/72 on simulated WidowX pick-and-place (teacher 40/72); replacing half the training stream with deployment-distribution teacher rollouts restores teacher parity (18/36 vs 17/36).

title: Verti-WM: A Physics-Aided Exteroceptive World Model for Off-Road Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Fuses a frozen Transformer (rigid terrain) with a neuro-symbolic terramechanics model (deformable) to replace simulator rollouts for off-road RL; PPO trains in 1.36 h vs 33.48 h in Chrono at similar success; real robot 4/5 vs 2/5 for direct sim-to-real.

title: Expert-Play Contouring Control: Faster-than-Demonstration Planning from Slow Expert and Fast Play
one_line: EPCC: extracts a time-independent progress contour from slow expert demos, trains a world model on fast play data, and plans to maximize contour progress; 2.0x the Diffusion Policy baseline's throughput, averaged over three simulated manipulation tasks.

title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
one_line: Starts world-model branches at states where the flow policy's 3-step and 5-step samples disagree. RoboTwin average 58.8 vs 54.3 for VLA-MBPO.

title: ForceRFT: Refining VLA Actions through Force-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning
org: EIT Ningbo; Jiangnan U; SJTU; HKUST-GZ; NUS
one_line: Force-aware TD3 residual bounded to 1 mm and 0.5 deg on a frozen force-conditioned SmolVLA, plus human corrections. Plug insertion: 12/30 prior → 25/30 within a 30-min budget.

title: Stable and Efficient Real-World Online VLA Post-Training via Asynchronous Replay-Anchored Policy Improvement (RAPolicy)
org: Fudan University; Shanghai Key Laboratory of Multimodal Embodied AI; Singapore Management University
one_line: A rollout copy of pi0.5, re-synced after each small update group, collects data while the learner trains an IQL-style chunk critic and one-step flow actor only on stored actions. Real, 4 tasks, 20 trials each: 86.3% average vs EXPO-FT 50%.

title: FAN: Foresight Action Normalization for Continual Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Compares five action-normalization strategies for continual VLA adaptation; FAN freezes stats from a small task-independent calibration set, avoiding coordinate drift, best across four real single-arm/bimanual task streams.

title: Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-in-the-Loop Optimization
short: Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-in-the-Loop Optimization
one_line: Bootstraps a forward outcome model, uses it for active preference queries that learn a user-specific reward, then optimizes the assistive policy without extra trials; in simulation, an estimated 413 vs 563 queries (mutual information) to reach 10% preference error.

title: ProTracer: Proprioception-Guided Failure Diagnosis in Robot Manipulation
one_line: Training-free VLM framework that turns proprioceptive robot-state signals into text to detect, categorize, explain and localize onset of manipulation failures; introduces FailTime benchmark.

title: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator Disturbance Compensation
short: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator…
org: Hanyang Univ.; Kyonggi Univ.; Kookmin Univ.
one_line: Residual RL over an NMPC + disturbance-observer loop, with a latent disturbance estimator and an ISS-derived action bound. Real 6-DOF arm, zero-shot, vs NMPC+DOB: tracking error −27.8% (circle), −16.7% (figure-eight); path RMSE −38.0% under unseen base vibration.

title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
one_line: Coda: frozen flow-matching VLA runs few-step sampling, then a lightweight Transformer predicts a demo-supervised endpoint residual; RoboTwin 50 tasks 71.64%→74.68% (5 steps); SmolVLA 2-step 60.8%→69.4%.

title: Sandwich-Residuals: Parameter-Efficient Test-time Adaptation of World Models
one_line: Freezes the latent world model and learns small residuals around the predictor from its own prediction error, no rewards; over 21 AdaJEPA-benchmark conditions, 1.3x frozen-model success, 95% of the best AdaJEPA variant, 97-99% fewer adapted parameters than AdaJEPA.

title: FRAMES: Failure Recovery And Monitoring of Embodied Skills for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
one_line: Planner, VLM Monitor and Recovery agents supervise humanoid mid-level skills; monitor catches 48/50 failures and accepts 46/50 successes (94% accuracy) over 100 MuJoCo trials.

title: CommitFlow: Semantic Commitment Verification and Local Correction for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation VLA Execution
one_line: Closed-loop wrapper for a frozen VLA: a semantic commitment monitor holds back dependent actions until stage conditions hold, BoundaryFlow adds gain-calibrated local corrections; 75.9% mean success on ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, 22.7 points above pi0.5 (53.2%).

title: CARF: Contrastive Attraction-Repulsion of Failure-Guided Flow Matching
one_line: Progress-based scorer trained on successes labels imperfect-data segments; flow-matching policy is attracted to progressive segments and repelled from failure-critical ones, beating baselines in sim and real.

title: CounterPlay: Counterfactual Post-Training for Self-Play Driving Policies
one_line: Post-trains self-play driving policies by backtracking from failures via value estimates, retrying under reward-conditioned styles, keeping verified retries; BehaviorBench SOTA with 1B transitions (1% of anchor's 100B).

title: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
short: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
one_line: Replays simulated expert trajectories open-loop on a real Franka FR3 to record real observations, unifying data collection, closed-loop evaluation and sim-to-real gap measurement for chunk-based VLAs.

title: Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer
one_line: Embodiment-agnostic world model pretrained with optical flow, finetuned on target actions, steers a frozen base policy via latent-space search; with 50 target demos, relative gains of 16%/62% (Robomimic/real) for Diffusion Policy and 8%/14% for Pi0.5.

title: Scaling Vision-Language Reward Learning for Robot Manipulation in Parallel Simulation
one_line: RAPID: GPU-parallel IsaacLab rollouts plus single-request VLM preference labeling for reward learning; vs an RL-VLM-F baseline on five simulated Franka tasks, 8.0x end-to-end speedup, 95.5% fewer API calls, success 86.3% to 98.7%.

title: VLA-Scope: Shift-Aware Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Two-stage runtime monitor for OpenVLA: detects and classifies input shift, then logistic regression on shift category, action-prefix and progress features predicts failure; LIBERO-Spatial: 0.945 OOD ROC-AUC, 0.850 failure ROC-AUC after 60 actions (0.791 without progress).

title: VT-Bridge: Bridging Pretrained Foundation VLAs to VTLAs via Lightweight Residual Adaptation
one_line: 0.98M-parameter residual adapter fed estimated force/torque signals, on a LoRA-fine-tuned then frozen pi0, pi0.5 or SmolVLA; trained on up to 50 teleoperated demos per task (supervised, not RL). Four real contact-rich tasks: completion 11.7% (fine-tuned VLA) → 62.9%.

title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
one_line: Privileged-state scripted teacher with LLM-revised waypoints synthesizes demos; the VLA is SFT'd, then PPO-refined with binary reward. LIBERO-PRO, no new human demos: rescues all 27 zero-success tasks (direct PPO: 10); 97.8%/97.1% Position/Task-axis averages.

title: SeeQ: Training Generalist Value Functions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Trains a critic that only values finishing the active subtask (reward at subtask end, no bootstrapping across boundaries) and reranks 8 samples from a frozen pi0.5 with it. Real bimanual, 24 trials per task: 35.4% → 66.7% average.

title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention (PARTS: Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks)
one_line: Masked, bounded TD3+BC residuals on human-identified bottleneck subtasks of a frozen pi0.5 SFT policy, gated by agent-written selectors and verifiers. Full task 50% → 95% (Franka) and 32% → 61% (YAM), with tens of minutes of real-world RL per task.

title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
short: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
one_line: Coding agent iteratively refines closed-loop robot policy code with simulation feedback (RoboCasa 28.3% to 64.2%); archived optimized code transfers to new tasks, +15.6 points over unoptimized references.

title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
short: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
one_line: SGPS: BC-initialized depth policies alternate sampling-based MPC action-target refinement with short-horizon first-order policy-gradient updates in differentiable simulation; learns simulated Go2/G1 skills, and Go2 specialists are distilled into one depth policy that transfers zero-shot to a real Go2.

title: StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation
one_line: A teacher VLM (Qwen3.5-397B) plus demos generates subtask-completion rationales, distilled by SFT into a 0.8B student VLM that decides stage transitions. Transition completion 96.23% (LIBERO), 90.18% (BEHAVIOR-1K); real arms 18/20 and 16/20 closed-loop trials, no real-robot baseline.

title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University et al.
one_line: World model aligned to DINOv2 target-centric servo error; reactive policy trained with imitation, consequence supervision and imagined rollouts favoring error contraction; real 7-DoF arm reaches 10% error region in 30/30 trials, retains it in 25/30 (26.67% without future-error alignment).

title: REFINEPPO: Learning Continuous Control Policies by Iterative Action Refinement
one_line: PPO whose actor builds each action by iterative residual refinement: a shared network repeatedly corrects an initial proposal given state and current action. Matches or exceeds PPO on 14 Gymnasium control tasks, converging faster on several.

title: Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation
one_line: RebarSim: privileged state-based RL teacher on procedural rebar geometries, DAgger-distilled into a multi-view RGB student; zero-shot 91.3% (137/150) real seating at 1.4 mm clearance; adapting to a new design takes 4-6x fewer distillation samples than training from scratch.

title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
short: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
one_line: Residual PPO adds bounded local corrections and release timing to a nominal task-space controller; 98.5% sim success over 512 conditions, real xArm7 26.7% to 63.3%.

title: Catch Me If You Can: Real-Time Feedback Denoising for Responsive VLAs
one_line: VLA-Feedback: low-frequency diffusion planning with the final denoising step kept as a high-frequency visual feedback interface; vs GR00T (same planner), dynamic sim tasks 27.5%→85.0%, real robot (3 tasks) 51%→73% (CoRL 2026).

title: Diverse and Adaptable Arm Coordination for Octopus-Crawling via Diffusion-Based Uncertainty-Aware Optimization
one_line: Diffusion-based optimization discovers and preserves diverse crawling coordination strategies for a simulated muscle-actuated soft multi-arm robot without demonstrations, adapting to new constraints without full retraining.

title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
one_line: Contact-centric world model for deformable bag manipulation using larger time steps than its source simulator (10x faster state rollouts, excluding rendering); real bag lifting: 13/20 for a VLA fine-tuned on source-sim data alone vs 19/20 with WorldContact-expanded data.

title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
one_line: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model trained on 5h robot plus up to 100h human touch data; used as surrogate for policy evaluation and synthetic trajectory generation.

title: MAGMA-GEN: Validated Recovery Supervision from Ambiguous Failures via Counterfactual Re-Execution
one_line: Turns failed long-horizon manipulation rollouts into recovery supervision: a coach proposes corrections, kept only if re-execution from that point improves outcomes; beats distillation and trajectory repair (CoRL 2026).

title: EmbodiedMind: Adaptive Data Curation and Prefix-Tree Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Embodied Intelligence
one_line: RL post-training of an embodied VLM (Qwen3-VL-8B) that outputs text plans and answers, not motor actions: rejection-sampling SFT, difficulty-queued IR-GRPO, then Trie-GRPO with prefix-tree step-level advantages. 70.02% average over 18 multimodal, spatial and planning benchmarks.

title: OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher
one_line: RL-trained privileged teacher on vectorized inputs supervises closed-loop fine-tuning of camera driving policies in AlpaSim (3DGS); scene scores rise 1.6x (TransFuser) and 9.5x (VaVAM); in a separate vectorized WOMD study it matches RL fine-tuning with ~1000x fewer episodes.

title: GR2PO: Group Relative Return Policy Optimization for Continuous Robot Control
one_line: Critic-free GRPO-style RL for continuous control: discounted returns from parallel trajectories, group-normalized per time index, clipped updates. MuJoCo Ant/Walker2d/Humanoid: beats immediate-reward GRPO, near PPO/SAC (trails PPO on Humanoid); Jetson TX2 test is inference-only.

title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
one_line: LoRA-adapts a pretrained Robometer progress reward model with Plucker-ray camera conditioning and synchronized multi-view block attention; in sim, 41-69% lower progress error than averaging single-view RGB predictions; ~21% lower MAE on real tasks.

title: TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces
one_line: KDE scores from retrieved success and failure traces guide a frozen pi0.5, with no critic. Real ordered fruits TSR 21/50 → 39/50, then 47/50 after one more round.

title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
org: UT Austin, University of Florida, BrainCo
one_line: Single-image real-to-sim-to-real pipeline for dexterous hands (Gaussian background, VLM-inferred physics, VR teleop, trajectory synthesis); on six task pairs, 1:1 sim-real co-training lifts mean real success of ACT, DP and pi0.5 from 29.2% (sim-only) to 61.9%.

title: Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training
one_line: SFT, then human-gated DAgger, then a latent residual TD3 on a frozen pi0.5 for two 20-DoF hands. All 5 tasks reach 20/20. Transfer goes 10% → 65% → 70% → 100% with RL, using 3,000 online transitions per task.

title: HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface
one_line: Queries the current pi0.5 policy in shadow mode during handheld UMI demos; human-policy discrepancy triggers collection, then advantage-conditioned BC. Real Franka Stack Cube task-progress score (0-100, 10 trials) rises 84 to 100 over 3 rounds.

title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
one_line: Identifies Value Flattening in PPO critics (flat predictions vs sharply varying Monte Carlo values); SP3O supervises only three well-separated states per response, improving LLM RL on Qwen3-Base.

title: ForceDelta-VLA: Distilling Force-Conditioned Action Corrections for Contact-Rich Manipulation
one_line: Distills force-conditioned corrections to a base VLA action; 82.2% versus 54.4% ForceVLA success over nine contact-rich tasks, with approximately 26% lower mean peak force over successful trials.

title: Not All Layers Need Tuning: Diagnosing and Directing Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: A diagnostic allocates variable-rank LoRA across VLA regions according to deployment shift; on a real xArm-7 instruction-wording shift, achieves 21/30 successes versus 22/30 for full fine-tuning, with 0.04% of its trainable parameters.

title: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
short: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
one_line: Generates synthetic demos from reconstructed assets without teleoperated source trajectories, using constraint-guided mesh deformation that preserves contact geometry; zero-shot deployment on contact-rich long-horizon tasks, no real fine-tuning.

title: Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
short: Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Studies when continual model-based RL should drop pre-shift replay: forgetting helps after large permanent dynamics shifts, hurts when dynamics recur; estimates staleness from interaction data across locomotion morphologies.

title: RAFAIL: Relationship-Aware Failure Detection for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Runtime failure detection via point-cloud anomaly detectors on task-relevant entity relationships, labeled offline by a VLM from successful demos only; 73.4% balanced accuracy on three real tasks.

title: Causal-History Test-Time Scaling for Failure Recovery in Autoregressive World-Action Models
one_line: Training-free failure recovery for autoregressive world-action models: progress-aware trigger detects stalls, rolls causal KV history back to a reliable prefix, then verifies three recovery hypotheses before committing.

title: FIERCE: From Generalist Robot Policies to Fast Specialists via Progress-Failure Feedback
one_line: A progress plus failure-risk evaluator shapes SAC for a distilled specialist; real mean 92.0% vs 83.0% with Robometer-guided RL after 300 rollouts (single seed).

title: DistAL: Distance-based Advantage Learning for VLA Fine-Tuning
one_line: Dense reward inside RECAP: negative kNN distance to the base VLA's training embeddings. Hardware mean 44.0 base / 60.0 binary reward / 69.5% DistAL.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies (Real-Time EXPO-FT)
one_line: Slow pi0.5 proposes 32 chunks from a stale observation; a fast policy adds bounded edits from the fresh one; a Q-ensemble picks one. Real, 4 dynamic tasks, 10 min online data: 12.5/30 → 29/30 (EXPO-FT w/ RTC 25/30).

title: The Robot Data Factory
one_line: Infrastructure for a continuous Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat robot-experience loop, with a mission-to-capability hierarchy, fleet/sensor/compute scaling laws, and three physical training grounds.

title: XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience
one_line: XPACE shares a video backbone between a world-action policy and simulator. Heterogeneous human/robot training improves IRON robustness; fine-tuning on simulator-generated recovery trajectories further improves real-world task completion.

title: Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults
short: Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults
one_line: Frozen healthy teacher plus recurrent residual policy, trained with fault-injection randomization and adaptive fault sampling, compensates hidden single-joint command faults without fault labels; beats the healthy policy in sim and deploys zero-shot on a real LEAP Hand with software-injected faults.

title: Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement
one_line: Position paper: reuse the VLA's frozen visual encoder plus a reference bank of successful demonstration endpoints as a built-in reward/evaluator, avoiding a separate reward model; COMAU Racer 3 demonstrator at TRL 4, no policy-improvement results yet.

title: Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport
one_line: Offline RL: state-wise entropic optimal transport couples a value-aware reference flow policy to a one-step policy, prioritizing high-value distillation targets without direct critic maximization; best state-based OGBench average (48.3 vs 45.6 for GFP).

title: Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization
one_line: Online RL for flow policies: refines the policy's own samples toward a Q-induced energy-based distribution, then flow-matches to them. Matches or beats SAC on 5 of 6 MuJoCo tasks (not Hopper); fits six synthetic 2D multimodal targets without mode collapse.

title: Steering Generative Robot Policies with Lexicographic Preferences
one_line: Dynamic-barrier guidance protects higher-priority costs to first order; cascade selection chooses among frozen-policy samples. Navigation success: 44.3% base to 56.0%, versus selection-only 48.0% and weighted-sum guidance 50.7%.

title: Real-World Reinforcement Learning with MPC Scaffolding for Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: MPC data, BC/Soft-SARSA pretraining and guidance seed SAC on an Allegro hand; first 5/5 after 7.4 min, then 100% at 55 deg/s vs MPC's 9.9 deg/s.

title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
one_line: Offline RL flow-matching policy with dense critic guidance at randomly sampled flow timesteps, avoiding BPTT through the flow; strong OGBench locomotion and manipulation results with minimal tuning (IROS 2026).

title: REVOLVE: An Automated Closed-Loop Framework for Evolving Robot Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
one_line: VLM failure monitoring, deterministic recovery and automatic resets reduce human intervention during iterative learning. On four real ViperX tasks, average success rises from 40.0% to 58.5% over five iterations; human help remains available.

title: ReWeight: Leveraging Human Data for VLA Post-Training via Demonstration Retrieval and Sample Weighting
one_line: Optimal-transport retrieval of egocentric human demos plus sample weighting for pi0.5 post-training; RoboTwin simulation success 39% robot-only to 57%, real-world 40.0% to 68.8%. Weighted BC, without RL.

title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
one_line: A 33,985-parameter readout detects failures from frozen VLA-JEPA states: 85.68/88.59 pooled AUROC/AUPRC across seven tasks. Real-robot transfer varies and is tested with adaptation; 0.23ms timing covers only the readout.

title: Smooth Exponentials for Robotics
one_line: Essay arguing robotics has entered smooth exponential progress via many players and standardized hardware-agnostic pretraining data; predicts the first 2-3 general-purpose home robots on the market in October 2027. No RL fine-tuning content.

title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
one_line: A world-model simulator uses a unified 28-dimensional action space. In RoboTwin simulation, adding 500 generated trajectories to 50 demos/task raises policy success from 70% to 93%; evaluation correlation is 0.994 across five checkpoints.

title: When Validation Stops Learning: Auditing Update Admission for Continual Embodied Agents
one_line: Audits policy-update admission: paired-binomial checks admit 31.6% of updates at 2,000 episodes/stage versus zero for a range-based gate in synthetic pushing. Unconditional replay learns better closed-loop; evidence remains analytical and simulated.

title: RoboDrop: Curating VLA Post-Training Data via Local Gradient Compatibility
one_line: In one warm-up epoch, compares each sample's compressed gradient with one from the most similar clean validation frames, and drops conflicting episodes before re-post-training pi0.5. Real, 4 tasks, 20 rollouts each: 35.0% → 67.5% with automatic filtering.

title: HaWMPO: Hallucination-Aware World Model-based Policy Optimization for Generalist Robot Policy
org: JD Joy Future Academy; Jilin University
one_line: Action-conditioned model scores hallucination per imagined chunk (AUROC 0.9375 on 50 human-labeled LIBERO chunks); scores down-weight chunk rewards in GRPO. LIBERO Spatial/Goal/Object average 63.7 vs 60.9 for reproduced WoVR* (no PACE).

title: WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training
one_line: Shared transformer with world-model and action heads (mixed unidirectional attention mask); at deployment samples exploratory actions and test-time-trains the world model on collected transitions; CALVIN, LIBERO gains.

title: A Decade of Bayesian Optimization for Controller Tuning and Robot Learning: Tutorial, Review, and Future Prospects
org: RWTH Aachen, University of Technology Nuremberg, TU Munich
one_line: Survey framing controller tuning as episodic policy search where a GP surrogate picks each trial; reviews 110 hardware papers and releases TuneControl. 57 of 110 use vanilla BO; sim 4-parameter cart-pole: LogEI 4310±48 vs Sobol 4647±190 (median±IQR cost, lower better).

title: No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies
one_line: A survey of roughly 150 robot verifiers grouped by who supplies the judgment; finds credibility falls as availability rises, and argues robotics has yet to search a learned verifier for inputs it wrongly accepts.

title: Proxy Policy Steering (PPS)
one_line: Nudges the base velocity field by gamma*(v_task - v_ref) from two small proxy models, with no RL. Real 8 tasks: pi0.5 22% → 79%, vs LoRA 59%, residual 19%, DSRL 25%.

title: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in Surgical Manipulation
short: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in…
one_line: VLM feedback returns the furthest visually verified task phase and its first-arrival time so sparse-reward RL reuses partial progress from failures; 75.2% vs 52.1% for CLIP rewards in simulation.

title: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
short: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Defines a Q-function over diffusion latents and a noisy-space policy gradient that avoids backprop through denoising; improves offline RL on state-based D4RL and vision-based OGBench (ICML 2026).

title: VLA-Corrector: Stage-Aware Observable State Understanding for Prompt-Based Closed-Loop Recovery of Vision-Language-Action Policies
one_line: Learned verifier estimates stage-wise progress and risk from observations, proprioception and actions, triggering stage-conditioned recovery prompts for a frozen VLA; improves LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus robustness without parameter updates.

title: Where Success Breaks: Failure-Boundary Learning for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models (DLS)
org: Show Lab, National University of Singapore
one_line: Finds pi0/pi0.5 failures in parallel digital twins, turns hand-defined task phases into a dense potential, and applies a critic-free contrastive velocity loss plus a real-demo SFT anchor. pi0.5, 3 real tasks, ID/Unseen: 84.4/72.2 vs PPO 81.1/67.8, 100-demo SFT 78.9/54.4.

title: How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation
org: HKUST (Guangzhou); Italian Institute of Technology; Zhejiang University
one_line: Real-world HIL residual SAC over a frozen BC prior; an intervention-aware latent world model predicts operator takeovers and shapes the actor away from them. Pick & Place: BC 43.3%, model-free HIL residual 60.0%, WHIRL 90.0% (30 trials).

title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
one_line: World-action model caches predicted contact; a tactile expert corrects chunk actions during execution, 20.7x cheaper than regenerating; real success 22% to 64% across five tasks.

title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
one_line: Frozen slow model plus on-device Capsule Field memory adds verified near-OOD successes without gradients. Matches an in-house full-data policy using 40% of its data; memory growth raises mean action success from 74.0% to 87.9%.

title: FailureSpot: Label-Efficient Timestamp-Level Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Timestamp-level VLA failure detection learns from weak labels on anomalous action chunks, then actively selects uncertain trajectories for annotation. Evaluated across VLAs with a fixed 15% timestamp-annotation budget.

title: R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models
