one_line: Calibrated Isaac twin plus pairwise VLM preferences with Bradley-Terry. Mean real-sim gap 2.13 pp and identical ranking across 6 VLAs.

title: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Imagines candidate chunks only at interaction-relevant states. Uses 77% less GPU time than full imagination and gets real pi0 60.0 → 77.5.

title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
org: University of Science and Technology of China; Beihang University; Zhongguancun Academy; Hefei SpinX Technology
one_line: Post-trains pi0.5's action-expert LoRA with flow-matching BC on demos, successes and human corrections, plus ensemble-critic advantages relative to a frozen reference instead of absolute-Q maximization. 9 real chemistry-lab tasks: 98.3% vs demo-only pi0.5 67.8%, ConRFT (Octo) 7.8%.

title: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized construction: A sample-efficient installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework
short: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized…
one_line: Installer-in-the-loop RL (Q-chunking with Flow Q-Learning, teleop demos plus binary takeovers) for window-unit seating, in MuJoCo sim: at 2 mm per-side clearance, 100% autonomous seating after 3.0 h online training with 12-15 min supervision.

title: Recursive Value Learning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
one_line: DCRL: recursively splits trajectory segments into a balanced binary tree, cutting worst-case bootstrap depth from linear to logarithmic; on the five hardest long-horizon OGBench tasks, raises the best prior average score from 55 to 64.

title: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
short: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of…
one_line: Six state estimators on differential-drive path tracking, 24 sensing conditions: replay position RMSE predicts closed-loop cross-track error (Spearman 0.923) better than open-loop rollout error (0.774).

title: World-Coherent Decoding: Self-Verifying Test-Time Planning for World Action Models
one_line: Samples futures from a frozen World Action Model, ranks video surprisal and action-path effort, and learns an execution-mismatch predictor. RoboTwin 2.0 Hard: 55.80% base WAM to 60.90% with limited randomized-scene supervision.

title: Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs
one_line: Training-free adaptive execution horizon for VLAs: detects high-entropy plateaus in action-to-observation cross-attention to decide when to replan; improves success on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO.

title: Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation
one_line: A wrench-predicting VLA uses contact-selective credit tags and bounded TD3+BC adaptation. Five real precision-assembly tasks: 16% alignment-only, 38% value-guided refinement, 82% full system; authors’ matched pi0.5+RECAP-style implementation scores 15%.

title: Physical Self-Play
one_line: Previews RL post-training via self-play: in simulated robot soccer the policy's one stated objective is to score, playing recent versions of itself, then is transferred to a real humanoid. No metrics; 140 simulated years of play, real match on video.

title: Robot Demos Are Easy. Reliability Is Hard (Jason Ma, Dyna Robotics talk)
short: Dyna: reward model as failure detector
one_line: A learned video progress model monitors deployment: progress dips flag errors and steer targeted recovery-data collection and retraining. Dyna-1 napkin folding: 99.4% success over a 24-hour run; Dyna says conventional pipelines stall near 80% (talk, no paper).

title: Towards Universal Post-Training for Robotics (blog)
one_line: Position essay for an EXPO-FT-style standard robot post-training recipe. It cites EXPO-FT reaching 30/30 with an average of about 19 min of online interaction. The baseline averages cover only the 4 tasks every baseline ran.

title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
one_line: Combines multi-horizon future-latent prediction with value-derived quality conditions for a flow actor. Matched-data comparisons improve success by 5.0 points on LIBERO-Plus and 4.5 points on RoboTwin Random (simulation).

title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: Single shared-weight model serves as policy, simulator and evaluator in a closed loop; curated expert demos train actions while failed and suboptimal interactions train dynamics and value; tactile sensing on a dexterous bimanual platform.

title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
one_line: Bounded residual TD3 actor on a frozen pi0.5 trained under the real asynchronous execution loop; tossing 39% → 94%, pen capping 8% → 83% over ~250 episodes.

title: DREAM: Deployment-Time Demonstration Generation via Real-to-Sim for Scalable Policy Adaptation
one_line: Reconstructs the deployment workspace in sim, translates instructions to symbolic goals via LLM, and uses TAMP to generate verified, randomized demos for VLA fine-tuning without human teleoperation.

title: In-Context Learning Results Hint at a "GPT Moment" for Robotics
short: In-Context Learning Results Hint at a "GPT Moment" for Robotics
one_line: Chris Paxton reviews video-prompted in-context learning (Skild S1, GEN-1.5, Rhoda, Lingbot VA-2) as an alternative to retraining; notes wholly new skills at high success still need more data or on-robot RL.

title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Retry via perturbation and bridging-segment augmented demos, plus Reset skills learned from offline MLLM failure-video analysis and gated by an online MLLM monitor, improves VLA robustness on contact-rich tasks.

title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
short: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
one_line: Analyzes ES post-training for LLM reasoning: unlike GRPO (entropy collapse), ES improves Pass@1 and reaches higher Pass@K than GRPO; gains concentrate in a sparse subset of larger-magnitude parameter updates; tests sequential GRPO/ES combinations (adjacent, LLMs).

title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
one_line: Cross-embodiment action-conditioned video world model: curriculum from latent actions on unlabeled video to end-effector/language actions; approaches or surpasses single-embodiment models on DROID, spans Bridge, YAM, G1.

title: GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
one_line: ConRFT-style online VLA RL plus training-only visual anchors for fine-grained lab tasks; 82.5% vs 57.5% for proposal-union supervision.

title: R^3: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Post-trains a VLM as a robotic reasoner: mid-training on expert reasoning traces, then rubric-based RL on offline action data; language reasoning steers low-level policies at test time.

title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
one_line: RA-VLA trains behavior-aligned demonstration retrieval and context-following execution on training tasks. It then adapts to held-out tasks through retrieved demonstrations without further weight updates; evaluated on LIBERO and a real UR5e.

title: Beyond Pairwise Feedback: Listwise Vision-Language Supervision for Preference-Based Reward Learning
one_line: A VLM ranks K=3-5 replay-buffer frames at once; a Plackett-Luce listwise loss trains the reward model. Competitive with pairwise Bradley-Terry and RL-VLM-F on three Meta-World tasks (Drawer Open: PL 86% vs RL-VLM-F 92%).

title: RoG-DAgger: Rollout-Guided Post-Training for End-to-End Driving
one_line: DAgger uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to generate driving corrections and time takeovers. In CARLA, improves SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points on Bench2Drive and raises Fail2Drive OOD success from 55% to 66%.

title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency (ARLI: Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information)
one_line: DSRL under asynchronous VLA inference. It feeds the noise policy the committed actions plus a fresher mid-inference frame. Real success goes from around 40% to near 100% in 100-125 episodes.

title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
one_line: A frozen teacher relabels an accelerated WAM student’s own rollout histories. Preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, 12 paired evaluations/task: Flash-WAM improves Handover Mic from 0/12 to 7/12 and Put Object Cabinet from 2/12 to 4/12.

title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Pairs expert actions with mismatched instructions and trains an adversarial discriminator as a reward for offline-RL VLA post-training; improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and real-robot (TX-G2) results.

title: CIDER: Continual Interactive Distillation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
one_line: RLPD plus reverse-KL distillation preserves a frozen teacher’s skills. After six sequential real tasks, CIDER reports 100/100 successful trials per task (Wilson 95%: 96.3–100%); plain fine-tuning averages 16.7% over those tasks.

title: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
short: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Trains the actor purely as a behavior model and does policy improvement at inference by critic reranking of behavior-supported candidates; reported to beat BC and jointly trained offline RL.

title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
one_line: Keeps the policy frozen as a proposal, scores 32-64 candidate chunks with a separate ~1B Q-function, runs their softmax-Q-weighted average, and retrains only the critic. Real robot, 5 iterations: stack-cups 40% → 90% vs 55% for SFT on successful rollouts.

title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
one_line: VLM-guided subgoals collect exploration trajectories, successful episodes fine-tune the VLA, and residual off-policy RL further optimizes it; evaluated on 22 simulated ALOHA manipulation tasks.

title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
one_line: Predicts scenario-level real-world policy performance from few paired sim/real samples plus many sim rollouts, with sim-bias correction and conformal calibration. Sim-to-sim: error down 4.9%/34.7% (driving), 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) vs neural/aggregate baselines; also run on a real Go2.

title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Learns reward from success-only demos by predicting expected transitions and scoring observed displacement on direction and magnitude agreement; penalizes wrong-direction and overshoot, reducing reward hacking in online/offline RL.

title: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
one_line: Replays frozen base-VLA rollouts with new expert demonstrations to prevent forgetting. Real ALOHA gear insertion: 30% with expert-only fine-tuning to 90% with self-demonstration replay.

title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Post-trains a reposing-pretrained PPO arm-hand policy: BC-distill the actor into new observations, warm up a fresh critic with the actor frozen, then PPO at actor LR 1e-5. Sim peg insertion: 5/5 seeds reach ADR 50 vs 0/5 at LR 1e-3.

title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
one_line: Generalist world model conditioned on pixel action flow across embodiments; 90.4% lower robot-motion error than action-conditioned baseline, r=0.96 replayed-vs-reference success correlation on RoboLab.

title: Reuse Before You Retrieve: Diagnosing Headroom and Complementarity for Test-Time Augmentation of Embodied Multimodal Policies
one_line: Diagnoses frozen VLAs via recoverable headroom (resampling/retry selection) versus retrieval complementarity (external demos); gains up to 21 points on LIBERO track measured headroom.

title: ORPA: Online Residual Policy Adaptation for Robot Manipulation Control with Human Feedback
one_line: Supervised residual head that turns coarse human feedback ('too left') into joint corrections for a frozen ACT, with no RL. Sim induced-failure Cube Transfer 60.0% → 92.3%.

title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
one_line: Reward = success + 0.2*quality (contacts, jerk, VLM judge) to break zero-variance groups, with an RLOO advantage. Theory: binary GRPO needs ~1.76x the rollouts per informative group at G=8 (p=0.1/0.9).

title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
one_line: Harness evolves runtime critics and recovery skills around frozen VLAs. Across 40 LIBERO-Pro Goal/Long task-settings, pi0.5 success rises from 32.0% to 71.1%; on 18 RoboCasa tasks, GR00T rises from 73.6% to 93.6%.

title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Privileged value functions give critics information hidden from the policy; TETHER mixes value and group-relative baselines. Both improve over standard value baselines and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO on tested reasoning tasks.

title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
one_line: Inverts demos into flow noise, keeps K=8 DCT modes, BC-initializes, then runs SAC on a frozen humanoid VLA. Toy Storage OOD with pi0.5: 2/10 → 8/10, while DSRL training failed.

title: τ0-VLA (tau0-VLA): a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
one_line: Confidence-gated beam search proposes subtasks, ranked with world-model and value predictions. Real Book Organization: 6/10 with the same hierarchy’s Plan Once baseline versus 9/10 with test-time search.

title: Q-Learning With World Models (QWM)
one_line: World-model tree search selects actions during online RL and evaluation atop EXPO/RLPD. Policy and Q-functions train only on real transitions; Robomimic and LIBERO experiments report improved sample efficiency from predictive search.

title: ViTaR: Visuo-Tactile Residual Adaptation for Foundation VLA Manipulation
one_line: Effect-Guided Modeling uses tactile feedback to select bounded residual corrections atop frozen OpenVLA-OFT. Seven simulated UniVTAC contact tasks: 61.3% mean success, 30.6 percentage points above the base.

title: GAINS: Leveraging Inconsistent Human Intervention Signals in Reinforcement Learning
org: Beijing Institute of Technology; Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics; City University of Hong Kong; Nankai University
one_line: Learns the return distribution with a truncated-quantile critic and acts on its lower tail, because takeover timing is inconsistent (over half of repeated marks differ by 10+ frames). Four sim and two real tasks: 22% higher success than RLIF.

title: Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
org: Peking University, EvoPhys AI and others
one_line: Adds rollout-history panels and OOD failure edits to the pairwise hop model; real repeated insertion 71/80 vs 48/80 for event-sparse reward.

title: Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning (PDF subtitle: "with Monte Carlo Q-Chunk Critics")
one_line: A Monte Carlo chunk critic selects imitation targets from buffer or actor actions by Q. Real USB insertion: ACT QChunk-MCBC reaches 99% in 30 minutes; HIL-SERL peaks at 100% after 5 hours.

title: PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation
one_line: A phase-aware distributional critic gives cleaner RECAP labels. LIBERO-Long 73.8 (ReCAP) → 83.3 (PACE).

title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs
org: Fudan University; Singapore Management University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
one_line: Keeps the flow decoder deterministic and adds exploration noise only to the output action, AR(1)-correlated within a chunk with learned, group-bounded scales for position, rotation and gripper. ManiSkill pi0.5 OOD average: SFT 25.9, piRL 49.3, action-space Gaussian 65.9, StructRL 70.3.

title: Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems
one_line: Onto-EV-WM layers a task ontology and deterministic rules over the EV-WM world model to record unmet predicates and route verification-gated corrections. LIBERO-Goal replay windows: 86.95% to 94.05% after direct simulator-state corrections; PointMaze ties EV-WM at 94%.

title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
one_line: Evaluation toolkit that turns rollout videos into dense progress curves with three metrics (failure-side progress, recovery, success-side execution quality); adds RoboPulse++ to validate process reward models.

title: Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models (CoRe)
one_line: Flags out-of-distribution states via a Mahalanobis test on the action-expert latent, rewinds to a recovery anchor, imagines the frozen policy's moves, and plans minimal object restorations; training-free. Sim LangSwitch (ManiSkill) switch average: pi0 18.3 → 87.5, pi0.5 35.5 → 92.7.

title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
one_line: Action-conditioned latent world model trained on unlabeled trajectories predicts multi-view embeddings under planned actions; a lightweight failure probe aborts failure-prone actions before contact, without modifying the policy.

title: FIRE-VLA: Failure-Informed Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
one_line: Low-reward, low-diversity groups trigger privileged-teacher self-distillation. Open-loop nuScenes, four-sample evaluation: mean L2 1.500m versus GRPO 1.848m (SFT 1.004m); single-sample improvement is inconclusive.

title: Temporal GRPO: Beyond Trajectory-Level Credit in Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
one_line: A frozen VLM proposes checkable stages compiled into predicates; group advantages are computed per stage over rollouts that reached it, so good early actions escape blame for later failures. Sim RoboTwin 2.0, OpenVLA-OFT, macro-average: 75.8 vs SimpleVLA-RL 68.8 (SFT 38.3).

title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
short: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
one_line: SHAPER: training-free self-improvement that keeps model weights frozen and evolves reusable skills plus a context-code harness; compared to fine-tuning and test-time scaling on VLABench and ESI-Bench. (adjacent)

title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
one_line: Pretrains only a BC actor offline, then starts online fine-tuning with a fresh critic after a short warm-up on offline data; plugs into existing offline-to-online algorithms; gains on simulated OGBench manipulation, roughly on par on Robomimic.

title: Adaptation of Generalist Robot Policies with Minimal Data (MiDAS: Minimal-Data Adaptation Strategy)
one_line: LoRA-tunes pi0.5 on one demo, then freezes it and trains a sparse-reward off-policy edit actor-critic that outputs the full executed chunk, so it can leave the base's action support. LIBERO-Long, 1 demo: 91.2 vs DICE-RL 89.3, DSRL 33.5.

title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
one_line: Treats optimization strategies retrieved for world models (Ctrl-World, Cosmos family, RoboCoin adaptation) as hypotheses validated on-target by a frozen verifier: 68% lower search cost vs cold start, negative transfer 0.34 (unconditional reuse) to 0.06.

title: RefineFly: Failure-Aware Post-Training for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
one_line: Token-level PPO post-training of a UAV VLA with dynamic failure memory, a two-stage scene curriculum and stage-specific reference regularization. TravelUAV (AirSim sim): +3.12 to 8.37 pp success over AerialVLA, with total rollouts about 30% of training-set size.

title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
one_line: Test-time prompt adaptation for VLAs: candidate updates are isolated, checked against future visual observations, and committed only if supported; +3.2 points over baseline TTT on SimplerEnv WidowX.

title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
one_line: World-action model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on executed actions, so failure rollouts supervise action consequences. Adding failure data lifts real bimanual seen-task success 82% to 89%; RoboTwin sim 87.5% vs Motus 87.8%.

title: Efficient Real-World Online Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation via Centralized Training and Critic Decomposition (HARC: Hybrid Actors with Reward-decomposed Critic)
one_line: Separate arm and gripper actors with one reward-decomposed central critic; real 3-task average 40% → 75% vs HIL-SERL.

title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Rainbow DQN picks the playback speed of a frozen ACT's chunks, so it hill-climbs cycle time rather than success. Sim Cube Transfer runs 3.81x faster at 97.9% (ACT 100%). The arXiv date is 2026-08, but the venue is ICRA 2025.

title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
one_line: Predicts seconds until task completion from an instruction and a few frames, trained on over 7,000 hours of video with no preference labels. As reward for real online DSRL on frozen pi0.5: 72.5% vs Robometer 52.5%, sparse 48.8%.

title: AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies
one_line: Scores proposed action chunks by visual similarity and consistency against a memory of successful demos, with separate calibrated thresholds for policy-operator handoffs; corrections from successful rollouts adapt the policy.

title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Two TD3 loops at different speeds for a VLA's semantic projection and action expert; CALVIN SR5 81.7 vs FLOWER 77.8.

title: Beyond Flat Policies: Hierarchical Post-Training for Embodied Agents in Robotic Manipulation (HiRoC)
one_line: Hierarchical post-training: a Qwen2.5-VL-3B planner emits subgoals; an OpenVLA-OFT executor is first aligned to planner subgoals, then improved with online GRPO. LIBERO average 93.5% vs 91.0% for the strongest listed baseline.

title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
one_line: HIL-SERL-style RL with a self-evolving success classifier, flow-matching action-chunk actor, and offline fine-tuning on relit replay; real FR3 USB insertion at the 60% point of a composite lighting-shift index: 1.00 vs HIL-SERL 0.50.

title: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
short: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
org: Qi Wang, Wentao Zhu et al.
one_line: Thea brings the coding-agent harness to robots: a persistent scene graph serves as context, and evaluations act as exit codes that detect completion, judge success and diagnose failures on long-horizon tasks.

title: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
short: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
one_line: Experiments attribute action-chunking gains to non-Markovian expressivity, reduced compounding error and implicit ensembling over delays. An explicit delayed-policy ensemble outperforms chunking in many tested settings.

title: ValueFormer: A Causal Transformer Value Function with Stage-Aware Labels for Semi-Autonomous Vision-Language-Action Policies
one_line: A 3.5M-parameter causal critic on DINOv3 for AWR reweighting and mistake detection; sandwich completion 70% to 85% (n=20, Fisher p=0.45, not significant).

title: You Don't Need To Stay in The Loop: An Agentic Robotics Loop for Robot-Policy Improvement
short: You Don't Need To Stay in The Loop
one_line: LLM controller coordinates recoverable train-evaluate-improve runs. Hardened gates reduce false promotions to 0.001 per run versus 0.005–0.021 with shipped gates; on the one measured lineage, checkpoint selection loses to taking the last checkpoint.

title: RL Bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT for a Novel Robot Embodiment
short: RL Bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT for a Novel Robot Embodiment
one_line: Demo-free RL in simulation aligns OpenVLA-OFT to a cable-driven parallel robot: PPO on directional primitives, then GRPO with expanded instructions. Held-out directional success 34.25% (after PPO) to 53.50% (after GRPO); move-to-object only 9.75%.

title: Not Just a Model, But a Product (Dyna Robotics blog on scaling customer deployments)
one_line: Fleet workflow: an auto-labeler splits each deployed episode into SOP steps with outcome and failure mode, humans review uncertain cases, and engineers query the fleet to retrain. Napkin folding: 35/hour, 75% passing (Dyna-1) → 95/hour, 93% (Dyna-2).

title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
one_line: Action-conditioned world model with initial-environment guidance and visual history supports imitation-data generation and closed-loop policy evaluation. Reports the highest combined score across WorldArena Track 1 and both Track 2 applications.

title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
org: UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, NVIDIA Research
one_line: Tunes closed-weight Gemini Robotics On-Device via an SFT API only, tagging the top 30% of chunks by dense-reward advantage over similar-start chunks as 'advantage positive'. Real Unitree G1, 2 cycles of 100 rollouts: Plate Handover 53% → 96%.

title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
one_line: A history-aware critic trained with latent next-state prediction; beats a single-frame VLM critic on all 7 real RECAP/AWR tasks (best 44/50) and reaches 99.0% ManiSkill IND with OpenVLA-OFT (PPO critic: 97.7%).

title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
short: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
one_line: Whole-body VLA plus ER 2 reasoning model and On-Device 2, which adapts to new bi-arm embodiments typically with under 200 examples; charted success ranges 32-92%, multi-finger dexterity still the hardest. No RL post-training described.

title: RedFlow: Redirect Failure into Action-level Corrections for Flow-Matching VLA Policies
one_line: Clusters action chunks by estimated progress and joint state; within a cluster, positive-scored chunks (progress gain plus episode outcome) form correction targets for negative chunks, which are also suppressed. Real pi0 clothes folding: 36 → 67/100 (AWR 48).

title: RLMM-Flow: A Flow-based Mobile Manipulation Framework with Latent-Space Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Frozen pretrained flow policy steered by an offline-RL latent-noise actor, with action-critic warm-up and coarse-to-fine latent-to-residual expansion; beats imitation-only and RL post-training baselines on success and collisions in simulated mobile manipulation, transferred zero-shot to real.

title: RL2-VLA: Adaptive RL Latent Compositional Steering with Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Offline-RL head on VLA latents is blended into the velocity to diversify candidates for verifier best-of-N, gated by a SAFE failure detector. PolaRiS pi0.5 OOD average 14.3 → 42.7 (rephrase 31.8).

title: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning? (IPE: Initialization via Policy Ensemble)
one_line: Shows demo-pretrained critics barely beat random ones, then rolls out an ensemble of diverse policies trained on the same data so the critic sees contrasting actions. Six Robomimic/OGBench sim tasks: reported 1.26x average fine-tuning improvement over naive Q pretraining.

title: ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
one_line: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model trained on real plus simulated tactile data; predicts aligned vision and touch for policy evaluation and rollout-based data augmentation of tactile policies.

title: GRACE: Gradient-Free Robot Action Generation via Combined Diffusion-MPPI Posterior Mean Estimation
one_line: Steers pretrained diffusion policies using MPPI forward cost evaluations, including non-differentiable constraints. On a real 7-DoF arm, avoids a deployment-time obstacle that the unguided prior hits in every trial.

title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids (DEED)
org: HIVE Robots; Technical University of Denmark
one_line: Data-efficient GR00T N1.6 post-training plus a RECAP-adapted refinement (text advantage prefix, VLM value function) for chip restocking on a Unitree G1, ~108 min of data. 50 real episodes each: SFT 32%, iteration 1 42% (CIs overlap), iteration 2 22%.

title: RoboHarness: Memory-Driven Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Policies for Long-Horizon Planning
org: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab; UBC; University of Toronto; McGill
one_line: Orchestrates heterogeneous policies (VLA, RL, TAMP) as agentic skills, using execution memory and a Memory Bridge to route and hand off between them; evaluated on 500 tasks and 135 real-robot trials.

title: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
short: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
one_line: Training-free best-of-N ranks world-action-model futures by cross-view depth-reprojection consistency from a frozen geometry model. At N=8, RoboCasa simulation group averages rise from 66.3% to 68.4% for Cosmos Policy and 80.8% to 82.5% for X-WAM.

title: Sunday Robotics ACT-2: What 778 of 785 Laundry Folds Actually Prove
one_line: Third-party evidence audit of ACT-2's 778/785 (99.1%) laundry-fold result: one fixed checkpoint across unseen homes, no per-home adaptation, but first-party, task-specific, not independently reproduced.

title: Data and Learning Where it Matters for Contact-Rich Manipulation
one_line: Motion planning for free-space motion; autonomous dense data collection plus offline SAC-based RL only for the contact segment; real 4-task average 96% vs 55% for the strongest baseline.

title: Foresight Residual RL for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Trains a PPO residual on a frozen per-phase pi0 for each subtask, multiplying each phase's reward by a learned predictor of next-phase success. Sim wrench-on-nut full task: 85.6±3.9% vs 54.5±3.6% with plain per-phase residuals.

title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
one_line: Fast-weight test-time training compresses history into weights, scaling visuomotor context to 8K timesteps. Real-robot average task-completion score: 79% versus single-step GR00T N1.7 at 42% and strongest baseline GDN at 56%.

title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
one_line: Action-conditioned drifting world model generating future frames in one forward pass: 30+ fps, 17x faster on average than diffusion baselines; policy-ranking scores correlate with simulator ground truth up to 0.99 (Robomimic Lift).

title: Zero2Skill: Bootstrapping Robot Skills through Autonomous Data Collection, Training, and Deployment
one_line: Language corrections persist in a corrective memory for autonomous data collection. Matches teleoperation episode-collection success at 16% of human working time; separately, two corrections raise real single-attempt collection success from 12.5% to 47.5%.

title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection (LIFT)
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Innovation…
one_line: Grafts force sensing onto pi0.5 during online DAgger; towel folding peaked at 0.825 (#2.8K frames) vs vision-only 0.725 (#3.1K).

title: Deconstructing Actor-Critic: A Large-scale Empirical Study of Design Components for Practitioners
one_line: 33,000+ experiments on a simulated PID-gain-tuning task built from real water-treatment-plant data dissect actor-critic design choices; Gaussian policies with pathwise gradients are among the least reliable, bounded distributions with adaptive update schedules stay robust.

title: Deployable Human Preference Alignment in Robotics: Learning Representative Rewards from Diverse Human Preferences
short: Deployable Human Preference Alignment in Robotics: Learning Representative Rewards from…
one_line: PREC clusters users into preference-coherent groups from binary preference labels and learns one reward model per cluster, beating a single shared policy in simulated locomotion.

title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
org: UNC Chapel Hill, CMU, SJTU, Amazon
one_line: Failures synthesized in sim train a Qwen3-VL-4B progress model (MAE 0.081 vs 0.230 for RoboReward-8B); real DSRL stack cups 60% sparse to 80% (10 trials).

title: UR-VC: Unsupervised Robotic Value Correction for Time-Derived Progress Proxies
one_line: Training-free correction of t/T labels via cross-episode nearest neighbours; advantage-conditioned cloth folding 72.8% (131/180) to 78.9% (142/180), vs a no-advantage baseline.

title: VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Replaces the Euler sampler so direct Q-gradients through a flow policy stay stable; OGBench 40 tasks 60 vs QAM 55.

title: Learning More from Less: Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight (LfH)
one_line: A VLM relabels low-reward GRPO groups (mean reward <0.8) with a hindsight instruction and reward. LIBERO-PRO OOD: matches GRPO's final score in ~5 vs ~30 steps. Real Franka FR3: 56% vs GRPO's 22% at 160 rollouts.

title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
org: Renmin University; Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
one_line: A history-conditioned VLM value guides quality-conditioned pretraining and filters rollouts for residual adaptation. Real chip insertion improves from 46% to 86% over three rounds of 500 rollouts.

title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers
one_line: Chunk-level PPO on a pretrained ACT (CVAE removed, learnable Gaussian noise), with a KL term between consecutive updates and a reward penalty for leaving the frozen BC policy. Sim Contour and Square Assembly: ACT 60.0%/51.2% → 100.0%/98.2%.

title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
one_line: LLM coding agents compose a frozen VLA with analytic primitives, learning operating ranges from execution traces. Best planner backend versus frozen VLA alone: LIBERO-Pro 82.4% versus 50.0%; RoboCasa365 57.1% versus 30.0% (simulation).

title: Prompt-Driven Exploration: Language as an Exploration Space for VLA Reinforcement Learning (PDE)
org: MIT Improbable AI Lab; MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab
one_line: Explores in language: a VLM watches rollout videos and rewrites per-episode prompts; PPO consolidates successes under the canonical prompt. Sim LIBERO-PRO hard tier (47 tasks), pi0.5: 19.5% vs action-noise PPO 13.3% (init 1.3%); one zero-start task: 81.8% vs 0%.

title: FlowDAgger: Human-in-the-Loop Adaptation of Generative Robot Policies in Latent Space
org: Microsoft Research; Microsoft; ETH Zurich; University of…
one_line: Inverts the flow sampler to find the noise that would have produced the operator's correction and trains a small noise policy on it, VLA frozen. MetaWorld, pi0.5: 0.78 vs SFT 0.71; held-out skills 0.88 (base 0.96) vs SFT 0.02.

title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
one_line: Test-time training updates a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen world-action model via self-supervised prediction on unlabeled human videos; beats in-context human-video conditioning on manipulation tasks.

title: Reward-Aware Population Scaling of Evolutionary Strategies in LLM Fine-Tuning
short: Reward-Aware Population Scaling of Evolutionary Strategies in LLM Fine-Tuning
one_line: In tested capable 0.5B–7B LLMs, z-score normalization can make binary-reward ES with N=2 fail; removing it improves GSM8K/TREC results. Derives zero-advantage probability and cautions that N=2 is not universally sufficient.

title: PriGo: Test-Time Primitive Guidance to Diffusion and Flow Policies for Adaptive Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Lightweight PANet predicts motion primitives and applies differentiable guidance to pretrained diffusion/flow policies at inference, no retraining; gains on LIBERO, CALVIN, SIMPLER and real-robot tasks.

title: HELP: Human-Efficient Large-Scale Robot Post-Training with Rollout Segmentation
one_line: A progress critic (VLAC-CUT) cuts autonomous pi0.5 rollouts into progress, recovery, idle and failure-inducing segments; only progress and recovery segments join HITL recovery data for retraining. Real round 2, Microplate: 42 tasks/hr at 90% vs HITL-only 25 at 60%.

title: RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
one_line: Single RGB image to sim-ready scene (collision-aware foreground assets, 3DGS background); releases DROID-Sim from 564 real scenes for replay, synthetic data generation and sim-real correlated policy evaluation.

title: LAMP: Latent Motion Prior-Guided Real-World Learning for Dexterous Hand Manipulation
one_line: Residual SAC/RLPD in a 2-D learned latent of hand motions for a 6-DoF dexterous hand. Real average 56.25% → 98.75%, while the same residual RL in the raw action space fails.

title: Optimal Transport Q-Learning for Flow Policy Steering and Acceleration (OTQL)
org: University of Edinburgh; Honda Research Institute Europe
one_line: Advantage-weighted optimal-transport pairing in flow matching; OGBench 0.59 at 2 function evaluations vs QAM 0.55, real single-task 36% → 86%.

title: Leveraging Offline Supervision for Efficient and Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Large-Scale Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: PPO plus an annealed KL to a frozen SFT policy. At 1M steps it matches plain PPO at 2M (IND 0.93, OOD 0.77) and beats SFT warm-start and a BC loss.

title: SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing
one_line: Trains PPO from scratch in sim on a capsule-chain cable for single-clip routing, then deploys through a 10 Hz twin whose sim joint angles become real targets. Real 3-clip routing, zero demos: 18/24 vs 12/24 copied from the hierarchical-IL paper.

title: VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models
one_line: GRPO trains a Qwen3.5-9B instruction rewriter around frozen pi0/OpenVLA, once per episode. VL-Think success: pi0 12.6% to 38.7%; OpenVLA with the grounder 63.9% versus GEPA’s 55.2%.

title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
one_line: Small TD3 adapter on a frozen world-action model reads its latents and proposed chunk; real average 26.4% → 87.1%.

title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
one_line: GelSight tactile SAC residual with a scheduled scale (0.05 → 0.15) on a frozen visual policy. Real base 40/10/5/5% → 100/100/90/85% after 40-80 min, including a 12-minute warm-start.

title: Look Before You Leap: Distilling Tree Search into Action Evaluation for Frozen VLA Models (SVA: Search, Value, and Act)
one_line: Distills simulator MCTS returns into a Q-model selecting candidates from a frozen VLA. Across five backbones, EmbodiedBench simulation success improves by 15.4 points on EB-Habitat and 13.2 on EB-Navigation over the base policies.

title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector for Scalable Robot Policy Post-Training
one_line: Visuo-tactile world model imagines corrections at stalled states. Average task score 0.375 → 0.825 vs DreamGen 0.550.

title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
one_line: DINOv2-space world model plus progress critic picks among pi0 samples and fixed motion primitives. Real OOD objects 23.75% → 66.25% (42.50% with policy samples only).

title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
one_line: Training-free plug-in for chunked VLAs: a latent-space vision monitor detects drift mid-chunk, truncates execution, and replans with online gradient guidance, giving an event-triggered adaptive action horizon.

title: Rank-Then-Act: Reward-Free Control from Frame-Order Progress
one_line: A GRPO-trained VLM ranks shuffled frames and the reward is rank agreement; games and sim only (Catrap L2 1.00 vs GVL 0.47).

title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
one_line: Benchmark (WMBench) and roadmap for world-model policy evaluators: 324k world-model rollout segments chained into human-scored episodes. Long-horizon action faithfulness and memory matter; background and photometric consistency correlate negatively with human scores.

title: WorldSample: Closed-loop Real-robot RL with World Modelling
org: Nanyang Technological University; Tsinghua University; Central South University; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
one_line: Adds a Dyna-like stream to real-robot SAC/RLPD: jittered actions are rendered by a post-trained Cosmos-Predict2.5 model, reward-labeled, and gated into the critic loss. Real robot, 5 tasks: 82% in 64 min vs HIL-SERL 56% in 83 min.

title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning (AutoSERL)
org: Institute of Automation, CAS; PKU-PsiBot Joint Lab; Peking University
one_line: Replaces HIL-SERL's human interventions with one-demo rules: a planner corrects drift beyond 2 cm; stalls trigger partial demo replay. Real, no start randomization: 50/50 on all 6 tasks in 8-45 min; SERL (20 demos, same time): 0-20/50.

title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
one_line: IQL critic on 100 logged rollouts of a frozen SmolVLA guides the flow sampler. Real bottle-to-box 19/40 → 34/40; no other baselines.

title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
one_line: Converts Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a causal, KV-cached, 4-step autoregressive video model on DROID, trained with Step Forcing to limit drift, and scores rollouts with GPT-4o. Across 8 VLAs (4,186 rollouts): Pearson r = 0.989 with the real RoboArena leaderboard.

title: FAR: Failure-Aware Retry for Test-Time Recovery and Continual Policy Improvement
one_line: Failure-Aware Retry uses a value function to locate problematic action chunks, applies preference-based policy updates between attempts, and adds lightweight action perturbations during retries to avoid repeating failures.

title: ACT-2 Preview: Generalizing Reliability (Sunday Robotics blog)
one_line: Pretrains ACT-2 on sensorized human data from Sunday's own capture hardware, then post-trains on repeated in-house Memo runs and recoveries (update rule undisclosed). Laundry: 99.1% over 785 autonomous attempts in unseen homes, one fixed checkpoint, zero per-home adaptation.

title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: STDR learns visual dense rewards from expert videos: stage-transition plus within-stage progress signals, with OOD detection and grasp regulation; beats LIV/VIP on all 14 sim manipulation tasks and matches or beats handcrafted dense rewards on several.

title: ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies
one_line: SAC allocates denoising steps and samples per state. Real pi0.5 matches Best-of-10 with 34% lower latency; a fixed schedule derived from its learned allocation also matches, while adaptation wins at a smaller budget.

title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: GRPO on pi0.5 where each group branches from one cloned approach-phase state, so credit lands on the manipulation phase. RoboCasa 24 tasks 67.4 → 80.6. TurnOnSinkFaucet 29.2 → 98.4.

title: Trust Your Instincts: Confidence-Driven Test-Time RL for Vision-Language-Action Models (T^2VLA)
one_line: GRPO uses DTW similarity to the policy’s most-confident rollouts as reward, without success labels. Simulated LIBERO: OpenVLA-OFT 91.0% to 97.2%; oracle-reward SimpleVLA-RL reference 99.1%.

title: STEAM: Self-Supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling for Real-World Robot Learning
org: Institute of Automation, CAS; Tsinghua University; UCAS
one_line: An ensemble of small VLMs predicts time offsets between expert frame pairs (forward and reversed); the ensemble minimum gives per-frame advantages for CFGRL training of pi0. Real towel folding: 92.3% vs one-iteration RECAP-style baseline 55.6%, BC 33.3% (trials unstated).

title: Behavior Uncloning: Distilling Mode Redirection into Policy Weights without Inference-Time Steering (MoRE)
one_line: A temporary mode classifier guides policy-weight edits with a retain loss. Simulated Push-T desired-mode success averages 50.0% before versus 98.3% after MoRE; the original policy already completes the task in either mode.

title: ReGuide: From Test-Time Guidance to Self-Improving Diffusion Policies
one_line: Phase-gated latent-dynamics guidance at test time, with the successes distilled back through filtered BC. Tool Hang 0.0312 → 0.2404 after two iterations (sim).

title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
one_line: Reconstructs video-to-sim digital twins and affordance-preserving object, scene and task variants for policy training. Across seven manipulation tasks and five policies, simulated evaluations correlate with real performance (mean Pearson 0.911).

title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation
one_line: Self-supervised relative-progress reward model trained on time-warped (speed-varied, reversed) demos; used to filter/reweight BC action chunks, giving up to ~18x successful T-shirt-folding throughput over vanilla BC on a real bimanual robot.

title: World Action Models Enable Continual Imitation Learning with Recurrent Generative Replays
one_line: REGEN: a world action model generates synthetic replay trajectories from instructions and observations, cutting catastrophic forgetting up to 50% vs sequential fine-tuning without storing demos.

title: KinetIQ Ascend: Towards 100% Manipulation Reliability and Superhuman Speed
one_line: Real-world PPO on a flow-matching VLA (ODE-to-SDE exploration noise, sparse success reward, speed curriculum), with gains measured against a concurrent frozen-policy A/B baseline. Tote handling 77.6%→98.9%, bottle picking 80%→98%, throughput +42% to +129% in 3-5 robot-days.

title: Support-Constrained RL Enables Real-World Policy Improvement without Real-World Experience (SCORE: Support-Constrained Off-Domain REinforcement)
one_line: Freezes a real-demo flow policy; in a scanned sim twin, PPO learns to steer its input noise plus a small residual, staying near the base's action support. Real Franka/LEAP, 8 tasks, no real-world RL: 37.8% → 89.9% vs Residual-RL 59.5%.

title: E-TTS: A New Embodied Test-Time Scaling Framework for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Joint sampling of reasoning traces and actions scored by reasoning and action verifiers, with critique-and-resample. Real MolmoAct 22.13% → 48.75%; sim E-CoT 6.67 → 39.81 vs naive best-of-N 23.61.

title: Learning to Fold: prizewinning solution at LeHome Challenge 2026 (1st place online, 2nd offline)
one_line: AWR sampling, RECAP conditioning and CFG improve a simulated bimanual SO-ARM101 policy that also predicts value: 79.63%, first of 62 teams. The second-place real final instead uses plain BC.

title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
one_line: Two-stage RL for multi-fingered hands: task-agnostic play pretraining on diverse objects, then sparse-reward assembly fine-tuning; 33x more sample-efficient than RL from scratch (even with dense rewards); zero-shot real 60% (6/10) on 0.5 mm-clearance insertions.

title: RMTL: Reinforced Micro-task Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation with VLM Rewards
one_line: Splits long-horizon tasks into language-described micro-tasks, computing multi-view VLM rewards per active micro-task with hierarchical RL and reverse curriculum; faster learning than single-prompt VLM rewards on Fetch.

title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Replaces PPO's policy loss with distillation to a closed-form, token-level advantage-tilted teacher. OOD 69+/-4 → 73+/-4 vs PPO, but not better on every ID cell, and 40.8 h vs 25.4 h compute.

title: FORCE: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Fine-Tuning via Value-Calibrated Warm-up and Self-Distillation
one_line: ConRFT-style Cal-QL + consistency-policy recipe without human interventions, adding an on-policy value-calibration warm-up and value-filtered self-distillation; ManiSkill 6-task sim average FORCE (Octo) 82.3% vs ConRFT without human intervention 71.1%.

title: Beyond Monotonic Progress: Retry-Supervised Value Learning for Robot Imitation
one_line: ReTVL treats retry events in imperfect demos as supervision, combining global progress calibration with local pairwise preferences to learn a non-monotonic value model that reweights demonstration segments for BC.

title: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
short: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: World Value Model: uses a world model rather than a VLM for value estimation; SOTA Value-Order Correlation, adds Suboptimal-Value-Bench (800 annotated suboptimal trajectories), improves sim and real policy learning.

title: Enabling Robust Cloth Manipulation via Inference-Time Simulator-in-the-Loop Refinement
one_line: Real-to-sim cloth mesh estimate plus MPPI in a GPU cloth simulator around the base plan. Real single-arm fold 3/10 → 9/10, dual-arm 1/10 → 8/10.

title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: RL fine-tuning for discrete-diffusion VLAs: treats denoising as an MDP and optimizes the sampled path's joint probability; 99.7% on LIBERO, and 61.4% → 92.0% over its SFT backbone on eight RoboTwin 2.0 tasks.

title: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
one_line: Trains a classifier on the policy's own successful vs failed rollouts and adds its clipped log-odds to the sparse success reward. Real WidowX with DSRL, Pick and Place: about 0.93 vs about 0.2 for outcome-only RL (plot reading).

title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
one_line: SAC residual plus SpaceMouse interventions on frozen Diffusion Policy or pi0.5. Bases at 50-80% rise to over 90% within 40-90 min of real training.

title: PolicyTrim: Boosting Intrinsic Policy Efficiency of Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: PolicyTrim uses RL to improve action-chunk execution efficiency. For pi0.5 on LIBERO-Object, physical steps fall to 51.4% of baseline (48.6% fewer); the paper reports up to 5.83x end-to-end speedup.

title: FlowDPG: Deterministic Policy Gradient on Flow Matching Policies for Real-World Manipulation
org: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Pennsylvania, Skild AI
one_line: Predicts the clean action from a noisy flow point, nudges it along the critic's gradient, and regresses velocity toward it alongside BC, without ODE backprop. Real dual-arm AirPods assembly: 88% offline vs 80% for RLT/QAM (BC 64%).

title: RARM: Confidence-Gated Progress Reward Modeling for RL in Manipulation
org: National University of Singapore, Booking.com, University of Cambridge, Nanjing University
one_line: A comparator trained on non-robot videos (DAVIS, MOSE) matches rollout clips to one successful demo, rewarding only confident forward progress. Real pi0 with DSRL, cloth folding after 90 rollouts: 25/30 vs binary reward 7/30, Robometer 9/30.

title: Robot Self-Improvement via Human-Video Dynamics Models
org: ETH Zurich; TU Munich; Microsoft; MCML
one_line: Human-video dynamics plus value models relabel failed states with better actions. Stretch average 85.3% vs RISE 76.0%; pi0.5 62.7 → 88.0.

title: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
short: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
one_line: Fine-tunes a Qwen2.5-VL pairwise progress critic from policy success/failure rollouts (binary labels) to pick among video-model-predicted outcomes of sampled actions. Real diffusion policy: Stacking 23/50 → 32/50, Push-Bowl mIoU 0.140 → 0.321.

title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
one_line: TSIL mines fast successful RL trajectories into adaptive temporal targets and efficiency-weighted self-imitation, improving success, speed and robustness on 30 long-horizon manipulation and navigation tasks.

title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
short: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
one_line: Agentic Qwen3.5 reward that checks planning, visual quality, instruction following, physics and task completion, plus DynDiff-GRPO rollout diversification, for RL post-training of robot video world models; PAI-Bench robot Domain score +0.80 (Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B), +3.08 (Kairos-3.0-Robot).

title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
org: NVIDIA, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley
one_line: Coding agents edit training recipes, train, run real rollouts scored automatically, and keep what raises success. Pin insertion: 8 agent/robot pairs reached near-perfect success in about 40 min vs over 1.5 h with one (success counts up to 8 retries).

title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
one_line: Video-model policy evaluator enforcing forward-inverse dynamics, cross-view and test-time consistency; 0.929 closed-loop Pearson and 0.119 MMRV across seven real-world VLA policies.

title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
one_line: 4D wrist-view surfel-indexed memory for action-conditioned world models; +14.5% Pearson correlation with real performance over Ctrl-World, and synthetic data lifts long-horizon success 58% to 72%.

title: DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning
one_line: Explores diffusion-policy candidates with critic min-value plus disagreement: three policy samples and one base sample, with ten critics (DSRL normally uses two). Reports sample-efficiency gains on simulated RoboMimic and OpenAI Gym tasks.

title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
one_line: TD3 residual on 6-DoF object poses, proprioception and the base action, trained only in a simple MuJoCo scene (measured primitives) against a paired 'sim VLA'. Real GR00T-N1.5 five-task average goes from 42% to 76% with zero real-world RL.

title: Reversal Q-Learning
one_line: Offline RL for flow policies: treats each flow refinement step as an MDP action, using flow reversal for synthetic on-policy trajectories; no backprop through time; tops flow baselines on 50 simulated robot tasks.

title: Recover, Discover, Plan: Learning Skills and Concepts from Robot Failures
one_line: ReSYNC learns RL recovery skills and discovers relational predicates from them to refine an abstract planner; outperforms evaluated baselines on unseen long-horizon tasks across four simulation domains, with a real-robot sim-to-real demonstration.

title: WAM-RL: World-Action Model Reinforcement Learning with Reconstruction Rewards and Online Video SFT
one_line: Online RL for world-action models that jointly optimizes world and action branches via environment interaction; actor-only tuning helps short-horizon tasks, joint optimization is needed for long-horizon gains.

title: Visual Verification Enables Inference-time Steering and Autonomous Policy Improvement (VERITAS)
one_line: Gradient-free verifier scores sampled π0 action chunks by distance to a Gemini-drawn 2D end-effector trace; verified successes are distilled back by BC. Reported average steering gains: 12.6% sim, 35% real; BC fine-tuning +9.7% over π0-Bridge in sim.

title: Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller (SteerGenPO)
one_line: Replaces stochastic latent sampling of a trained generative RL policy with a learned state-dependent latent actor for deterministic deployment; beats baselines on six Isaac Lab tasks plus Unitree G1 locomotion.

title: Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes (HABC: Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning)
one_line: Viability and efficiency critic heads turn episode success bits into per-transition flow-matching weights. At equal budget, SFT 36/44/12% → 60/78/22%.

title: SafeDojo: Safe Reinforcement Learning for VLA via Interactive World Model
org: Peking University; Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics; NTU; HKUST; UESTC
one_line: Lagrangian-constrained GRPO inside a Wan 2.2-based video world model, with a learned per-step safety-cost head. Real Franka (5 tasks, 10 trials each): safe-success 70% vs 36% for the best baseline (SafeVLA), 22% for WoVR.

title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Splits each human intervention into autonomous rollout, human adaptation and human recovery, placing the failure penalty after adaptation; an optimistic expectile critic drives RECAP-style conditioning. Iteration 1, same robot data, Erase/Bread: 60.0%/73.3% vs RECAP 50.0%/66.7%.

title: Cargo Cults, Data Flywheels, and Novelty Pumps
short: Cargo Cults, Data Flywheels, and Novelty Pumps
one_line: Essay: more robots repeating the same tasks yield redundant data; real improvement needs a labor-intensive "novelty pump" of ops teams seeking new states and tasks, not an automatic flywheel.

title: Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch (ViTaL)
one_line: Vision picks the mode (latent world model plus VLM reward), then tactile-reward-guided diffusion editing refines contact. Real, visual base policy (appendix): wiping 30 → 90%, pipette 30 → 75%, insertion 40 → 80%.

title: EV-WM: Event-Verified World Models for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Decodes imagined futures from a pretrained-feature world model into predicate-level event states and scores task progress, semantic consistency, physical feasibility and uncertainty to guide CEM planning. PointMaze random-target success 0.90 → 0.94 (simulation only).

title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Multi-view flow-matching world model predicting future latents and rewards: 0.870 correlation with real success for policy evaluation, +38% real success over a foundation policy, +14% from 5-10x faster test-time planning.

title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering (FRS)
one_line: Flow-reverses coarse human or VLM hints into noise for a frozen pi0.5, then trains a noise-space BC/RL policy. Real DROID ~20% → ~87% zero-shot with human steering. Towel hanging 5% → 50% → 80% after RL.

title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
short: Learning What to Say to Your VLA
one_line: Searches for language instructions that raise a frozen VLA's closed-loop success, distills them into a language feedback policy, and uses a conformalized improvement head to refuse harmful steering; tested with pi0.5 on LIBERO-OOD and a real Franka.

title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
org: UCLA, UC San Diego, Peking University, University of Utah, UESTC
one_line: Adds contact-gated tactile tokens to a pi0.5-style VLA, co-trains on real plus sim demos, then runs sim PPO with a real-data BC anchor. Real, 4 bimanual tasks after sim RL: 72.5% visuo-tactile vs 50.0% vision-only.

title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
org: Nanyang Technological University; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
one_line: Adds an intervention agent to HIL-SERL: a VLM-based proxy value model and a temporal value-risk critic detect stagnation, then steer back to a remembered high-value state. 5 real UR7e tasks: HIL-SERL 81% success at 34.3% intervention → 88% at 14.6%.

title: VeriSpace: Spatially Grounded Action Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: 3D-aware 7B verifier over k=8 VLA samples. SimplerEnv OpenVLA 37.0 → 55.0 vs RoboMonkey 40.5, V-GPS 36.0, MG-Select 39.0.

title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Classifies the active action primitive to gate a mixture-of-experts value head regressing normalized remaining steps, used as reward for a residual TD3+BC policy on frozen pi0.5. Real, Round 3 Whiteboard: 18/20 vs fine-tuned Robometer 13/20, sparse 11/20.

title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning (QGF, Q-Guided Flow)
one_line: Freezes a BC flow policy and IQL critic; each flow step adds grad Q, evaluated at a one-step estimate of the finished action, to the velocity. OGBench sim, charts only: beats all tested test-time methods, slightly edges EDP.

title: ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies
one_line: Frozen VLA plus residual recovery policies trained in sim with VLM-selected structured reward masks; sim success 36.7% (fine-tuned pi0.5) to 66.7%, 61.7% zero-shot sim-to-real.

title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Training-free runtime loop: feature probe for 3D object positions, kinematic failure state machine, and CBF action filter; lifts OpenVLA-OFT from 69.6% to 74.1% on LIBERO-plus.

title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
one_line: One RECAP round with a continuous sigmoid optimality indicator on a dexterous diffusion policy. Average 50.0 BC / 75.3 HG-DAgger / 80.0 RECAP / 87.3% (50 trials per task).

title: TORL-VLA: Tactile Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
one_line: Frozen wrench-aware pi0.5 plus small per-contact-phase actor-critics; full-task 12/30 (pi0.5) and 21/30 (reference) → 28/30.

title: ActProbe: Action-Space Probe for Early Failure Detection of Generative Robot Policies
one_line: Black-box failure detector using temporal consistency error between action chunks and chunk magnitude; +12.7% hypervolume, +9.0% early-detection ROC-AUC on unseen tasks, 2.9x fewer RL fine-tuning interactions.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Matching Policies with Density Transport
short: Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Matching Policies with Density Transport
one_line: RLDT fine-tunes flow policies toward an SVGD transport field from a maximum-entropy RL objective without backpropagation through time. Evaluated in simulation on Gym, state-based Furniture-Bench and vision-based Robomimic.

title: Video2Sim2Real: Full-Stack Autonomous Dexterous Skill Acquisition from a Single Human Video
org: Georgia Institute of Technology, University of Pennsylvania, Toyota Research Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
one_line: Builds a sim twin from one RGB-D human video, re-optimizes robot poses at object-motion keyframes, distills them into a point-cloud policy, adds a PPO finger residual. Real, 7 tasks, no robot demos: 67/70 (95.7%) vs 11/70 with FoundationPose poses.

title: Q-VGM: Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching for Offline-to-Online RL of Flow-Matching VLA Policies
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; University of Michigan
one_line: Value-gradient matching at late pi0.5 denoising steps avoids BPTT; LIBERO few-shot-SFT mean 84.6% becomes 90.7% offline and 98.4% after online training.

title: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
short: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
one_line: Probabilistic elite membership (PEM) replaces hard ES rank weights with expected weights under ranking uncertainty. Residual-bootstrap RB-PEM improves COCO bbob-noisy, policy-search and hyperparameter-optimization results in tested noisy, fixed-budget settings.

title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement (ForesightFlow)
one_line: The VLA generates a success-potential channel used both as the AWR baseline and for best-of-K selection. Real average 35.4% vs IDQL 32.6% vs filtered BC 24.6%.

title: FlowPRO: Reward-Free Reinforced Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching VLAs via Proximalized Preference Optimization
org: Tencent Robotics X; Futian Laboratory; Tsinghua University
one_line: Operators roll back and teleoperate fixes, giving paired failed/corrected segments for a critic-free DPO-style flow-matching loss with proximal and SFT terms. Real Pack, pi0 base, 3 rounds: 99% vs 94% for a RECAP-style advantage-conditioning baseline, DAgger 88%.

title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Reward-free test-time latent-prompt tuning uses a state-grounding proxy loss. SimplerEnv WidowX: base pi0.5 51.1%, retrained latent-prompt policy 63.5%, then test-time tuning 67.4% (simulation).

title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation (PACT: Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training)
one_line: Treats each human takeover as a preference to deflate credit for pre-takeover actions; average 58.0 → 82.5 vs HIL-SERL on 5 real tasks.

title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections (SDP)
one_line: Uses the robot's rejected chunk to build a 'desired set' around the correction; robust to noisy corrections (noisy Square 0.946 vs DP 0.683).

title: Coherent Off-Policy Improvement of Large Behavior Models with Learned Rewards (CSIL++)
one_line: Dense coherent reward from a small BC policy avoids the fine-tuning dip on a frozen pi0.5; Threading 0.14 → 0.92 in sim, Nut Assembly no gain.

title: τ0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Unified video-action predictor plus action-conditioned simulator that scores candidate actions by task progress; trained on ~27,300 hours of teleop, UMI, egocentric human video and rollout/failure data.

title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies (LP-DS)
one_line: Learns residual noise perturbations for a frozen diffusion policy using a Lagrangian trust region to limit prior deviation. Walker2D return: approximately 5000 versus 4000 for the strongest compared baseline.

title: FLAG: Flow Policy MaxEnt-RL by Latent Augmented Guidance
one_line: MaxEnt RL for flow policies: augments the state with a flow latent to localize importance sampling, mitigating weight collapse via a provably consistent proxy objective; scales to high-dimensional control (DMC, MyoSuite, MuJoCo).

title: Feat2Go: Visual Feature-Grounded Value Estimation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Value model trained on progress targets from world-model patch similarity to subgoals reshapes terminal rewards for PPO/GRPO VLA fine-tuning; ManiSkill3 (sim) average OOD success 82.9% vs 76.8% for OpenVLA-OFT with plain PPO and 17.5% after SFT.

title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
one_line: Noise-space RL adapts GR00T N1.6 for suspended-load pushing. Sim placement error: 22.44cm to 2.54cm after 20 rollouts, 6.25cm after 30. Real error: 9.28cm to 6.38cm; yaw worsens from 14.5° to 28.9°.

title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
one_line: Optimizes diffusion-world-model noise toward plausible VLM-specified failures. Failure recall rises 54% to 94%; using steered failures to downweight demonstrations raises real pi0.5 success from 39% with uniform-weight fine-tuning to 71%.

title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
one_line: HIL-SERL-style vision teacher distilled into a vision-free student via real RL; 95.0% overall vs residual RL 85.7% in about 50 min.

title: Sample-Efficient Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning with Critic Guidance (CGPO: Critic-Guided diffusion Policy Optimization)
one_line: Critic-guided diffusion sampling distilled back with advantage-weighted denoising; best on 5/5 MuJoCo tasks.

title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
org: SJTU, CASIA, Shanghai AI Lab, USTC
one_line: Offline IQL-style chunk critic on a consistency-head dexterous VLA, then a small online residual; real average 53.0% → 86.0%.

title: SPAR: Support-Preserving Action Rectification
one_line: Offline policy improvement as local residual rectification on a frozen BC policy; Latent Self-Imitation (latent weighted regression) avoids manifold-normal drift of value gradients; SOTA on D4RL.

title: ProgVLA: Progress-Aware Robot Manipulation Skill Learning
one_line: Compact 0.1B VLA with two-stage Perceiver resampling and jointly trained progress heads (offline-RL critics over normalized remaining-horizon targets) that weight flow-matching imitation; beats imported larger-baseline scores on LIBERO and Meta-World; progress weighting adds 2.3 points on LIBERO.

title: How VLAs Fail Differently: Black-Box Action Monitoring Reveals Architecture-Specific Failure Signatures
one_line: 450 PushT/ALOHA episodes across VQ-BeT, Diffusion Policy, ACT: action direction reversals predict failure (AUROC 0.79-0.93), velocity violations barely do; training-free SafeContract monitor with conformal calibration.

title: VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction
one_line: MC-dropout uncertainty picks 2 s failure clips from Isaac Lab rollouts for VR correction; success comparable to unguided HITL review at about 40% less collection time per sample, up to +23 pp over BC (sim).

title: Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization
one_line: Replaces MPPI search with diffusion policy optimization anchored by an implicit energy/KL term. Competitive or better online across 121 simulated tasks; offline scaling generally helps, but both methods decline at 340M parameters on the 30-task dataset.

title: A Factory-Floor Deployment Case Study of VLA Pipelines for Industrial Packaging Task: Workflow, Failures, and Lessons
one_line: Runs a pure-SFT loop on pi0.5 in a real Siemens factory: teleop demos, manual review, re-fine-tuning, and targeted recovery demos, relaxing constraints each round. 2,535 factory episodes; no final success rate given; authors say it fell short of expectations.

title: TapSampling: Inference-Time Sampling with a Task-Progress-Understanding Verifier for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Action-VAE posterior turns a policy's actions into extra latent candidates; a task-progress verifier drops low scorers and score-weights the rest. CALVIN ABC→D avg length DP 2.41 → 2.58, OpenVLA 3.30 → 3.51; real π0 78.3% → 83.3%.

title: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Samples 8 pi0.5 chunks, adds a tanh-bounded learned edit to each, runs the argmax-Q of 16; the VLA keeps training on its supervised loss, with human interventions. Real, 8 tasks: SFT 20.5/30 → 30/30 each, 19.1 min average (HG-DAgger 22.1/30).

title: Bridging the Gap: Enabling Soft Actor Critic for High Performance Legged Locomotion
one_line: Policy initialization, timeout-aware critic targets and multi-step returns let SAC match PPO’s performance in parallel legged-locomotion simulation, with slower wall-clock training. Real-robot fine-tuning remains future work.

title: From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models
one_line: Demo2Reward optimizes a frozen VLM reward model’s prompt using 3–10 demonstrations to reduce false positives. Evaluated in simulated policy learning and one real Franka Panda Lid-On-Pot task, without extra model training.

title: PAPO-VLA: Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Treats a VLA as planner plus executor: identifies planning actions via action variation and trajectory outcome, weights them by causal sufficiency/necessity, and injects weights into GRPO advantage estimation.

title: Beyond Action Residuals: Real-World Robot Policy Steering via Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning (ZPRL, Z-Perturbation RL)
one_line: SAC perturbs a small variational-bottleneck latent inside a frozen flow policy rather than its actions. Real tasks gain 33.7% on average over the IL base (Insert Bills 20% → 77.5%), with about 28.5 h of real RL in total.

title: DyGRO-VLA: Cross-Task Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Grouped Residual Optimization
one_line: Learns shared multi-task VLA representations, then applies dynamically routed residual RL experts. Evaluated on LIBERO and RoboTwin2; sim-to-real tests on four tasks show mixed gains and limited real-world coverage.

title: Contrastive Conceptor Activation Steering (COAST): Unlocking Vision-Language-Action Models through Hidden States
one_line: Training-free steering of a frozen policy's action-expert activations with contrastive conceptors fit from about 15 success/failure rollouts per task. Mean success up over 20 points in sim (partly early, under-trained checkpoints) and 40 points on 3 real tasks.

title: OHP-RL: Online Human Preference as Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation
one_line: Uses human takeovers as pairwise preferences in SAC with a critic-based intervention gate. Real Franka Move Sand Bag success: 68% versus SILRI 66% and HIL-SERL 16%.

title: Hand-in-the-Loop: Improving VLA Policies for Dexterous Manipulation via Seamless Hand-Arm Intervention (HandITL)
one_line: Shared hand-arm corrections for a 56-DoF bimanual VLA with two 21-DoF hands; one hour of Copilot-mode correction data raises mean normalized subgoal score from about 0.70 to 0.95 across three real tasks.

title: RoboEvolve: Co-Evolving Planner-Simulator for Robotic Manipulation with Limited Data
one_line: VLM planner and video simulator co-evolve via GRPO exploration and near-miss preference mining. Planner gains 36.4/24.6 points over base Qwen3-VL on EB-ALFRED/EB-Habitat; simulator gains ~48% relative Gemini-judged task success on BridgeData V2.

title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Distributed async RL system for large VLAs: decouples data and weight traffic, four-thread swimlane pipeline, dual-pool VRAM management; higher throughput than RLinf and RL-VLA3 for pi0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT in ManiSkill (16 GPUs).

title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
one_line: Test-time framework for VLAs: a trigger detects critical phases, a proposer samples alternative action chunks, and an evaluator trained on success/failure/boundary data dreams futures to pick one; four real tasks average 72.5% vs 48.8% for base π0.5.

title: Think Twice, Act Once: Verifier-Guided Action Selection For Embodied Agents
one_line: VeGAS: MLLM embodied agent samples multiple candidate actions and a verifier trained on LLM-synthesized failure cases picks one; up to 36% relative gain over CoT baselines on Habitat and ALFRED.

title: Discrete Flow Matching for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
short: Discrete Flow Matching for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
one_line: DRIFT: fine-tunes an offline-pretrained CTMC policy online with advantage-weighted discrete flow matching, a path-space penalty and candidate-set approximation; best on Jericho text games, not robotics.

title: Behavioral Mode Discovery for Fine-tuning Multimodal Generative Policies
one_line: A noise-steering policy on a frozen diffusion policy, conditioned on a per-episode code, learns distinct modes via a DIAYN-style classifier reward, kept as an RL fine-tuning bonus. ManiSkill sim Avoid, success ~1.00: DSRL keeps 2/24 modes, DPPO 6.33/24, DSRL[BMD] 10/24.

title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models (RAW-Dream)
one_line: A task-agnostic world model and zero-shot VLM rewards refine a policy initialized with one-shot SFT. LIBERO success: 43.4% to 52.3% without target-task world-model training; real Piper few-shot SFT: 50.0% to 71.7%.

title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
one_line: Context-smoothed pretraining plus a learned noise-level dial lets steering leave the base's narrow support. Real widowx-sausage reaches 1.0 at about 50 episodes while DSRL stays at 0 (RSS 2026).

title: Reinforce Adjoint Matching: Scaling RL Post-Training of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Models (adjacent)
one_line: RAM: reward-corrected pretraining target with a consistency loss, no SDE rollouts or backward adjoint sweeps; matches Flow-GRPO peak reward on SD3.5-M in up to 50x fewer steps. Image generation only.

title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking
one_line: Self-supervised action-ranking losses replace CQL-style pessimism; antmaze-large-play 91.2% vs Cal-QL 67.7%, plus pi0 VLA experiments in sim.

title: Adaptive Action Chunking via Multi-Chunk Q Value Estimation (ACH)
one_line: Causal-transformer critic scores every chunk prefix so the chunk length is picked per state; puzzle-4x4 13 → 90 vs QC 11 → 38.

title: Retrieve-then-Steer: Online Success Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of Generative VLAs
org: Xi'an Jiaotong University; One Robotics; Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology
one_line: Stores progress-calibrated successful segments during deployment, retrieves and consistency-filters them into an elite action prior, and injects it into a frozen VLA's action sampler with confidence-adaptive strength. LIBERO-10: pi0.5 92.4% → 94.4%, pi0 81.6% → 84.4%; no weight updates.

title: UniSteer: Unified Noise Steering for Efficient Human-Guided VLA Adaptation
org: Microsoft Research; Tsinghua University; University of Technology Sydney
one_line: Trains a SAC-style noise actor for frozen pi0, inverting the flow decoder by fixed-point iteration so human teleop corrections become noise-space targets. Real AgileX Piper, 4 tasks: average success 20% → 90% (~66 min training) vs DSRL 55%, DAgger 60%.

title: ProcVLM: Learning Procedure-Grounded Progress Rewards for Robotic Manipulation
