one_line: Procedure-grounded progress labels train a 2B reward VLM. Real stack-bowls soft success with SFT versus reward fine-tuning: 37.5%/62.5% at 5k steps, 70.8%/83.3% at 10k (12 rollouts per evaluation).

title: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models
short: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models
one_line: Diagnoses action-state consistency in World Action Models and uses a value-free consensus over sampled futures for test-time selection; improves RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 without extra training or reward models.

title: Failing Forward: Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: A failure action head sharing the VLA backbone gives adaptive CFG-style negative guidance during sampling. LIBERO average pi0.5 96.9% → 98.4% (sim only).

title: Sword: Style-Robust World Models as Simulators via Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping for VLA Policy Post-Training
one_line: Style augmentation plus latent scheduled sampling make the world-model simulator robust (Mixed FVD 111.19 vs 198.84 for WoVR). RL success is measured only inside the world model.

title: Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
short: Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: ME-AM adds mirror-descent entropy maximization and a mixture behavior prior to adjoint-matching flow-policy Q-learning, countering popularity bias; competitive or superior on sparse-reward continuous control.

title: Adaptive Q-Chunking for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (AQC)
org: Peking University; Galbot; University of Toronto
one_line: Trains critics for several chunk lengths and picks each state's chunk size by discount-normalized advantage over a per-horizon baseline; OGBench 25-task offline→online success 62→96% vs QC 52→86%.

title: When Life Gives You BC, Make Q-functions: Extracting Q-values from Behavior Cloning for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning (Q2RL: Q-Estimation and Q-Gating from BC for RL)
one_line: Reads a Q-function out of BC log-probabilities plus MC values and gates BC vs SAC actions; real peg insertion 0.70 → 1.00, pipe assembly 0.20 → 0.75.

title: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
one_line: Off-policy TD critics provide terminal rewards for group-sampled PPO over denoising chains, without GRPO’s variance normalization. On simulated Robomimic Square/Transport, DPPO takes about ten times longer to reach OGPO+’s final success.

title: VLA-ATTC: Adaptive Test-Time Compute for VLA Models with Relative Action Critic Model
org: University of Sydney; Central South University; USTC; SenseTime Research; HKUST
one_line: Samples two chunks; when their DTW distance exceeds a threshold, samples 16 and picks one by knockout tournament under a relative action critic trained on auto-generated preference pairs. LIBERO-LONG, 50 trials/task: pi0 82.8% → 90.6% gated (92.2% ungated); RoboMonkey 56.5%.

title: Learning While Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
org: AGIBOT Finch; Shanghai Innovation Institute; Columbia University
one_line: A 16-robot fleet logs rollouts and takeovers with sparse rewards; off-policy RL bootstraps the critic from an uncertainty-adaptive quantile of a distributional value model, with QAM policy extraction. 8 real tasks, mixed success/stage score: 0.95 vs SFT 0.76, RECAP 0.85.

title: What 10 Months in Production Taught Us About the Robotics "Bubble"
short: What 10 Months in Production Taught Us About the Robotics "Bubble"
one_line: York Yang essay: pretraining alone is insufficient; capability matures through iterated post-training on deployment data. It says DYNA-1 shipped in April 2025 running 24h+ at 99%+ success on tasks like napkin folding; longest deployment ~10 months of daily use.

title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Robotic Manipulation via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning
one_line: LAPO jointly optimizes latent reasoning and actions with adaptive reasoning depth. LaST-R1 reports 99.9% average success on simulated LIBERO after one-shot warm-up and evaluates transfer across four real manipulation tasks.

title: Learning from the Best: Smoothness-Driven Metrics for Data Quality in Imitation Learning (RINSE: Ranking and INdexing Smooth Examples)
one_line: Smoothness scores retain top-ranked demonstrations. On simulated RoboMimic Transport mh, spectral arc length selects 50 of 300 demos for 55% success versus 39% with all 300; trajectory-envelope distance scores 46%.

title: dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model
one_line: Discrete-token masked-diffusion evaluator with failure data. Real AgileX r 0.918 / MMRV 0.02, with better action controllability than video evaluators.

title: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Compresses frozen pi0.6 embeddings into one 'RL token'; a tiny TD3-style actor-critic then edits the VLA's own sampled action chunk under an L2 penalty, only in each task's critical phase. Screw critical-phase success: 20% → 65%.

title: Hi-WM: Human-in-the-World-Model for Scalable Robot Post-Training
org: Current Robotics; Tsinghua University; Peking University; University of Toronto
one_line: A human corrects failure-prone policy rollouts inside a learned action-conditioned world model, with rollback and branching from cached states; the corrections post-train the policy. 3 real tasks, DP and pi0: +37.9 points over base, +19.0 over world-model self-training without humans.

title: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
one_line: A critic predicts, from the raw noise seed, the denoised action's Q-value, so only the best seed gets denoised. pi0.5 on 5 libero_90 tasks vs EXPO: inference FLOPs 37.55 TF → 4.70 TF, success comparable.

title: Fisher Decorator: Refining Flow Policy via a Local Transport Map
one_line: Offline RL: refines a flow policy via a residual local transport map with Fisher-information-weighted (anisotropic) regularization instead of isotropic L2; provable error bound, SOTA on offline RL benchmarks.

title: OmniVLA-RL: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Spatial Understanding and Online RL
one_line: Mix-of-Transformers VLA (reasoning, spatial, action experts) with Flow-GSPO: flow matching recast as an SDE and trained with GSPO (Group Sequence Policy Optimization) on action chunks; evaluated on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus.

title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning
one_line: Training-free runtime safeguard for a frozen ACT policy: a chunk-consistency failure detector (TIDE, conformal threshold) triggers a respawn to the latest VLM-verified checkpoint state. Real 6-task average: 66.7 → 80.0% unperturbed, 18.3 → 76.7% under adversarial perturbation.

title: Bessemer Predicts: Robotics and Physical AI
one_line: Investor prediction piece with founder quotes: going from 80% to 99.9% task success is not a linear problem and needs different approaches; data is expensive and capital is the moat; sim-to-real manipulation remains open.

title: ScoRe-Flow: Complete Distributional Control via Score-Based Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
org: Zhejiang U., SJTU, Shanghai Innovation Institute,…
one_line: Adds a closed-form score-function drift (computed from the velocity field, no extra network) plus learned noise variance to SDE-based flow-policy RL. Robomimic average success 92.5 vs ReinFlow-S 85.9 and DPPO 75.9; 2.4x faster convergence than ReinFlow on D4RL.

title: WM-DAgger: Enabling Efficient Data Aggregation for Imitation Learning with World Models
one_line: Not RL: a world model synthesizes detour-and-recover data in place of human DAgger. Bag pushing reaches 93.3% with 5 demos vs 26.7% for BC.

title: MoRI: Mixture of RL and IL Experts for Long-Horizon Manipulation Tasks
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
one_line: Gate picks a BC expert or a BC-anchored SAC expert per state; 4 real tasks average 97.5% vs BC 37.5% in 142-288 min.

title: ViVa: A Video-Generative Value Model for Robot Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Builds the RECAP value model from the Wan2.2 video generator, jointly predicting future proprioception and a return separating successes [0,1) from failures [1,2). Real, three tasks, two rounds: 80.0% average success vs 63.3% with a VLM value.

title: Going Beyond World Models & VLAs
one_line: Position post: goals matter more than VLA/world-model labels; GEN-1 has ~99% of parameters trained from scratch on 500k+ hours, targeting 99%+ success from about one hour of robot data.

title: Human-Robot Copilot for Data-Efficient Imitation Learning
one_line: Low-cost bidirectional leader arm for HG-DAgger clips; sim Nut Assembly 56 vs 46 total success at 40 trajectories.

title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation
one_line: Tri-state (+1/0/-1) relative-progress labels credit recovery; advantage-weighted BC folds towels at 99.4% vs 78.5% with SARM weights and 62.1% plain BC (trial count not reported; CVPR 2026 Workshops).

title: Building a 100-Robot Data Factory Toward Factory-Ready AI
short: Building a 100-Robot Data Factory Toward Factory-Ready AI
one_line: 100-robot Data Factory 1 trains the Ti0 VLA on teleop demos plus corrections of its own mistakes, then RL post-training from human-scored episodes; running one policy on 100 robots surfaces an 8-hour edge case in about 5 minutes.

title: GEN-1: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Mastery
one_line: Pretrained on 500K+ hours of human wearable-device data, adapted per task with about 1 hour of robot data; RL is one of five listed ingredients, not detailed. Three charted tasks: 99% average vs 64% for fine-tuned GEN-0 (whole-system comparison).

title: Generalizable Dense Reward for Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks (VLLR: Vision-Language Long-horizon Reward)
one_line: A VLM progress reward used briefly to warm-start the critic, then policy self-certainty as a bonus; PickUp 97.0% vs 91.8% for sparse-reward FLaRe (sim).

title: SOLE-R1: Video-Language Reasoning as the Sole Reward for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning
one_line: An 8B video-language model writes chain-of-thought at each timestep, then outputs progress in [-100, 100] as the only reward for off-policy RL from a random policy. 40 sim and real tasks: >=50% success on 24 vs 7 for GPT-5.

title: VLA-OPD: Bridging Offline SFT and Online RL for Vision-Language-Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
one_line: DAgger with a neural teacher: reverse-KL on-policy distillation from an RL-tuned VLA teacher; LIBERO avg of a 1-demo SFT student 48.9 to 87.4 (distill only), 93.4 with GRPO (teacher 93.9). Sim only.

title: Grounding Sim-to-Real Generalization in Robotic Manipulation: An Empirical Study with Vision-Language-Action Models
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
one_line: Controlled study of zero-shot sim-to-real for a VLA trained only in RoboTwin 2.0, isolating which randomization factors matter and adding binary-success GRPO in sim. Real average success: SFT 5.6% → SFT+RL 33.4% → SFT+RL+DR 42.8%.

title: PRM-as-a-Judge: A Dense Evaluation Paradigm for Fine-Grained Robotic Auditing
one_line: Replaces binary success with dense process-reward-model scoring of trajectory progress (OPD metrics), validated on the RoboPulse diagnostic benchmark and used to audit mainstream policies on long-horizon tasks.

title: StageCraft: Execution Aware Mitigation of Distractor and Obstruction Failures in VLA Models
one_line: A training-free VLM rearranges clutter and obstructions before a frozen VLA executes. Across three real task domains with pi0.5 and SmolVLA, average success improves by 40 percentage points versus the obstructed workspaces.

title: Towards Practical World Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
org: Nanjing University; Mila / Universite de Montreal
one_line: Fine-tunes Bagel on ~50 collected rollouts per task to predict multi-view frames 10 steps ahead plus task success, then runs PPO on short imagined branches from dataset states. Sim LIBERO average 76.8 → 85.9, vs 82.6 for equal-budget online RL.

title: AcceRL: A Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning and World Model Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Asynchronous VLA RL with plug-in world models. On 4×H200, estimated time to 2,000 steps: 6.5h versus RLinf 15.8h. LIBERO-Spatial: DIAMOND-backed training needs ~200x fewer simulator interactions than model-free AcceRL for comparable return.

title: Scaling Sim-to-Real VLA Reinforcement Learning with Generative 3D Worlds
short: Sim-to-Real VLA RL with Generative 3D Worlds
one_line: Generates 100 physical ManiSkill 3 scenes with a GPT-4o designer and EmbodiedGen, runs PPOFlow on a BridgeV2-pretrained pi0 across them, then transfers zero-shot. Real WidowX, 12 scenes, 240 trials: 21.7% → 75% success, compared only with the imitation starting policy.

title: Conservative Offline Robot Policy Learning via Posterior-Transition Reweighting
one_line: PTR: reward-free weighted regression for VLA post-training; a transition scorer's identification posterior-to-uniform ratio reweights heterogeneous mixed-quality samples, compatible with diffusion and flow-matching action heads.

title: Large Reward Models: Generalizable Online Robot Reward Generation with Vision-Language Models
one_line: Separately LoRA-tunes Qwen3-VL-8B reward models for contrastive progress, absolute progress or completion. After 30 PPO iterations on pi0.5 in ManiSkill3: 56.88% baseline to at most 60.93%, versus 66.87% with environment reward.

title: Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning (OmniReset)
one_line: OmniReset: diverse programmatic simulator resets let large-scale RL learn long-horizon dexterous manipulation without hand-crafted curricula or demos; scales with compute and transfers to real robots above baselines.

title: ExpertGen: Scalable Sim-to-Real Expert Policy Learning from Imperfect Behavior Priors
org: RAI Institute; UT Austin; Sony AI
one_line: DSRL + FastTD3 noise steering in massively parallel sim with binary reward only. On an 8-task AnyTask mean: ExpertGen 85.3 vs DP prior 40.3, residual RL 53.7, DSRL-SAC 37.7.

title: Simulation Distillation: Pretraining World Models in Simulation for Rapid Real-World Adaptation (SimDist)
one_line: Pretrain a latent world model in simulation; freeze encoder, reward and value, adapt dynamics on real data and plan with MPPI. Go2 slippery slope: 14/15 successes across three speeds after 35.7 minutes, versus IQL/RLPD 0/15.

title: You've Got a Golden Ticket: Improving Generative Robot Policies With A Single Noise Vector
org: Robotics and AI Institute; Arizona State University; Northeastern University
one_line: Replaces per-chunk Gaussian noise in a frozen diffusion or flow policy with one fixed noise vector found by black-box search. Real Franka block/cube pick: 80 → 98% success on 50 held-out episodes after 150 search episodes (~30 min).

title: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning
one_line: Offline RL method (CGQ) regularizing a single-step critic toward a chunk-level critic trained with temporally extended backups; tighter optimality bounds, strong long-horizon OGBench results.

title: SmoothVLA: Aligning Vision-Language-Action Models with Physical Constraints via Intrinsic Smoothness Optimization
one_line: GRPO fine-tuning of a VLA with a hybrid reward: sparse task success plus dense jerk-based intrinsic smoothness term; 13.8% smoother than standard RL on LIBERO.

title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
one_line: DPPO on a humanoid diffusion planner, alternating with PPO on the low-level controller. Sim 50-70% → >90%. Booster T1 hardware 70% / 50% / 75%.

title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Adaptive Diffusion Navigation Policies
one_line: GRPO (value-network-free) fine-tuning of an imitation-pretrained diffusion navigation policy (NavDP) with selective layer updates; Isaac Sim PointGoal unseen-scene success 52.0% to 58.7%, zero-shot transfer to a real Unitree Go2 quadruped.

title: RoboStereo: Dual-Tower 4D Embodied World Models for Unified Policy Optimization
one_line: RGB/pointmap 4D world model supports test-time action verification and imagined GRPO. Combining all three components lifts OpenVLA-OFT mean MimicGen success 27.7% to 54.0%; online GRPO reaches 29.2%, under the same 128-trajectories-per-task interaction budget.

title: RoboClaw: An Agentic Framework for Scalable Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks
one_line: VLM-driven agent unifying data collection, policy learning and execution; Entangled Action Pairs give self-resetting autonomous collection loops. Reports 25% higher success than baselines on a real long-horizon vanity-table task and 53.7% less human data-collection time.

title: HandelBot: Real-World Piano Playing via Fast Adaptation of Dexterous Robot Policies
one_line: Freezes the best sim piano rollout as an open-loop trajectory, nudges each finger's lateral joint from MIDI key errors, then adds bounded residual RL rewarded by MIDI. Real, 5-song mean key-press F1: 77.6 vs open-loop sim 41.8.

title: Simple Recipe Works: Vision-Language-Action Models are Natural Continual Learners with Reinforcement Learning
org: UT Austin, UCLA, NTU, Sony AI
one_line: Fine-tunes a VLA on each new task in sequence with GRPO on sparse 0/1 success and a rank-32 LoRA adapter, with no replay or regularizer. Sim LIBERO-Spatial: AVG 81.2, forgetting 0.3, vs 7.3 and 40.9 with full fine-tuning.

title: World2Act: Latent Action Post-Training from World Model Dynamics
one_line: Frozen GR00T-N1.6-ft plus a residual policy trained in action latents contrastively aligned with world-model latents. RoboCasa success 70.1% to 72.6%; real-robot average improves 6.7 points over the same fine-tuned baseline.

title: Update-Free On-Policy Steering via Verifiers
org: University of Toronto; Google DeepMind; University of Alberta; Harvard University; UT Austin
one_line: Trains a small verifier on labeled evaluation rollouts of the deployed policy, then reranks 10 samples from the frozen diffusion or flow policy. Real ALOHA, 5 tasks, 20 trials each: mean success 38% → 87% (chart reading).

title: Quality over Quantity: Demonstration Curation via Influence Functions for Data-Centric Robot Learning (QoQ)
one_line: Hessian-free max-cosine influence against a small validation set. Robomimic Can-paired 99.2% vs 64.8% with all data; real cabinet opening 25.0% → 43.3%.

title: DexHiL: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training in Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: Arm-plus-hand takeovers for a dexterous VLA (Being-H0.5), with intervention samples reweighted to 50% of the training distribution; Tissue Extraction after three rounds 19/20 vs DAgger* 16/20 vs data-matched offline 15/20.

title: From Prior to Pro: Efficient Skill Mastery via Distribution Contractive RL Finetuning
one_line: Freezes a diffusion/flow BC prior as a noise-to-chunk sampler, trains a small residual on the same noise with a TD3+BC-style loss, and runs the best-Q sample. Real UR5 BeltAssembly (30 trials): 56.67% → 93.33% after about 420 episodes.

title: Towards Human-Like Manipulation through RL-Augmented Teleoperation and Mixture-of-Dexterous-Experts VLA
short: Towards Human-Like Manipulation through RL-Augmented Teleoperation and…
one_line: IMCopilot RL skills assist teleoperation and serve as MoDE-VLA execution primitives; residual expert modules add force and tactile signals to pi0. Mean success across four real tasks is 34% versus pi0’s 15%.

title: OmniGuide: Universal Guidance Fields for Enhancing Generalist Robot Policies
one_line: Test-time guidance of VLA action sampling via differentiable attractor/repeller energy fields from 3D foundation models, semantic reasoners and human pose estimators; improves success and safety in sim and real.

title: PlayWorld: Learning Robot World Models from Autonomous Play
one_line: Fine-tunes a Ctrl-World-style model on 30 hours of unattended, failure-rich robot self-play, then hill-climbs a few-demo diffusion policy inside it with DSRL. Towel folding: 10% → 75% at 2000 steps vs a 40% human-demo-model peak (chart reading).

title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
one_line: Per-task consistency-model world model from about 6 h of play. Evaluation r 0.8455-0.9908 across checkpoints of DP/ACT/pi0/pi0.5; runs 10+ minutes at 15 FPS on a 4090.

title: AtomVLA: Scalable Post-Training for Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Latent World Models
one_line: Offline GRPO scores sampled action chunks using V-JEPA2 latent distances to subgoals and goals. LIBERO simulation average: 93.0% SFT to 97.0% after post-training without online environment rollouts.

title: Critic in the Loop: A Tri-System VLA Framework for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation
one_line: Tri-system hierarchy: VLM planner, fast VLA executor, and lightweight visual critic that routes control, triggering VLM replanning on failures or stalls in long-horizon manipulation.

title: RoboPocket: Improve Robot Policies Instantly with Your Phone
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Innovation…
one_line: Robot-free DAgger-style loop: an iPhone handheld gripper previews the policy's predicted trajectory in AR and streams corrections to online finetuning; in a four-user distributed test, Scene 2 rose 0.42 to 0.82 with 12 corrections.

title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies
one_line: Latent actor picks the noise for a one-step MeanFlow policy, and the action-space Q-gradient is backpropagated through the generator. Real average: BC-FM 25/80, DSRL 28/80, LPS 45/80.

title: Force-Aware Residual DAgger via Trajectory Editing for Precision Insertion with Impedance Control (TER-DAgger)
one_line: Force-mismatch trigger plus trajectory-edited residual corrections under impedance control for insertion; average success 77.2% vs 40.0% for the best baseline (Finetune) over two simulated and three real insertion tasks.

title: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
one_line: Human quality scores train a per-step reward, and a residual is fitted with exp(beta*r)-weighted BC. Apple 60% → 100%, while IQL-weighted BC scored 0%.

title: SEAR: Sample Efficient Action Chunking Reinforcement Learning
one_line: SEAR combines a multi-horizon causal critic with random receding-horizon replanning for off-policy action-chunk RL. Outperforms prior methods on the twenty hardest MetaWorld tasks; adding it to QC improves OGBench cube-triple offline-to-online learning.

title: Robometer: Scaling General-Purpose Robotic Reward Models via Trajectory Comparisons
org: USC, UT Dallas, MIT, University of Washington, Ai2, NVIDIA
one_line: Qwen3-VL-4B reward model with progress, success and preference heads, trained on RBM-1M including failures. Real DSRL on frozen pi0: 20% → 85% in ≤45 min (10k steps) vs 55% with RoboReward; 0 false-positive successes vs 45.

title: π-StepNFT: Wider Space Needs Finer Steps in Online RL for Flow-based VLAs
one_line: Critic-free, likelihood-free step-wise ranking on Flow-SDE rollouts. pi0 LIBERO 57.6 → 90.5, trailing piRL PPO at 96.0. ManiSkill OOD 50.4 vs PPO 39.3.

title: Keyframe-Guided Structured Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon Laboratory Robotics
short: Keyframe-Guided Structured Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon…
one_line: Extracts kinematics-aware keyframes from demos, diffusion-predicts stage targets, builds geometric progress rewards for online VLA fine-tuning; 82% after 40-60 min on four lab tasks vs HG-DAgger 42%, HiL-ConRFT 47%.

title: SPARR: Simulation-based Policies with Asymmetric Real-world Residuals for Assembly
one_line: Frozen sim PPO assembly policy plus a real-world image and force residual trained RLPD-style, seeded with the prior's own successes. 95-100% on 10 AutoMate tasks in 0.5 h, with no human in the loop.

title: FlowCorrect: Efficient Interactive Correction of Generative Flow Policies for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: VR 'nudges' train a tiny LoRA patch on a frozen flow policy; hard Pick-and-Place cases 0/40 to 32/40.

title: IG-RFT: An Interaction-Guided RL Framework for VLA Models in Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Trains pi0.5 in three stages: SFT on 60 demos, an offline advantage-weighted flow-matching loss from a learned critic, then human-in-the-loop correction rounds with the same weighting. 4 real long-horizon tasks, 20 trials each: 18.8% → 40.0% → 85.0%.

title: PhysMem: Scaling Test-Time Memory for Embodied Physical Reasoning
one_line: A VLM planner tests physical hypotheses before reusing them as memory, without weight updates. Simulated medium-difficulty brick insertion: 76% success versus 61% free-form memory, 53% no memory and 23% direct experience retrieval.

title: AdaWorldPolicy: World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Couples world model, action expert and force predictor as flow-matching DiTs; online adaptive learning alternates action generation and future imagination to update modules under visual/physical domain shift.

title: What Matters for Simulation to Online Reinforcement Learning on Real Robots
one_line: Empirical study of continuing sim-pretrained SAC on real robots: keep or warm-start replay, update the actor once per 20 critic steps at LR 1e-5, restore optimizer state. Franka vision grasping reaches near-perfect success in about ten real minutes.

title: LLMs Can Learn to Reason Via Off-Policy RL
short: LLMs Can Learn to Reason Via Off-Policy RL
one_line: OAPL: off-policy LLM post-training that embraces lagged inference policies (400+ gradient steps) instead of importance-sampling; beats GRPO+IS on competition math, matches DeepCoder with 3x fewer generations.

title: TOPReward: Token Probabilities as Hidden Zero-Shot Rewards for Robotics
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Amazon, UNC Chapel Hill
one_line: Reads a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B's log-probability of 'True' that a video prefix completes the task as a training-free progress curve. Real ManiRewardBench progress subset (113 tasks, 497 episodes): VOC 0.942 vs GVL 0.316 on the same model, trained Robometer-4B 0.858.

title: RoboCurate: Harnessing Diversity with Action-Verified Neural Trajectory for Robot Learning
one_line: Filters generated robot videos by comparing their motion with simulator replays of annotated actions. Relative success gains over real-data-only: +70.1% GR-1 Tabletop (300 demos), +16.1% DexMimicGen pretraining, +179.9% real ALLEX humanoid.

title: Stable Asynchrony: Variance-Controlled Off-Policy RL for LLMs
one_line: VCPO scales the learning rate by effective sample size and adds a critic-free minimum-variance baseline for stale-rollout policy gradients; stable even 128 steps off-policy, and matches synchronous performance 2.5x faster on a long-horizon tool-use task.

title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies (DreamZero)
short: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies (DreamZero)
one_line: 14B autoregressive video-diffusion World Action Model jointly predicting future video and actions at 7Hz; real-robot task progress over 2x the best pretrained VLA on unseen tasks/environments; 10-20 min video-only cross-embodiment data: >42% relative gain on unseen tasks.

title: WoVR: World Models as Reliable Simulators for Post-Training VLA Policies with RL
one_line: Runs GRPO entirely inside an action-conditioned Wan2.2-5B world model, starting imagined episodes near failure keyframes and refreshing the model with policy-aligned data to curb hallucination. Real Franka: 51.1 → 80.0 average (WMPO 64.5), no online robot RL.

title: Dual-Granularity Contrastive Reward via Generated Episodic Guidance for Efficient Embodied RL (DEG)
short: Dual-Granularity Contrastive Reward via Generated Episodic Guidance for Efficient…
one_line: Video generation model produces per-episode task guidance; coarse- and fine-grained contrastive latent rewards against it drive manipulation RL without human annotations across 18 sim and real tasks.

title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models
org: Tsinghua University, Harbin Institute of Technology, Peking University, Carnegie Mellon University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Zhongguancun Academy
one_line: Co-trains the VLA on real plus MimicGen sim demos, then runs PPO in a rough ManiSkill3 task copy with a weighted real-demo BC loss; no real-robot RL. Real average success, pi0.5: SFT co-training 45.9 → 66.2.

title: ALOE: Action-Level Off-Policy Evaluation for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training
org: AgiBot, HKUST, Fudan University, Nanjing University
one_line: Learns a chunk-level Q of the current pi0.5 policy by TD bootstrapping with a pessimistic ensemble, instead of Monte Carlo state values, to weight policy updates. Phone Assembly, 60 trials, 10.0% BC start: ALOE 95.0, AWR 80.0.

title: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
one_line: Grounds a world model on 50 real pi0.5 rollouts per task each iteration, labels synthetic rollouts with a strict Qwen3-VL-4B, and fine-tunes on real plus synthetic successes. 5 real DROID tasks: 0.460 → 0.868 vs filtered BC 0.752.

title: Scaling Verification Can Be More Effective than Scaling Policy Learning for Vision-Language-Action Alignment (CoVer / CoVer-VLA)
one_line: Keeps pi0 frozen, samples K instruction rephrasings times M action chunks, and picks one with a CLIP-style contrastive verifier trained on BridgeV2. SIMPLER red-teaming, ID/OOD: pi0 41.5/29.7, pi0 fine-tuned on augmented data 44.0/48.7, pi0 (rephrase) + CoVer 65.5/62.0.

title: Accelerating Robotic Reinforcement Learning with Agent Guidance (AGPS: Agent-guided Policy Search)
one_line: Replaces the HIL-SERL human with a failure-detector-gated VLM agent; USB insertion 100% at 8 min with zero human interventions.

title: GigaBrain-0.5M*: a VLA That Learns From World Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
one_line: RECAP-style conditioning plus world-model future latents and value. Box Packing about 60 pretrain / 75 AWR / 60 RECAP / 95% RAMP (bar readings).

title: What Makes Value Learning Efficient in Residual Reinforcement Learning?
org: Nanyang Technological University; Mila / Universite de Montreal; National University of Singapore
one_line: Speeds up residual SAC by fixing the critic: prefill the replay buffer with 20K base-policy transitions and add LayerNorm to the critic. ManiSkill sim PegInsertionSide: 90% success about 6x faster than Policy Decorator (~0.3M vs ~2-2.3M env steps, plot reading).

title: RISE: Self-Improving Robot Policy with Compositional World Model
org: CUHK; Kinetix AI; HKU; Shanghai Innovation Institute; Horizon Robotics; Tsinghua University
one_line: Replaces online physical rollouts with a learned action-conditioned video model and a pi0.5-based value model that scores imagined chunk outcomes, driving advantage-conditioned training of pi0.5. Real dual-arm, 20 trials per task: box closing 35% → 95% vs RECAP 60%.

title: Where Autonomy Works: Evaluating Robot Capabilities in 2026
one_line: Survey of reported robot reliability: warehouse picking 99%+ (per roboticist interviews), DYNA-1 napkin folding 99.4% over a 24-hour run, Figure package handling 95% (claimed, one-hour demo); autonomy works where environments are controlled or forgiving.

title: Preference Aligned Visuomotor Diffusion Policies for Deformable Object Manipulation (RKO)
one_line: Preference fine-tuning of a pretrained diffusion policy on preferred vs dispreferred real cloth-folding demos; RKO merges KTO's per-sample labels with RPO's similarity reweighting. Best in 4/9 settings; Trousers Pref 1: 0.910 vs 0.701 for vanilla DDPM.

title: SERNF: Sample-Efficient Real-World Dexterous Policy Fine-Tuning via Action-Chunked Critics and Normalizing Flows (the v4 PDF is titled "SERNF: Sample-Efficient Real-World Dexterous Fine-Tuning with Normalizing-Flow Policies")
one_line: Normalizing-flow chunk policy (exact likelihood) with a chunk critic; real dexterous scissors cut success 0.16 → 0.84 with 60 online rollouts.

title: χ0 (kai0): Resource-Aware Robust Manipulation via Taming Distributional Inconsistencies
one_line: Open garment-folding pipeline: model soup plus stage-aware advantage (RECAP-style, eps = 0.3) plus train-deploy alignment on pi0.5. Task A success about 27% → 97% (bar readings, 30 trials).

title: TwinRL (TwinRL-VLA): Digital Twin-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Robotic Manipulation
org: Peking University; HKUST; Simplexity Robotics; Tsinghua University
one_line: SFTs Octo-Small on 30 real demos plus twin trajectories, runs RL in a phone-scanned twin to seed the real buffer, then real HIL-SERL-style RL. 4 real Franka tasks: near-100% success, at least 30% less real interaction than HIL-SERL.

title: RLinf-USER: A Unified and Extensible System for Real-World Online Policy Learning in Embodied AI
one_line: Infrastructure, not an algorithm: a fully asynchronous system for real-robot online learning. Peg insertion (CNN, RLPD) converges in about 1500 s vs 8000+ s with a synchronous pipeline; pi0 Pick-and-Place 39/60 → 58/60 with HG-DAgger.

title: VGAS: Value-Guided Action-Chunk Selection for Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
one_line: A chunk critic with expected-max backup and geometric regularization reranks eight SmolVLA samples. Simulated LIBERO, five demos/task: 39.8% BC to 49.0%; plain Q-chunking scores 37.9%.

title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
one_line: World model pretrained on 44k h of human video with latent actions. Checkpoint ranking r = 0.995 / MMRV 0.003 on AgiBot fruit packing (human-scored).

title: World-VLA-Loop: Closed-Loop Learning of Video World Model and VLA Policy
one_line: Cosmos world model with a built-in reward head, trained on success plus near-success data and refreshed with policy rollouts. Real Place Cup 13.3% → 50.0% after 2 loops.

title: RL-VLA³: A Flexible and Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for VLA Training
one_line: Fully asynchronous distributed RL framework for VLA post-training (decoupled simulation, inference, training; dynamic batching, environment sharding); up to 85.2% higher throughput than synchronous baselines, scaling 8 to 256 GPUs.

title: Reparameterization Flow Policy Optimization
one_line: RFO trains flow policies with reparameterization policy gradients, backpropagating through ODE action generation and differentiable dynamics; almost 2x SOTA baseline reward on a soft-body quadruped task.

title: VLS: Steering Pretrained Robot Policies via Vision-Language Models
org: University of Washington; AI2; University of Oxford; NUS
one_line: Training-free: a VLM names task objects, SAM/DINOv2 features plus depth give 3D keypoints, and the VLM writes differentiable per-stage rewards whose gradients steer a frozen diffusion/flow policy's denoising. CALVIN (sim) movable objects: 0.94 vs DynaGuide 0.26, base 0.13.

title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Shows expected-reward RL is a first-order approximation of maximum likelihood under binary terminal feedback; MaxRL interpolates between them as sampling compute scales, up to 20x test-time scaling efficiency over GRPO.

title: RFS: Reinforcement Learning with Residual Flow Steering for Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: One PPO policy outputs both the starting noise for a frozen flow-matching base and an additive residual, so it can switch modes and leave the demo manifold. Sim, 6 IsaacLab dexterous tasks: 0.861 vs base 0.250, DSRL-only 0.483.

title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
one_line: GRPO trains a VLA inside WorldGym with GPT-4o rewards. Real eggplant-to-blue-sink success: 4% SFT to 72%; World-Gymnast outperforms RL trained in SIMPLER on three of four evaluated real tasks.

title: Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control (FPO++)
org: Amazon FAR, UC Berkeley, Stanford, HKU, CMU
one_line: Flow policy gradient using exp(old CFM loss - new CFM loss) as the PPO ratio, clipped per (tau, eps) sample, with zero-noise test-time sampling. Zero-sampling alone lifts the sim Robomimic Can base policy from 10.00% to 71.35% before RL.

title: TQL: Scaling Q-Functions with Transformers by Preventing Attention Collapse
one_line: Attention-entropy regularization lets transformer critics improve with size (43% gain from 0.4M to 26M); 25-task average 40±7 vs floq 34±7.

title: Green-VLA: Staged Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Robots
one_line: Five-stage VLA curriculum (VLM, grounding, multi-embodiment pretraining on 3,000 h, embodiment adaptation) ending in an RL policy-alignment stage; adds progress prediction and anomaly detection at inference.

title: SA-VLA: Spatially-Aware Flow-Matching for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
org: Wuhan University; A*STAR IHPC; NUS; CAS; NTU
one_line: RL fine-tuning of flow-matching VLAs that preserves spatial grounding: spatial tokens fused with visual tokens, geometric progress dense rewards, SCAN spatially-conditioned exploration; better zero-shot spatial generalization on LIBERO/LIBERO-PLUS.

title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
one_line: SDPO: LLM conditioned on rich textual feedback (e.g. runtime errors) acts as self-teacher, distilling next-token predictions into the policy; at test time on very hard coding questions, matches best-of-k discovery with ~3x fewer attempts.

title: One Step Is Enough: Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization (DMPO), renamed OGPO: One-Step Generative Policy Optimization for Real-Time Robot Control
one_line: One-step MeanFlow policy with a dispersive loss, fine-tuned by PPO on a one-step Gaussian chain plus BC regularization. Square 0.83 at 1 NFE vs DPPO 0.78 at 20 NFE. Without the BC term (v1 ablation), success collapses to near zero.

title: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
short: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
one_line: REMAC (ICLR 2026): LoRA fine-tuning with masked action prefixes and a self-conditioned curriculum adapts pretrained policies to asynchronous inference. Prefix-preserved sampling maintains chunk continuity; reports higher completion rates and faster execution without added inference overhead.

title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
one_line: SDFT: a demonstration-conditioned model acts as its own teacher for on-policy distillation, learning new skills from demos with less forgetting than supervised fine-tuning (foundation models, not robot-specific).

title: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
one_line: Video-model policy that is also a world model and value function. Best-of-N planning refit on 648 real rollouts raised hard ALOHA tasks from 59.5 to 72.0 average score. Mainly a policy architecture.

title: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM)
one_line: Trains a second flow toward pi_beta(a|s)·exp(tau·Q(s,a)) via adjoint matching, using the critic's action gradient without backpropagating through the sampler. Offline RL over 50 OGBench tasks (sim): QAM 44 vs ReBRAC 40, FQL 36, FBRAC 11.

title: DeFlow: Decoupling Manifold Modeling and Value Maximization for Offline Policy Extraction
one_line: Offline RL with a flow-matching behavior policy plus a lightweight refinement module in a data-derived trust region, avoiding ODE-solver backprop; strong OGBench results and efficient offline-to-online adaptation.

title: Failure-Aware RL: Reliable Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning with Self-Recovery for Real-World Manipulation (FARL)
org: Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute, SJTU, Tsinghua and others
one_line: World-model safety critic predicts near-future failures and hands control to an offline-trained recovery policy during PPO-based (Uni-O4) offline-to-online RL; real Franka tasks: 73.1% fewer intervention-requiring failures than Uni-O4 (mean of per-task reductions).

title: SOP: A Scalable Online Post-Training System for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Ten real AgiBot G1 robots run pi0.5 with human takeovers; a cloud learner mixes on-policy data with old demos, publishing weights every 25 steps. 3 h on-policy interaction: 0.571 → 0.800; 80 more demo hours: 0.576 → 0.612.

title: CycleVLA: Proactive Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Models via Subtask Backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
org: University of Oxford; University of Cambridge
one_line: Predicts stop/progress as extra action dimensions; a VLM checks for failure near subtask ends, then backtracks and retries with MBR consensus over eight chunks. Simulation: LIBERO-Plus pi0.5 65.0% to 86.0%; LIBERO 96.9% to 98.5%.

title: V-VLAPS: Value-Guided Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: An offline-trained value head guides Octo-prior MCTS using the LIBERO simulator. Matches value-free VLAPS at 600 seconds of search per episode; at 1800 seconds, adds 6 points on LIBERO-Object and 4 on LIBERO-10.

title: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
one_line: Fine-tunes Qwen3-VL to score rollouts 1-5 on a rubric, adding counterfactual-relabeled and clipped negatives; in sim, reward accuracy tracks RL success (r=0.83). Real WidowX DSRL, open drawer, 20 trials: base 10%, RoboReward 8B 80%, human-reward oracle 90%.

title: Enact: Real-world RL environments for robotics models (YC S26)
one_line: Startup that rolls out customer policies, finds failures and collects targeted recovery data; pi0.5 packing went from 90/100 (200 demos) to 99/100 with 50 added recovery demos (self-reported).

title: Fern (Ishiki Labs): RL environments for robotics companies
one_line: YC W26 startup: world-model RL environments replicating production scenes; adds RL heads atop customers' existing policies to raise speed and success weekly. No quantitative results published.

title: Real-world Reinforcement Learning from Suboptimal Interventions (SiLRI)
org: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics and others
one_line: Per-state Lagrange multiplier keeps the policy near human interventions only where humans are consistent; reaches 90% at least 50% faster than HIL-SERL.

title: Robo-Dopamine: General Process Reward Modeling for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
org: Peking University, BAAI, University of Sydney, CASIA
one_line: A VLM reward model predicts signed progress 'hops' from multi-view images, fused into a potential used as policy-invariant shaping, not raw reward. 8 real tasks: 95.2% final success vs 68.0% with sparse reward (ConRFT) and 9.8% for BC.

title: ReinforceGen: Hybrid Skill Policies with Automated Data Generation and Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Decomposes tasks into motion-planner-linked skills, imitates data generated from 10 human demos, then fine-tunes pose prediction, skills and termination with online adaptation and RL; over 80% on every Robosuite visuomotor task tested, 84.6% vs 44.7% for the HSP baseline.

title: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
one_line: Pretrain BC to match a posterior over demonstrator actions so later RL can explore; Libero 16 tasks at 1000 rollouts best-of-N: BC 33.1, PostBC 55.1.

title: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
org: University of Washington; Princeton University; UC Berkeley; Stanford University; Toyota Research Institute; USC; Cornell University; Physical Intelligence
one_line: Turns a 2-5 minute monocular video into a splat-rendered IsaacSim twin for policy evaluation, with brief co-training to align visuals. Average Pearson r = 0.9 across 6 unseen scenes; in their tests the Ctrl-World video model mis-ranked policies (MMRV 0.22).

title: EVOLVE-VLA: Test-Time Training from Environment Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Test-time GRPO with a pretrained progress critic (VLAC) instead of an oracle reward. LIBERO average 89.2 → 95.8 over the paper's own OpenVLA-OFT baseline; 1-shot SFT 43.6 → 61.3.

title: Symmetry-Aware Steering of Equivariant Diffusion Policies: Benefits and Limits
one_line: Equivariant noise-steering actor and critics on equivariant diffusion policies. Square D2 peak success: base 0.275, DSRL 0.552, Equi-DSRL 0.644; but strict equivariance was lowest on Stack D1 (0.728 vs DSRL 0.740). Plain DSRL's Q diverged in 3/5 Lift seeds.

title: Evaluating Gemini Robotics Policies in a Veo World Simulator
one_line: Fine-tunes Veo 2 into an action-conditioned multi-view world model, runs Gemini Robotics On-Device checkpoints closed-loop in it, and humans score the videos. Nominal, 8 checkpoints: Pearson 0.88, MMRV 0.03 vs real success, though absolute rates are under-predicted.

title: Decoupled Q-Chunking
one_line: Long-chunk value backups train a distilled partial-chunk critic for a shorter-output policy. Across six hard offline goal-conditioned OGBench environments, aggregate score is 82 versus n-step 68, SHARSA 44 and Q-chunking 25.

title: Scalable Offline Model-Based RL with Action Chunks (MAC)
short: Scalable Offline Model-Based RL with Action Chunks (MAC)
one_line: Action-chunk dynamics model predicts future state from an action sequence, reducing compounding error in model-based value expansion; rejection-samples a behavior policy; best offline MBRL on datasets up to 100M transitions.

title: Training Diffusion Policies via Prior-Mapping Co-Evolution
short: Training Diffusion Policies via Prior-Mapping Co-Evolution
one_line: GoRL: online RL for generative policies by optimizing a tractable latent prior, then consolidating into an expressive prior-to-action mapping; HopperStand return over 870, 3x strongest baseline (ICML 2026).

title: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models as Anti-Exploration: A Test-Time Scaling Approach (TACO)
org: TeleAI (China Telecom); USTC; Tsinghua University; HKUST
one_line: Samples M chunks from a flow VLA and runs the one with the highest pseudo-count in the fine-tuning data, from a small Coin Flipping Network on internal features. RoboTwin 2.0 (pi0.5, 41 tasks, M=50): 59.3 → 64.0.

title: GR-RL: Going Dexterous and Precise for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Offline distributional chunk critics filter demonstrations, followed by mirror-symmetry augmentation and latent-noise online RL around a frozen base. Real shoe lacing improves from 45.7% for GR-3 behavior cloning to 83.3%.

title: State of Robot Learning — December 2025
one_line: Practitioner essay: nearly all robot learning today is BC plus laborious DAgger-style data iteration, and real-world RL remains hard; in the author's reading, pi*0.6's advantage-weighted method gives minor gains over BC and many tasks still needed human corrections.

title: Goal-Driven Reward by Video Diffusion Models for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Fine-tunes a pretrained video diffusion model to generate goal videos; rewards combine video-level latent alignment with them and a forward-backward-representation reward toward a CLIP-selected goal frame; evaluated on Meta-World and Distracting Control Suite.

title: Beyond Success: Refining Elegant Robot Manipulation from Mixed-Quality Data via Just-in-Time Intervention
one_line: Trains an offline Cal-QL critic on frozen VLA features from labeled demo segments; only when its Q-value jumps from its moving average are N chunks reranked. LIBERO-Elegant, SmolVLA: 49.8 → 67.2 ESR vs 53.8 reranking every step.

title: Reinforcing Action Policies by Prophesying (Prophet / ProphRL: FA-GRPO + FlowScale)
org: Fudan University; Shanghai Innovation Institute; Logos Robotics
one_line: Trains flow VLAs with FA-GRPO and FlowScale inside a 2B Cosmos-initialized action-to-video world model, rewarded by a VLM majority vote. Real UR30e, 100 in-model RL updates, 3 runs x 20 trials: pi0.5-3B 52.1 → 82.1 (+30.0).

title: Discover, Learn, and Reinforce: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Pretraining with Diverse RL-Generated Trajectories
one_line: DLR makes RL generate multiple distinct high-success behavior patterns per task for VLA pretraining; beats equal-sized standard-RL data downstream and scales positively where single-pattern RL data does not.

title: SpeedAug: Policy Acceleration via Tempo-Enriched Policy and RL Fine-Tuning
one_line: Tempo-augmented demonstrations and discounted sparse rewards optimize policy speed. DPPO handles simulation; real-arm PA-RL increases pick-and-place throughput from 11.4 to 20.76 successes/min after 16 minutes of interaction (v2 result).

title: DYNA-1 Pre-Training: Zero-Shot Dexterity Is Here (adjacent)
one_line: Company update, no paper: says the DYNA-1 base model folds laundry and sorts packages zero-shot in unseen environments, and that as little as one hour of demos fine-tunes it to roughly 100% success on new tasks. RL not discussed.

title: Evolution Strategies at the Hyperscale (EGGROLL: Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning)
org: University of Oxford (FLAIR, WhiRL); Mila; NVIDIA AI Technology Center; NormaCore.dev
one_line: Makes each evolution-strategies perturbation a low-rank A_i B_i^T, so the population shares one big matmul plus cheap per-member corrections. On one GH200 (8192-dim bf16 layer, batch 1024): 91% of max batch-inference throughput vs PPO 34%, OpenES 0.41%.

title: SRPO: Self-Referential Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Scores failed rollouts by V-JEPA 2 latent distance to the batch's own successes and uses these rewards in a GRPO-style update; one-shot OpenVLA* on LIBERO goes from 48.9% to 99.2% average success.

title: Towards Deploying VLA without Fine-Tuning: Plug-and-Play Inference-Time VLA Policy Steering via Embodied Evolutionary Diffusion (VLA-Pilot)
one_line: GPT-4o writes a keypoint scoring function, then evolutionary search with truncated re-noising inside a diffusion VLA's samples. Real DiVLA 0.31 → 0.62.

title: π*0.6: a VLA That Learns From Experience
one_line: Fits a distributional value, thresholds n-step advantages into an 'Advantage: positive/negative' text input, and retrains the whole flow VLA supervised; CFG optional. Real T-shirt/shorts laundry, same data: about 2x AWR's throughput; success ~96% vs AWR ~91%, PPO ~75%.

title: Scalable Policy Evaluation with Video World Models
one_line: Action-conditioned Cosmos-Predict2 evaluator. Sim Pearson 0.833-0.879; real Bridge only 0.687. Adding other policies' rollouts to world-model training matters.

title: Harnessing Bounded-Support Evolution Strategies for Policy Refinement (TD-ES)
one_line: Continues from a PPO checkpoint with antithetic evolution strategies whose bounded triangular per-coordinate noise keeps candidates in a small box around the weights. Sim IQM success, 3 Isaac Lab Franka tasks: PPO 67.2%, Gaussian ES 73.7%, TD-ES 85.0%.

title: Diffusion Policies with Value-Conditional Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: DIVO (IROS 2025): trains a diffusion behavior model with binary advantage-based loss weights, then regularizes a TD3+BC actor toward diffusion samples with non-negative advantage; reports gains on D4RL locomotion and AntMaze.

title: WMPO: World Model-based Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Runs critic-free GRPO for OpenVLA-OFT inside a pixel-space video world model fine-tuned on the policy's own rollouts, failures included, with a VideoMAE success classifier. MimicGen (sim), 4 tasks, 128-rollout budget: 33.6 → 47.1 vs online GRPO 33.2, offline DPO 37.3.

title: The Path Not Taken: RLVR Provably Learns Off the Principals
one_line: Three-Gate Theory for LLM RL with verifiable rewards: sparse-looking updates are a model-conditioned bias landing off principal weight directions with minimal spectral drift, unlike SFT.

title: ExpReS-VLA: Specializing Vision-Language-Action Models Through Experience Replay and Retrieval
one_line: Frozen-feature success/failure buffers, retrieval-augmented LoRA BC and a contrastive loss on failures. Real ID: naive FT 84.7% → 98.0%; OOD: 32% → 98%.

title: Real-to-Sim Robot Policy Evaluation with Gaussian Splatting Simulation of Soft-Body Interactions
one_line: PhysTwin spring-mass twins plus Gaussian-splat rendering. Sim vs real success of ACT/DP/pi0/SmolVLA checkpoints correlates at Pearson r 0.944 / 0.901 / 0.915 on toy packing / rope routing / T-block pushing.

title: Learning Without Critics? Revisiting GRPO in Classical Reinforcement Learning Environments
short: Learning Without Critics? Revisiting GRPO in Classical Reinforcement Learning Environments
one_line: Benchmarks critic-free GRPO against PPO on classical control: all critic-free baselines underperform PPO except on short-horizon tasks like CartPole; high discount factors mostly help; smaller group sizes outperform larger ones.

title: AgiBot deploys its Real-World Reinforcement Learning system
short: AgiBot deploys its Real-World Reinforcement Learning system
one_line: AgiBot's RW-RL system learns assembly skills directly on a Longcheer pilot production line; company claims training cut from weeks to minutes and 100% task completion over extended operation. The article links no paper or code.

title: RL without TD learning
one_line: Transitive RL: divide-and-conquer off-policy value learning over in-dataset subgoals with expectile regression; matches best TD-n on OGBench long-horizon (up to 3,000-step) goal-conditioned tasks without tuning n.

title: End-to-End Dexterous Arm-Hand VLA Policies via Shared Autonomy: VR Teleoperation Augmented by Autonomous Hand VLA Policy for Efficient Data Collection
short: End-to-End Dexterous Arm-Hand VLA Policies via Shared Autonomy: VR Teleoperation…
one_line: Shared autonomy combines human VR arm control with a tactile DexGrasp-VLA hand policy; collected data and corrective teleoperation train an end-to-end arm-hand VLA. Real pick-and-place across 50 objects: 88.7% success, averaging seen and unseen objects.

title: Human-in-the-loop Online Rejection Sampling for Robotic Manipulation (Hi-ORS)
one_line: Drops the critic: keeps episodes whose return clears a rising threshold, human-corrected successes included, and trains pi0 on them with its flow-matching loss. Three real tasks, two robots: 23.3% average margin over offline BC; about 1.5 h of real training.

title: Self-Improving Vision-Language-Action Models with Data Generation via Residual RL (PLD: Probe, Learn, Distill)
org: NVIDIA GEAR; CMU; UC Berkeley; UT Austin
one_line: Trains a bounded Gaussian residual with SAC on a frozen VLA, lets the VLA drift before the residual recovers, and distills successes into it. LIBERO Spatial/Object/Goal avg: OpenVLA-OFT 91.8 → 99.2; real Franka cube pick-up: 30/30 vs 10/30 (human data).

title: πRL (piRL): Online RL Fine-tuning for Flow-based Vision-Language-Action Models
org: Tsinghua University; Peking University; CASIA; Carnegie Mellon University; Infinigence AI; Zhongguancun Academy
one_line: Makes pi0/pi0.5 flow chunks PPO-trainable by adding a learned per-step noise net (Flow-Noise) or an equal-marginal SDE (Flow-SDE) for exact log-probs, dropped at deployment. Few-shot LIBERO (sim): pi0 57.6% → 97.6%, pi0.5 77.1% → 98.3%.

title: On-Policy Distillation
one_line: Student samples its trajectories; teacher supplies per-token reverse-KL feedback. Thinking Machines estimates 9–30x lower cost than extrapolated off-policy SFT for raising Qwen3-8B-Base from 60% to 70% on AIME 2024.

title: Transitive RL: Value Learning via Divide and Conquer
one_line: Divide-and-conquer value update for offline goal-conditioned RL built on the triangle inequality; in principle needs O(log T) recursions versus TD's O(T), reducing bias accumulation; best results on long-horizon benchmarks. ICLR 2026.

title: GSWorld: Closed-Loop Photo-Realistic Simulation Suite for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: 3DGS plus ManiSkill3 photoreal twin for evaluation and DAgger. Sim underestimates real in all 8 ACT/pi0 cells. Sim-collected DAgger, evaluated on the real FR3: 63.75% vs 55% training from scratch at iteration 5 (4-task average).

title: Using Non-Expert Data to Robustify Imitation Learning via Offline Reinforcement Learning (RISE: Robust Imitation by Stitching from Experts)
one_line: Offline IDQL with binary expert/non-expert rewards, a spectral-norm penalty and DINOv2-neighbor action augmentation widens the behavior policy to stitch play/failure data. Real lampshade: BC 17.5%, plain IDQL 10.0%, RISE 82.5%.

title: RM-RL: Role-Model Reinforcement Learning for Precise Robot Manipulation
one_line: Best-of-scene self-imitation plus REINFORCE for a discrete pick-pose correction. Shelf placement 10/10 for pretrained RM-RL vs 5/10 for plain REINFORCE. This is a cross-method comparison, and the pretrained variant uses about 200 extra prior samples.

title: VT-Refine: Learning Bimanual Assembly with Visuo-Tactile Feedback via Simulation Fine-Tuning
org: Columbia University, NVIDIA, UC San Diego
one_line: BC-trains a visuo-tactile diffusion policy on 30 real demos per task, fine-tunes it with DPPO and sparse success reward in an Isaac Gym twin simulating the same tactile pad, and redeploys. Real tabletop, 5 parts, visuo-tactile mean: 0.50 → 0.85.

title: RL-100: Performant Robotic Manipulation with Real-World Reinforcement Learning
org: Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; HKU; IIIS, Tsinghua University; UNC Chapel Hill; Carnegie Mellon University; CASIA
one_line: BC-trains a diffusion policy on 29-400 teleop demos per task, then applies PPO-clip at every denoising step, offline with IQL advantages and an OPE gate, then online with GAE. Real, 8 tasks: 100 mean vs DP3 67.8; 1000/1000 trials.

title: Adversarial Fine-tuning in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot Control
short: Adversarial Fine-tuning in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot…
one_line: Offline-pretrained policies fine-tuned online with injected action perturbations under an EMA-based performance-aware curriculum; more robust than offline-only and faster than scratch on locomotion.

title: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
short: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
one_line: 400k+ GPU-hour study fitting sigmoidal compute-performance curves to LLM RL: recipes differ in asymptote, while details like loss aggregation, normalization and curriculum mainly change compute efficiency; ScaleRL predictably extrapolates to a 100k GPU-hour run.

title: Reflection-Based Task Adaptation for Self-Improving VLA (Reflective Self-Adaptation)
one_line: GPT-4o converts failure videos into dense rewards for OpenVLA PPO. Standard LIBERO average: 83.6% versus VLA-RL 81.0%; on separate LIBERO-Adapt ablations, removing success-filtered SFT collapses success to zero.

title: Refinery: Active Fine-tuning and Deployment-time Optimization for Contact-Rich Policies
org: USC; NVIDIA; University of Washington; University of Sydney
one_line: A GP over start states plus Bayesian optimization picks where PPO trains, and a GMM steers deployment. Per-step assembly success 83.61% → 96.35% in sim.

title: RoVer: Robot Reward Model as Test-Time Verifier for Vision-Language-Action Model
one_line: A process reward model trained on perturbed expert actions scores candidates and predicts local-search directions. Real dual-arm Dobot with a Diffusion Policy base: 72.9% to 88.6% success across seven conditions with ten trials each.

title: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Policies for Vision-Language-Action Models (FPO for pi0)
one_line: Freezes the pi0 decoder; trains a latent flow actor with a CFM-loss ratio proxy, PPO clipping and a Q-ensemble. LIBERO average 87.2 (no plain-pi0 row). One-task ablation, SAC replacing the ratio proxy: 32.4 vs 78.5 (ICRA 2026).

title: Ctrl-World: A Controllable Generative World Model for Robot Manipulation
one_line: Fine-tunes a 1.5B multi-view video diffusion model on DROID so a VLA runs closed-loop inside it, then fine-tunes the policy on human-labeled successful imagined rollouts. pi0.5-DROID: 38.7% → 83.4% on novel instructions and objects, imagined rollouts only.

title: Failure Prediction at Runtime for Generative Robot Policies (FIPER)
one_line: Failure detection combines RND out-of-distribution scores with action-chunk entropy, calibrated on successes. Time-varying thresholds achieve accuracy 0.78 and TWA 0.65; the CP-band variant with a false-alarm bound achieves TWA 0.62.

title: DEAS: DEtached value learning with Action Sequence for Scalable Offline RL
one_line: Offline RL with action-sequence critics (SMDP Q-learning) plus detached value learning to curb overestimation; beats baselines on OGBench and boosts VLAs on RoboCasa Kitchen and real-world manipulation.

title: A Survey of Process Reward Models: From Outcome Signals to Process Supervisions for Large Language Models
short: A Survey of Process Reward Models
one_line: Survey of step-level process reward models for LLMs: process data generation, PRM construction, use in test-time scaling and RL; applications span math, code, multimodal, robotics, agents.

title: Value Flows
one_line: Flow-matching model of the return distribution trained with distributional TD; 1.3x average success gain over 62 tasks.

title: RLinf-VLA: A Unified and Efficient Framework for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language-Action Models
org: Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Academy; Infinigence AI; Peking University; UC Berkeley; Harbin Institute of Technology; CASIA
one_line: Infrastructure plus recipe for VLA RL: simulators, rollout and trainer share GPUs, split them or run pipelined, with chunk-aware PPO and GRPO tricks. ManiSkill 25 tasks, ID/OOD: OpenVLA 53.91/39.10 → GRPO 84.38/75.15 → PPO 96.09/81.93.

title: Verifier-free Test-Time Sampling for Vision-Language-Action Models (MG-Select: Masking Distribution Guided Selection)
one_line: Selects actions by KL divergence from masked-condition predictions. Jointly trained MG-Select* on pi0-FAST: RoboCasa’s eight pick-and-place tasks, 30 demos, 5.3% to 14.2%; SIMPLER average 46.9% to 50.3%.

title: Group Policy Gradient
one_line: Critic-free policy gradient (GPG) replacing the value function with a group-based Monte Carlo advantage estimator inside PPO's clipped objective; matches or beats PPO and uses parallel simulation better.

title: A Recipe for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Manipulation with Online Imitation-Pretrained World Models
org: UC San Diego, UC Berkeley, UNC Chapel Hill, Sudo AI
one_line: Reward-free online imitation RL pretrains a TD-MPC2-style world model in sim for coverage, then a 15-30 demo real fine-tune. Real 32/40 vs 15/40 for the best baseline (v2 numbers; v1 differed).

title: Prosperity before Collapse: How Far Can Off-Policy RL Reach with Stale Data on LLMs?
one_line: M2PO constrains the second moment of importance weights for stable LLM RL on stale data. At staleness 256, clipped tokens average 0.06% versus GRPO’s 1.22%; experiments span six model scales.

title: The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
org: Mila - Quebec AI Institute; Universite de Montreal
one_line: Compares the pretrained policy's return with the dataset's average: if the policy is better, protect it with warm-up rollouts; if the data is better, replay offline data. Regime predictions matched outcomes in 45/63 D4RL settings (71%).

title: Compose Your Policies! Improving Diffusion-based or Flow-based Robot Policies via Test-time Distribution-level Composition (GPC, General Policy Composition)
one_line: Convex mix of two policies' scores at each denoising step, with the weight grid-searched on rollouts. E.g. 86.39 vs 78.84 for the better parent on Robomimic+PushT.

title: VLA-RFT: Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning with Verified Rewards in World Simulators
org: Westlake University; Zhejiang University; OpenHelix; Fudan;…
one_line: GRPO for a flow VLA against a 138M world model with 'verified' reward (distance to the world model's rendering of the expert). LIBERO 86.6 → 91.1 in 400 steps.

title: Open-World Dexterity and Live Demos around the World (DYNA-1i)
one_line: Post-trains a VLA on 'only tens of hours' of office data to stay reliable in unseen venues; no objective or update rule is given. 30-minute shirt-folding trials (~40/hour): 22 consecutive failure-free folds in the office, 20 in unseen venues.

title: VLA Model Post-Training via Action-Chunked PPO and Self Behavior Cloning
short: VLA Model Post-Training via Action-Chunked PPO and Self Behavior Cloning
one_line: Action-chunked PPO plus auxiliary self-BC loss on a dynamically refreshed buffer of high-quality self-collected trials; 0.93 success and 42.17 steps-to-success on MetaWorld, beating supervised fine-tuning.

title: TimeRewarder: Learning Dense Reward from Passive Videos via Frame-wise Temporal Distance
org: Tsinghua, Shanghai Qi Zhi, SJTU, UPenn
one_line: Learns signed frame-pair temporal distances from action-free videos as a dense progress reward; added to the sparse success signal for DrQ-v2, it reaches near-perfect success on 9/10 Meta-World tasks within 200k interactions (sim).

title: SAC Flow: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Flow-Based Policies via Velocity-Reparameterized Sequential Modeling
org: Tsinghua, CMU, Li Auto, Shanghai AI Lab
one_line: Treats flow sampling as a residual recurrent computation; GRU-style gated Flow-G or Transformer-decoded Flow-T stabilize direct SAC training. Reports up to 130% improvement on from-scratch MuJoCo HumanoidStandup.

title: XQC: Well-conditioned Optimization Accelerates Deep Reinforcement Learning
one_line: SAC-based actor-critic whose BatchNorm + WeightNorm + distributional cross-entropy critic cuts condition numbers by orders of magnitude; SOTA sample efficiency on 55 proprioceptive and 15 vision tasks with fewer parameters.

title: Evolution Strategies at Scale: LLM Fine-Tuning Beyond Reinforcement Learning
org: Cognizant AI Lab, MIT, UCLA, UT Austin
one_line: Perturbs all weights of 30 model copies with tiny Gaussian noise, scores each with an outcome-only reward, and steps toward high-scoring noise, with no backprop or log-probs. Countdown, Qwen-2.5-3B (language-only): ES 60.5 vs Dr.GRPO-v 43.8 (base 10.0).

title: SARM: Stage-Aware Reward Modeling for Long Horizon Robot Manipulation
one_line: Stage-aware progress labels from subtask segmentation; reward-weighted BC on pi0 gets 10/12 medium and 8/12 hard T-shirt folds vs 1/12 and 0/12 for plain BC on the full dataset; available in LeRobot.

title: World-Env: Leveraging World Model as a Virtual Environment for VLA Post-Training
one_line: RLOO+PPO for OpenVLA-OFT inside a video simulator with a VLM reflector. LIBERO 5-demo average 74.85 → 79.6, about equal to RIPT-VLA in the real simulator.

title: DexFlyWheel: A Scalable and Self-improving Data Generation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
org: Harbin Institute of Technology, Peking University, PsiBot,…
one_line: Freezes a diffusion imitation policy, trains a SAC residual scaled by 0.1 with shaped rewards, then filters successful rollouts, augments them and retrains imitation policies in a simulation data-generation loop.

title: VLA-Reasoner: Empowering Vision-Language-Action Models with Reasoning via Online Monte Carlo Tree Search
one_line: MCTS with a KDE action prior, a video world model and a progress value on a frozen VLA. LIBERO OpenVLA 76.0 → 81.0; real OpenVLA 22% → 41%.

title: Beyond Human Demonstrations: Diffusion-Based Reinforcement Learning to Generate Data for VLA Training
one_line: Diffusion-policy RL autonomously generates LIBERO training data; a VLA trained on it reaches 81.9% average success, +5.3 over human demos and +12.6 over Gaussian-RL data.

title: Selective Progress-Aware Querying for Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
short: Selective Progress-Aware Querying for Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
one_line: SPARQ: query policy requests human feedback only when learning stagnates or worsens; near-perfect success on simulated UR5 cube picking (PyBullet) with about half the always-query feedback budget.

title: Generalizable Domain Adaptation for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
short: Generalizable Domain Adaptation for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
one_line: Unbalanced optimal-transport loss aligns joint observation-action features across abundant sim and scarce real demos during BC co-training; up to ~30% real-world success gain (NeurIPS 2025).

title: World4RL: Diffusion World Models for Policy Refinement with Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: PPO inside a diffusion world model trained on demos plus policy and random rollouts. Real Franka 68.3% → 93.3% (DP 88.3%).

title: SOE: Sample-Efficient Robot Policy Self-Improvement via On-Manifold Exploration
one_line: Information-bottleneck latent exploration for iterated success-filtered BC. Real Toaster Load 0.56 → 0.75 (0.84 with human steering) in one round.

title: Residual Off-Policy RL for Finetuning Behavior Cloning Policies (ResFiT)
org: Amazon FAR; Stanford; CMU; UC Berkeley
one_line: Keeps an ACT chunked BC policy frozen and trains a small per-step residual with a tuned TD3-style off-policy recipe (demos in each batch, LayerNorm critic, n-step returns). Real 29-DoF humanoid: WoollyBallPnP 14% → 64% after 134 rollouts.

title: A Vision-Language-Action-Critic Model for Robotic Real-World Reinforcement Learning (VLAC)
one_line: Fine-tunes InternVL into a pairwise critic outputting signed progress between two frames plus a done signal, labeled from video temporal order, and uses it for real-arm PPO. Four real tasks: about 30% → about 90% within 200 episodes.

title: Self-Improving Embodied Foundation Models
one_line: REINFORCE with a steps-to-go head that serves as both shaped reward and success detector. Real LanguageTable ~62-63% → ~87-88% with ~3% extra episodes (NeurIPS 2025).

title: SHaRe-RL: Structured, Interactive Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Industrial Assembly Tasks
one_line: Scripted manipulation primitives and human corrections let SAC learn only a 3D insertion primitive. On real industrial connectors, reported cycle time is 3.5s versus HIL-SERL’s 7.4s after about three hours of interaction.

title: Dual-Actor Fine-Tuning of VLA Models: A Talk-and-Tweak Human-in-the-Loop Approach
one_line: Human-in-the-loop BC+Q fine-tuning uses a second actor for language-guided latent corrections. Three real tasks: 25/25 successes each (Wilson 95%: 86.7–100%) versus HG-DAgger’s 25.3% average; whether evaluation includes human language corrections is unclear.

title: SimpleVLA-RL: Scaling VLA Training via Reinforcement Learning
org: Tsinghua University, Shanghai AI Lab, SJTU, PKU, HKU
one_line: GRPO on a tokenized-action OpenVLA-OFT: 8 rollouts per scene, binary success reward on every action token, group-normalized advantages, no critic, and all-agree groups dropped. LIBERO average 91.0 → 99.1; with one demo per task, 48.9 → 96.9.

title: RaC: Robot Learning for Long-Horizon Tasks by Scaling Recovery and Correction
one_line: Changes HG-DAgger takeovers: the human first recovers to a familiar state, then finishes the sub-task, and the episode ends with the takeover. Shirt-hanging: 78.3% with 5 hours of data vs ALOHA Unleashed's 75.0% with ~89 hours (RaC's estimate; cross-paper).

title: floq: Training Critics via Flow-Matching for Scaling Compute in Value-Based RL
one_line: Trains a flow-matching Q-function with TD targets; more integration steps increase critic computation. Best configuration reaches about 1.8x FQL on hard OGBench offline tasks, with separate gains in online fine-tuning.

title: Balancing Signal and Variance: Adaptive Offline RL Post-Training for VLA Flow Models (ARFM: Adaptive Reinforced Flow Matching)
one_line: Critic-free softmax-advantage-weighted flow-matching loss with adaptive temperature on pi0. LIBERO simulation average: 88.1% base to 92.1%; flow RWR 90.8%, flow ReinboT 91.2%.

title: Learn from What We HAVE: History-Aware VErifier that Reasons about Past Interactions Online
one_line: Decouples generation from verification: a diffusion model proposes candidate actions and a history-aware verifier selects using past interactions, handling ambiguous articulated objects, multi-modal doors, uneven pick-up. CoRL 2025.

title: Compute-Optimal Scaling for Value-Based Deep RL
short: Compute-Optimal Scaling for Value-Based Deep RL
one_line: Studies compute allocation across model size, batch size and UTD ratio in online value-based RL; identifies TD-overfitting, where large batches hurt small critics but not large ones.

title: Improving Pre-Trained Vision-Language-Action Policies with Model-Based Search (VLAPS)
one_line: MCTS uses Octo action priors and the LIBERO simulator as an assumed accurate environment model. Simulation only: at the 50k-step Octo checkpoint, LIBERO-Object success rises from 6% to 73% over Octo alone.

title: Actor-Critic for Continuous Action Chunks: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Sparse Reward (AC3)
one_line: TD3-style actor-critic over 16-action chunks with success-only actor updates; BiGym average 0.465 vs CQN-AS 0.349.

title: IRL-VLA: Training an Vision-Language-Action Policy via Reward World Model
one_line: Driving VLA: imitation pretraining, then PPO fine-tuning against a lightweight inverse-RL reward world model instead of a simulator; top NAVSIM v2 results, 2nd in CVPR2025 Autonomous Grand Challenge.

title: Genie Envisioner: A Unified World Foundation Platform for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: One video world model platform for policy (GE-Act), simulation and closed-loop evaluation (GE-Sim), trained on about 3,000 h of teleop.

title: DiWA: Diffusion Policy Adaptation with World Models
one_line: DPPO inside a frozen RSSM trained on play data, with no physical interaction during fine-tuning. CALVIN simulation skills gain roughly 17-41 points over the base policy (close-drawer 59.14% to 91.95%).

title: D2PPO: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization with Dispersive Loss
one_line: Dispersive-loss regularization (in-batch representations as negatives) during diffusion-policy pre-training, then DPPO fine-tuning. RoboMimic average success 0.94 vs 0.86 for DPPO (Transport 0.87 vs 0.60); real Franka Transport 70% vs 45% (AAAI 2026).

title: CO-RFT: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language-Action Models through Chunked Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Behavior cloning on 30–60 demos precedes offline chunked Cal-QL with a Transformer critic. Across six real dexterous-hand grasping tasks, reports 57% average success-rate improvement over SFT; absolute versus relative change is unstated.

title: Flow Matching Policy Gradients (Flow Policy Optimization, FPO)
one_line: PPO ratio = exp(L_CFM_old - L_CFM_new), with no likelihoods. DM Control average 759.3 vs 667.8 for Gaussian PPO and 652.5 for DPPO.

title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
one_line: LLM RL algorithm replacing GRPO's token-level importance ratios with sequence-likelihood ratios and sequence-level clipping; more stable and efficient than GRPO, stabilizes MoE training, used for Qwen3.

title: Latent Policy Steering with Embodiment-Agnostic Pretrained World Models
one_line: Cross-embodiment-pretrained Dreamer world model plus critic ranks BC chunks. Real Franka, 30-50 demos: BC 21.2% → 36.2%.

title: Finetuning Deep Reinforcement Learning Policies with Evolutionary Strategies for Control of Underactuated Robots (EvolSAC)
one_line: Pretrains SAC on a dense surrogate reward, then fine-tunes the policy with SNES using the true task score as fitness. Sim cartpole swing-up time (10-agent mean): 2.085 s → 1.135 s, vs 1.565 s after 1000 more SAC episodes.

title: Action Chunking and Exploratory Data Collection Yield Exponential Improvements in Behavior Cloning for Continuous Control
short: Action Chunking and Exploratory Data Collection Yield Exponential Improvements in…
one_line: Control-theoretic analysis showing action chunking and exploratory (noise-injected) data collection each circumvent exponential compounding error in behavior cloning, in different regimes; validated on robot learning benchmarks.

title: Penalizing Infeasible Actions and Reward Scaling in Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data (PARS)
short: Penalizing Infeasible Actions and Reward Scaling in Reinforcement Learning with Offline…
one_line: Reward scaling with layer norm plus penalizing infeasible actions curbs Q-function extrapolation; strong offline and offline-to-online D4RL results, notably AntMaze Ultra (ICML 2025 spotlight).

title: Online Pre-Training for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
short: Online Pre-Training for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
one_line: OPT adds an online pre-training phase that trains a new value function tailored for online fine-tuning; average 30% improvement on D4RL (MuJoCo, Antmaze, Adroit) with TD3/SPOT. ICML 2025.

title: Reinforcement Learning with Action Chunking (Q-chunking; algorithms QC and QC-FQL)
one_line: Critic and policy act on h-step action chunks with an unbiased h-step TD target, while the policy stays near a flow-matching BC model of the data. OGBench, 25 tasks, offline → online: QC 52→86 vs FQL 37→58.

title: An Introduction to Zero-Order Optimization Techniques for Robotics
org: Machines in Motion Laboratory, New York University
one_line: Tutorial framing derivative-free robotics methods as one loop: sample Gaussian perturbations, score them, move toward better samples; the sample weighting recovers MPPI, CMA-ES or CEM-like updates. Plots only: on 4 Hydrax sim tasks, MPPI-CMA consistently outperforms MPPI.

title: CUPID: Curating Data your Robot Loves with Influence Functions
org: Stanford; Toyota Research Institute; Cambridge; NVIDIA
one_line: Scores each demo's effect on closed-loop success by chaining influence functions with a REINFORCE estimate from labeled eval rollouts, then drops negative-influence demos and retrains. Real TuckBox mass shift, 66% filtered: base 0%, CUPID 84%, oracle 88% (bar readings).

title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Structured pruning of a VLA, recovery via SFT then RL (critic warm-up, BC-loss regularization), then quantization: up to 8x memory reduction, 2.3x speedup at original success rate.

title: RoboMonkey: Scaling Test-Time Sampling and Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: 7B VLM verifier trained on 20M synthetic preferences reranks Gaussian-perturbed OpenVLA samples. Real OOD 60% vs OpenVLA 35% and V-GPS 30%.

title: Compliant Residual DAgger: Improving Real-World Contact-Rich Manipulation with Human Corrections (CR-DAgger)
one_line: Compliant physical delta corrections train a force-aware residual on a frozen diffusion policy; real book flipping 40% to 100% success with on-policy delta data.

title: Steering Your Diffusion Policy with Latent Space Reinforcement Learning (DSRL)
one_line: RL over the input noise of a frozen diffusion or flow policy. Real Franka 2/10 → 9/10 after about 40 episodes. Real pi0 'turn on toaster' 5/20 → 18/20 after 80 episodes.

title: DynaGuide: Steering Diffusion Policies with Active Dynamic Guidance
one_line: A DINOv2-space dynamics model's gradient guides a frozen diffusion policy toward goal images. CALVIN articulated parts 70% average, 8.7x over base.

title: SAFE: Multitask Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: A tiny failure-detector head on frozen VLA hidden states; unseen-task ROC-AUC 78.00 vs 73.93 for the best baseline in sim.
