title: TGRPO: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action Model via Trajectory-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization
one_line: GRPO mixing step-level and trajectory-level group z-scores, with an LLM-written dense reward. LIBERO average 80.7 vs SFT 76.5 (v3), and not best on Goal.

title: Reinforcement Learning via Implicit Imitation Guidance (Data-Guided Noise, DGN)
one_line: Uses demos only to shape RLPD's exploration covariance, never as a BC loss; up to 2-3x improvement over prior methods on 7 sim tasks.

title: Self-Improving Loops for Visual Robotic Planning (SILVR)
one_line: Video-generative planner (optionally composed with an internet-pretrained video model) iteratively fine-tuned on its own success-filtered rollouts; improves over iterations on unseen MetaWorld and two real-arm tasks, and still improves with VLM-judged filtering or suboptimal initial data (ICLR 2026).

title: A Smooth Sea Never Made a Skilled SAILOR: Robust Imitation via Learning to Search
one_line: MPPI residual search in a learned world model with an IRL reward and critic, then distillation. Sim only; e.g. Square 0.29 → 0.78 at 50 demos.

title: Horizon Reduction Makes RL Scalable
one_line: Many offline RL methods saturate despite datasets up to 1,000x larger than typical. Horizon-reduction experiments improve scaling on challenging tasks; SHARSA achieves the best asymptotic performance among the evaluated methods.

title: 1X World Model: Evaluating Bits, not Atoms (1XWM, policy evaluation with a learned action-conditioned video world model)
one_line: Action-conditioned video world model that also predicts task success from the final generated frame, used to rank humanoid policy checkpoints. Evidence is predicted success per checkpoint, checked by real runs on selected checkpoints; no correlation coefficient is reported.

title: Scaling Helix: a New State of the Art in Humanoid Logistics
one_line: Improves one deployed parcel-sorting job with more in-domain demos, richer System-1 inputs (stereo, vision memory, state history, force) and a 50% larger decoder head; the post describes no RL. Over three months, barcode-orientation success rose ~70% → ~95%.

title: WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation (earlier/code title: "Evaluating Robot Policies in a World Model")
one_line: Video world model plus GPT-4o judge as a policy evaluator. Pearson r = 0.78 vs real over 17 Bridge tasks.

title: ProRL: Prolonged Reinforcement Learning Expands Reasoning Boundaries in Large Language Models
one_line: Prolonged RL adds KL control, reference-policy resets and diverse tasks to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B. Pass@k gains are largest where the base is weak; some high-baseline math tasks show unchanged or lower pass@128.

title: Diffusion Guidance Is a Controllable Policy Improvement Operator (CFGRL)
one_line: Trains one flow policy by BC with an optimality token; classifier-free guidance samples reference policy times a non-decreasing advantage function. Sim ExORL walker-stand, same IQL critic: 782±8 vs AWR 603±8. OGBench: mixed vs AWR, beats goal-conditioned BC on most tasks.

title: FastTD3: Simple, Fast, and Capable Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Control
one_line: TD3 with parallel simulation, large-batch updates and a distributional critic; solves a range of HumanoidBench tasks in under 3 hours on one A100 GPU.

title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
short: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
one_line: Shows LLM policy-gradient RL trades policy entropy for performance, driven by probability-logit covariance; Clip-Cov and KL-Cov restrict high-covariance token updates to prevent entropy collapse.

title: SCIZOR: A Self-Supervised Approach to Data Curation for Large-Scale Imitation Learning
one_line: A task-progress predictor removes suboptimal state-action pairs; deduplication removes redundant pairs. On Sirius-Fleet real-robot tasks, the paper text reports a 32.9-percentage-point success gain over training on the full dataset.

title: ReinFlow: Fine-tuning Flow Matching Policy with Online Reinforcement Learning
one_line: A learned noise network makes flow steps Gaussian for exact-likelihood PPO. Simulated image-based Can success: 57.83% to 98.50%; Transport: 30.17% to 88.67%. Reports 62.82% lower wall time than DPPO across tasks.

title: Hume: Introducing System-2 Thinking in Visual-Language-Action Model
org: Shanghai AI Lab; SJTU; Fudan; INSAIT
one_line: pi0-style VLA with a built-in value-query head that picks among 5 partly denoised chunks, plus a fast refiner. LIBERO 98.6% vs pi0 94.2%.

title: RFTF: Reinforcement Fine-tuning for Embodied Agents with Temporal Feedback
one_line: A temporal-ranking value model as potential-based shaping in PPO; CALVIN ABC-D Avg. Len. 4.283 to 4.296 (Seer-Large), while a sparse-reward PPO ablation fell below the starting policy (4.225).

title: What Can RL Bring to VLA Generalization? An Empirical Study
short: RL4VLA (What Can RL Bring to VLA Generalization?)
one_line: Controlled study where PPO beats GRPO and DPO. ID 0.781 (SFT-16k, plateaued) → 0.938. Robot-pose OOD 0.339 → 0.797. Zero-shot Franka pick-and-place 0.00 → 0.27.

title: WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator
org: Midea Group; East China Normal University
one_line: Conditions Wan 2.1 14B on the policy's own latent (Policy2Vec). Average r 0.942 vs 0.411 for a real-to-sim baseline.

title: Genie Centurion: Accelerating Scalable Real-World Robot Training with Human Rewind-and-Refine Guidance
one_line: Rewind-and-refine DAgger on the GO-1 VLA with a learned success detector; e.g. Microwave-Heating task score 0.97±0.01 at 80 trajectories vs 0.55±0.05 teleop.

title: VLA-RL: Towards Masterful and General Robotic Manipulation with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
one_line: PPO on OpenVLA-7B, treating a trajectory as a multi-turn conversation, with a VLM process reward model trained on automatically extracted pseudo-labels. LIBERO average 76.5 → 81.0 (OpenVLA SFT baseline); π0-FAST, listed for reference, scores 85.5.

title: Interactive Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models (RIPT-VLA)
one_line: RLOO, PPO clipping and dynamic sampling use binary success rewards. LIBERO averages: QueST 82.7% to 93.6%, OpenVLA-OFT 96.7% to 97.5%. Best reported one-demo cross-scenario gain: 3.5% SFT to 97.2%.

title: FlowQ: Energy-Guided Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Energy-guided flow matching learns a Q-guided velocity field during training, needing no inference-time guidance; policy training time is constant in flow sampling steps, with competitive offline RL performance.

title: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
one_line: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL diagnoses failures and corrects VLA actions, using 9,440 failed trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs. Failure-analysis score: 79.10 versus GPT-4o 57.42; real SO-100 success after five attempts: 61.25% versus 47.5% without correction.

title: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
short: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
one_line: Across 7 RL algorithms (PPO, GRPO, DPO...) and 10 LLMs, RL fine-tuning updates only 5-30% of parameters; these sparse updates are nearly full-rank. NeurIPS 2025.

title: ReWiND: Language-Guided Rewards Teach Robot Policies without New Demonstrations
one_line: A language-conditioned progress reward with rewind augmentation from about 5 demos per task; real bimanual policy 12% to 68% in 1 hour of RL.

title: DataMIL: Selecting Data for Robot Imitation Learning with Datamodels
one_line: Linear datamodels with a target-demo BC-loss proxy select prior-data clusters. LIBERO-10 37.76 vs 27.72 for all-data co-training.

title: ReinboT: Amplifying Robot Visual-Language Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
one_line: End-to-end VLA that predicts dense returns to capture data-quality distribution and act toward maximized return; SOTA on CALVIN mixed-quality data, strong few-shot and real-world OOD generalization.

title: What Matters for Batch Online Reinforcement Learning in Robotics?
one_line: Controlled study of deploy-collect-retrain loops; implicit Q best-of-N extraction beats AWR (Square: AWR 62 → 11 vs best-of-N 47 → 83).

title: X-Sim: Cross-Embodiment Learning via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
one_line: Reconstructs a photorealistic sim from an RGBD human video, trains RL on object-centric rewards, distills into an image diffusion policy with online sim-real alignment; no teleoperation data. Average task progress +30% over hand-tracking and sim-to-real baselines on 5 real tasks.

title: SIME: Enhancing Policy Self-Improvement with Modal-level Exploration
one_line: Success-filtered self-improvement with noise injected into the observation embedding to diversify modes. Square-20 (state): 0.534 → 0.620 vs 0.556 for plain self-improvement.

title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
short: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the…
org: Tsinghua University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
one_line: RLVR-trained LLMs win at pass@1 but base models win at large-k pass@k: RL improves sampling efficiency within base-model capability, unlike distillation; NeurIPS 2025 Oral.

title: Welcome to the Era of Experience
short: Welcome to the Era of Experience
one_line: Position essay (preprint chapter of MIT Press book "Designing an Intelligence"): agents will gain superhuman ability by learning predominantly from their own experience via streams, grounded actions, grounded rewards, and planning.

title: Real-is-Sim: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap with a Dynamic Digital Twin
one_line: The policy always acts on a synced dynamic digital twin. Failure states mined in sim plus 30 new demos lift real PushT from about 57% to 80%.

title: Dyna Robotics Unveils DYNA-1: The First Commercial-Ready Robot Foundation Model Offering Fully Autonomous, Round-the-Clock Dexterity
one_line: Press release for DYNA-1: self-reported 800+ napkins folded in a continuous 24-hour run with zero interventions, 99.4% success at 60% of human throughput; credits a proprietary reward model for error recovery and training-data generation.

title: Dynamism v1 (DYNA-1) Model: A Breakthrough in Performance and Production-Ready Embodied AI
one_line: Reward-model-in-the-loop training over 6 weeks; self-reported 99.4% success over a 24-hour zero-intervention napkin run (850+ napkins, ~60% of human speed); method described only at a high level.

title: HACTS: a Human-As-Copilot Teleoperation System for Robot Learning
one_line: Low-cost, 3D-printed bilateral teleoperation system that syncs leader hardware with robot joints so humans can seamlessly intervene and collect correction data; improves imitation learning and human-in-the-loop RL.

title: Sim-and-Real Co-Training: A Simple Recipe for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
org: UT Austin, NVIDIA, UC Berkeley, New York University
one_line: Co-trains one Diffusion Policy on 20-50 real demos per task plus MimicGen-multiplied sim 'digital cousins' and prior sim data. Across six real tasks, average success rose from 45.3% (real only) to 83.2% (real + cousins + prior).

title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
one_line: Dr. GRPO removes a response-length optimization bias, improving token efficiency while maintaining reasoning performance. The paper’s complete minimalist R1-Zero recipe reaches 43.3% AIME 2024 accuracy with a 7B base model.

title: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
one_line: Scaling contrastive goal-conditioned RL from 4 to 64 layers gives 2–50x gains on simulated tasks without demonstrations or rewards; Humanoid U-Maze improves further up to 1,024 layers.

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
one_line: Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization: four techniques for large-scale LLM RL; 50 points on AIME 2024 with Qwen2.5-32B; code on verl plus dataset released.

title: MoRE: Unlocking Scalability in Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts quadruped VLA fine-tuned with an RL objective on mixed-quality data; outperforms baselines across six skills, generalizes OOD, validated on real robot (ICRA 2025).

title: RoboCopilot: Human-in-the-loop Interactive Imitation Learning for Robot Manipulation
one_line: Compliant bilateral teleoperation system that lets a human seamlessly take over from and hand back to the policy, collecting interactive correction data for bimanual manipulation in sim and real.

title: Refined Policy Distillation: From VLA Generalists to RL Experts
one_line: A small PPO student plus an MSE term toward a frozen VLA teacher's action. Even 1-10% success teachers make sparse-reward PPO work in ManiSkill3 (sim only).

title: Curating Demonstrations using Online Experience (Demo-SCORE)
one_line: A success classifier trained on policy rollouts flags demonstration strategies the policy cannot execute. Robomimic square peg (simulation, averaged over data mixtures): 79.9% base to 94.4%.

title: Chunking the Critic: A Transformer-based Soft Actor-Critic with N-Step Returns (T-SAC)
one_line: Transformer critic over action prefixes trained with N-step returns without importance sampling; Box-Pushing dense 96.8% vs baselines at or below 85%.

title: Multi-Stage Manipulation with Demonstration-Augmented Reward, Policy, and World Model Learning (DEMO3)
org: UC San Diego, Hillbot, ETH Zürich
one_line: Demonstration-augmented model-based RL (TD-MPC2 backbone) that learns stage-wise dense rewards online alongside policy and world model; 40% better average data efficiency (70% on the hardest tasks) than baselines across 16 simulated sparse-reward tasks, using 5-100 demos per task.

title: Uncertainty Comes for Free: Human-in-the-Loop Policies with Diffusion Models
one_line: Computes uncertainty from a diffusion policy's own denoising process to request operator help only when needed at deployment; the same signal targets data collection for fine-tuning.

title: Re3Sim: Generating High-Fidelity Simulation Data via 3D-Photorealistic Real-to-Sim for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Real-to-sim pipeline using 3D reconstruction and neural rendering inside a physics simulator; imitation policies trained only on its sim data exceed 58% average zero-shot real success.

title: Robot Data Curation with Mutual Information Estimators (DemInf)
one_line: Label-free demo scoring by contribution to I(S;A), using k-NN estimators in VAE latents. The abstract reports a 5-10% improvement on RoboMimic.

title: From Action Labels to Sets: Rethinking Action Supervision for Imitation Learning from Corrective Feedback (CLIC)
one_line: CLIC: builds set-valued desired-action targets from human corrections and trains the policy to put probability mass on those sets, giving robustness to noisy corrections and multi-modal behaviors.

title: ConRFT: A Reinforced Fine-tuning Method for VLA Models via Consistency Policy
one_line: Trains a consistency-policy head over frozen Octo using BC+Q: Cal-QL offline, then human-in-the-loop online fine-tuning. Across eight real-robot tasks, mean success rises from 39.4% to 96.3%.

title: Value-Based Deep RL Scales Predictably
one_line: Fits power laws relating batch size and learning rate to UTD and predicts data/compute trade-offs from small runs; evaluates off-policy value-based RL with SAC, BRO and PQL.

title: Learning from Active Human Involvement through Proxy Value Propagation (PVP)
one_line: Reward-free +1/-1 proxy values on human vs rejected actions; MetaDrive test success 0.857 vs HG-DAgger 0.045 (NeurIPS 2023, arXiv 2025).

title: DIME: Diffusion-Based Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Derives a tractable lower bound on the MaxEnt RL objective for diffusion policies with provably convergent policy iteration; outperforms other diffusion-RL methods on high-dimensional control benchmarks.

title: Rapidly Adapting Policies to the Real World via Simulation-Guided Fine-Tuning (SGFT)
one_line: Precursor. The frozen sim critic serves as a potential-based shaping reward and H-step terminal value for real-world SAC/TD-MPC2. 100% on hammering and pushing within about an hour, 70% on insertion within two hours.

title: Flow Q-Learning (FQL)
one_line: Pure-BC flow policy plus a one-step actor that climbs Q under a distillation leash; OGBench cube-double 29 vs ReBRAC 12.

title: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment (FOREWARN)
one_line: Latent world model plus fine-tuned VLM verify 6 plan modes in language. Real Franka Fork task 0.10 → 0.70.

title: Inference-Time Enhancement of Generative Robot Policies via Predictive World Modeling (GPC: Generative Predictive Control; v1 titled "Strengthening Generative Robot Policies through Predictive World Modeling")
one_line: World model plus reward predictor rank diffusion-policy chunks. State Push-T 0.812 → 0.934 (K=5000); vision Push-T 0.642 → 0.739 vs V-GPS 0.620.

title: Improving Vision-Language-Action Model with Online Reinforcement Learning (iRe-VLA)
one_line: Alternates online RL on an action head over a frozen VLM with full-model SFT on expert demos and RL successes. MetaWorld unseen-10 success: 0.51 SFT / 0.39 PPO-Replay / 0.80 iRe-VLA.

title: Policy Decorator: Model-Agnostic Online Refinement for Large Policy Model
one_line: Bounded SAC residual plus a progressive exploration schedule on frozen BeT or Diffusion Policy. Bases at 15-78% reach near-perfect success on 8 sim tasks, with millions of env steps.

title: RLDG: Robotic Generalist Policy Distillation via Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Real-world HIL-SERL specialists generate successful rollouts that become SFT data for OpenVLA/Octo. OpenVLA +33% on FMB Insertion vs fine-tuning on human demos.

title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning Need Not Retain Offline Data (WSRL: Warm-Start RL)
one_line: Drop offline data, warm up with frozen-policy rollouts, then high-UTD RL; real Franka peg insertion 13/20 → 20/20 in 18 min, while SERL/RLPD was at 0/20 after 50 min.

title: Policy Agnostic RL: Offline RL and Online RL Fine-Tuning of Any Class and Backbone (PA-RL)
one_line: Samples policy actions, selects high-Q candidates, refines them by Q-gradient ascent, then distills with the policy’s own loss. PA-RL+Cal-QL on simulated CALVIN: 28% offline success to 61% after online fine-tuning.

title: Robot Learning with Super-Linear Scaling (CASHER)
one_line: Crowdsourced real-to-sim scans plus sim RL bootstrapped by human demos; the improving generalist policy replaces human effort, giving zero/few-shot real transfer and scan-only fine-tuning.

title: GRAPE: Generalizing Robot Policy via Preference Alignment
org: UNC-Chapel Hill; University of Washington; University of Chicago
one_line: Trajectory-level preference optimization aligns OpenVLA using its successful and failed rollouts, ranked by task success, self-evaluation and VLM-generated stage/keypoint costs, with a KL anchor to the SFT reference policy.

title: PROGRESSOR: A Perceptually Guided Reward Estimator with Self-Supervised Online Refinement
one_line: Predicts a Gaussian over task progress from initial, current and goal frames, pretrained on EPIC-KITCHENS video; during online RL, adversarial 'push-back' lowers estimates on the agent's own out-of-distribution rollouts to counter distribution shift.

title: Inference-Time Policy Steering through Human Interactions (ITPS)
one_line: Human clicks, sketches or nudges define inference-time costs for steering pretrained generative policies. Compares sample ranking, gradient guidance and diffusion-specific stochastic sampling, studying intent alignment versus constraint satisfaction.

title: Coarse-to-fine Q-Network with Action Sequence for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Critic-only coarse-to-fine Q-network over action sequences; avoids actor-driven overestimation that breaks chunked SAC/TD3 (curves only).

title: Vision Language Models are In-Context Value Learners (Generative Value Learning, GVL)
one_line: Asks a frozen VLM (Gemini-1.5-Pro) for task progress on shuffled frames, zero- or few-shot; introduces VOC (0.74 on RT-1); one-shot GVL-weighted AWR beat diffusion policy on 4 of 7 real ALOHA tasks (1 tie, 2 losses).

title: So You Think You Can Scale Up Autonomous Robot Data Collection?
short: So You Think You Can Scale Up Autonomous Robot Data Collection?
one_line: CoRL 2024 study over 7 sim and real tasks: autonomous imitation-learning data collection inherits RL's environment-design burdens; scaling human demos often improves policies significantly more.

title: CHG-DAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning with Human-Policy Cooperative Control
org: Toyota Motor Corporation; Toyota Research Institute
one_line: Cooperative HG-DAgger uses multilateral control so a human and learned visuomotor policy can correct task failures together without a full control handoff.

title: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models (Sirius-Fleet)
one_line: World-model-based failure monitor decides when humans step in; real autonomous success 0.250 to 0.715 over 3 rounds.

title: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning (HIL-SERL)
one_line: RLPD with human SpaceMouse corrections and a learned binary reward classifier, trained on real robots. RAM insertion: 100% after 1.5 h vs 29% for a data-matched HG-DAgger baseline; faster cycle times on every timed task.

title: On-Robot Reinforcement Learning with Goal-Contrastive Rewards (GCR)
one_line: A VIP-style progress embedding kept honest with hard negatives from the agent's own failed episodes; solves about twice as many tasks as baseline reward learners.

title: SPIRE: Synergistic Planning, Imitation, and Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation
one_line: TAMP decomposes tasks into short segments; BC policies receive RL fine-tuning with a KL penalty. Across nine simulated tasks, average success is 87.8% versus 52.9% for TAMP-gated BC and 37.6% for planner-guided RL.

title: Diff-DAgger: Uncertainty Estimation with Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Diffusion training loss triggers human queries in robot-gated DAgger; reports 39.0% higher failure-prediction F1 and 20.6% task-completion improvement over evaluated baselines, with 7.8x lower average policy-update time than Ensemble-DAgger.

title: Steering Your Generalists: Improving Robotic Foundation Models via Value Guidance (V-GPS)
one_line: Offline Cal-QL Q reranks K samples from frozen generalists. Real WidowX Octo-small-1.5 0.24 → 0.44 (+82%); SIMPLER gains are small for some policies (OpenVLA 0.24 → 0.27).

title: TOP-ERL: Transformer-based Off-Policy Episodic Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Enables off-policy updates for episodic RL by segmenting long action sequences and valuing each segment with a transformer critic and n-step returns; ICLR 2025 Spotlight.

title: Automated Creation of Digital Cousins for Robust Policy Learning (ACDC)
one_line: Precursor. Sim 'cousin' scenes built from one image. Zero-shot real door opening: 25% for the exact twin vs 90% cousin-only and 95% twin+cousin.

title: Incremental Learning for Robot Shared Autonomy
short: Incremental Learning for Robot Shared Autonomy
org: Carnegie Mellon University; NIST; University of Pittsburgh
one_line: ILSA continually fine-tunes an assistive arm's shared-autonomy policy on each interaction's limited new data while preserving prior knowledge. In a 20-person study it completed tasks faster than static baselines.

title: Reinforcement Learning From Imperfect Corrective Actions And Proxy Rewards
short: Reinforcement Learning From Imperfect Corrective Actions And Proxy Rewards
one_line: ICoPro: value-based RL that combines sparse, imperfect human corrective actions (margin loss plus target-Q pseudo-labels) with proxy rewards; better alignment and sample efficiency on Atari and highway driving.

title: The Promise of Generalist Robotic Policies
short: The Promise of Generalist Robotic Policies
one_line: Essay: generalist robot foundation models bootstrap a deployment data flywheel; language feedback and RL from real-world outcomes then drive autonomous self-improvement beyond imitation.

title: Unpacking Failure Modes of Generative Policies: Runtime Monitoring of Consistency and Progress (Sentinel)
one_line: Runtime failure detector (action-chunk consistency plus VLM progress check). Detects 18% more failures than either detector alone.

title: Run-time Observation Interventions Make Vision-Language-Action Models More Visually Robust
short: Run-time Observation Interventions Make Vision-Language-Action Models More Visually Robust
one_line: BYOVLA: training-free run-time intervention finds image regions a VLA is sensitive to and edits task-irrelevant distractors out (VLM + segmentation + inpainting); on hardware, VLAs nearly retain nominal performance despite distractors that otherwise cut success by up to 40%.

title: AHA: A Vision-Language-Model for Detecting and Reasoning Over Failures in Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Fine-tunes a VLM on FailGen's procedurally perturbed sim failures to detect and explain manipulation failures; beats GPT-4o in-context learning by 10.3%; as failure feedback it lifts success in three LLM/VLM pipelines 21.4% on average over GPT-4 models.

title: Towards Effective Utilization of Mixed-Quality Demonstrations in Robotic Manipulation via Segment-Level Selection and Optimization (S2I)
one_line: S2I segments mixed-quality demos, selects good segments via contrastive learning and optimizes poor ones' trajectories; 3 expert demos as reference improve downstream policies on six tasks (ICRA 2025).

title: RL-GSBridge: 3D Gaussian Splatting Based Real2Sim2Real Method for Robotic Manipulation Learning
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University and others
one_line: Precursor. A 3DGS-rendered twin lets image-based SAC transfer zero-shot. small_cube grasping 96.88% sim → 96.88% real, vs 12.50% real for mesh renders.

title: FLaRe: Achieving Masterful and Adaptive Robot Policies with Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
org: Ai2, UT Austin, UW, Sony AI
one_line: PPO fine-tunes a BC transformer in AI2THOR using a low learning rate, no entropy bonus and a separate critic. CHORES-S success: ObjectNav 85.0%, Fetch 66.9%, PickUp 91.8%, RoomVisit 70.4%.

title: RACER: Rich Language-Guided Failure Recovery Policies for Imitation Learning
one_line: Augments expert demos with automatically generated failure-recovery trajectories and rich language; a VLM supervisor guides a language-conditioned visuomotor actor, outperforming RVT on RLBench.

title: SplatSim: Zero-Shot Sim2Real Transfer of RGB Manipulation Policies Using Gaussian Splatting
one_line: Precursor. Gaussian-splat rendering over PyBullet physics. A zero-shot RGB diffusion policy averages 86.25% sim-to-real vs 97.5% real-to-real.

title: DemoStart: Demonstration-led Auto-Curriculum Applied to Sim-to-Real with Multi-Fingered Robots
one_line: Uses a few sim demos and a sparse reward to build an auto-curriculum for RL on a three-fingered hand, then distills and transfers zero-shot to real. Needs 100x fewer demos than real-robot baselines.

title: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization (DPPO)
one_line: PPO over diffusion denoising steps. Furniture-Bench sim One-leg 57% → 97%, Lamp 12% → 87%, Round-table 1% → 86%. Zero-shot hardware One-leg 80% (16/20) vs 0% for Gaussian PPO.

title: 1X World Model (announcement of a learned simulator for evaluating humanoid policies, plus the 1X World Model Challenge)
one_line: Blog and challenge arguing for a learned simulator as a repeatable evaluator. No quantitative link to real success.

title: Bidirectional Decoding: Improving Action Chunking via Guided Test-Time Sampling (BID)
one_line: Training-free selection among N chunks by coherence with the last chunk and contrast with a weak checkpoint. 32% average relative gain over vanilla closed loop on 7 sim tasks.

title: Representation Alignment from Human Feedback for Cross-Embodiment Reward Learning from Mixed-Quality Demonstrations
short: Representation Alignment from Human Feedback for Cross-Embodiment Reward Learning from…
one_line: Shows cross-embodiment IRL (e.g., XIRL) fails on mixed-quality demos; studies representation learning aligned with human feedback to improve transferable reward learning and shaping.

title: Autonomous Improvement of Instruction Following Skills via Foundation Models (SOAR)
one_line: VLM-proposed tasks and VLM success filtering for goal-conditioned BC on autonomous data. Average real-world success 28% to 57% across 10 scenes, with no human annotations.

title: From Imitation to Refinement -- Residual RL for Precise Assembly (ResiP)
one_line: Per-step PPO residual on a frozen chunked diffusion policy. Sim assembly goes from 5-54% to 88-99% (low randomization) with 50 demos, while diffusion BC plateaus at about 80% on one_leg even with 100K RL-generated demos.

title: Residual-MPPI: Online Policy Customization for Continuous Control
org: UC Berkeley; Sony Research; UT Austin
one_line: Online MPPI planning adapts a pretrained policy to new objectives using only its action distribution, no retraining; customizes champion GT Sophy racing agent few-shot and zero-shot.

title: To Err is Robotic: Rapid Value-Based Trial-and-Error during Deployment
one_line: Bellman-Guided Retrials: a demo-trained value function detects stalled progress at deployment and resamples alternative strategies, avoiding failed ones; raises average absolute success rates by more than 20 points in simulation and more than 50 in real-world tests.

title: IRASim: A Fine-Grained World Model for Robot Manipulation
one_line: An action-conditioned video model ranks candidate chunks using predicted-outcome IoU. Push-T IoU: 0.637 to 0.961 with 50 candidates and 1,000 world-model training rollouts; without rollout training data, 50 candidates score 0.418.

title: AIC MLLM: Autonomous Interactive Correction MLLM for Robust Robotic Manipulation
one_line: MLLM predicting SE(3) poses for articulated objects corrects itself from interaction failures via visual-mask and text prompts, a feedback extraction module, and test-time adaptation.

title: Diffusion Actor-Critic: Formulating Constrained Policy Iteration as Diffusion Noise Regression for Offline Reinforcement Learning (DAC)
one_line: KL-constrained policy iteration written as diffusion noise regression with a Q-gradient nudge; locomotion total 836.4 vs DTQL 798.3.

title: Video-Language Critic: Transferable Reward Functions for Language-Conditioned Robotics
one_line: A CLIP-initialized video-text critic learns contrastive and temporal-ranking rewards. At matched hand-reward convergence budgets on MetaWorld: 58% sparse-only success, 78% with in-domain MW50 VLC, 65% with cross-embodiment Open X VLC.

title: Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning via Q-weighted Variational Policy Optimization
short: Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning via Q-weighted Variational Policy Optimization
one_line: QVPO (NeurIPS 2024): Q-weighted variational loss plus entropy regularization and an efficient behavior policy trains diffusion policies in online RL; state-of-the-art reward and sample efficiency on MuJoCo.

title: Diffusion Actor-Critic with Entropy Regulator
one_line: Online RL (DACER) using the diffusion reverse process as the policy, with GMM-estimated entropy tuning exploration noise; state of the art on most MuJoCo benchmarks.

title: TRANSIC: Sim-to-Real Policy Transfer by Learning from Online Correction
one_line: Gated residual trained by max likelihood on human SpaceMouse corrections over a frozen sim policy. Real Franka average 81% over four tasks; beats BC fine-tuning, and HG-DAgger and IWR, which the authors find forget the base policy.

title: Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation (SIMPLER)
org: UCSD; Stanford; UC Berkeley; Google DeepMind
one_line: Real-to-sim evaluation via sysID plus visual matching. Average Pearson r 0.924 vs 0.308 for offline action MSE. Introduced MMRV.

title: IntervenGen: Interventional Data Generation for Robust and Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning
one_line: Expands 10 human interventions into 1,000 synthetic corrections. In simulated Coffee with injected pose-estimation error and full observability on contact, success improves from 2% base to 80%.

title: DrS: Learning Reusable Dense Rewards for Multi-Stage Tasks
one_line: Learns stage-aware dense rewards from sparse rewards and optional demos, reusable on unseen tasks; across 1000+ manipulation task variants it sometimes matches hand-engineered rewards.

title: Rank2Reward: Learning Shaped Reward Functions from Passive Video
one_line: Temporal ranking of demo frames plus a GAIL discriminator for pessimism; real xArm tasks learned in under 2 hours.

title: Bayesian Optimization for Sample-Efficient Policy Improvement in Robotic Manipulation (BOpt-GMM)
one_line: Imitate from about 10 demos with a GMM dynamical system, then BO (SMAC3) on sparse binary success. In sim it reaches 80% success 87 episodes earlier than SAC-GMM.

title: Yell At Your Robot: Improving On-the-Fly from Language Corrections
one_line: High-level policy over language-conditioned low-level skills takes real-time verbal corrections and is iteratively retrained on them, improving long-horizon dexterous manipulation without extra teleoperation.

title: Stop Regressing: Training Value Functions via Classification for Scalable Deep RL
one_line: Trains value functions with categorical cross-entropy instead of MSE regression, improving performance and scalability on Atari, Q-transformer robot manipulation, chess and Wordle by mitigating noisy, non-stationary targets.

title: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-to-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation (RialTo)
org: MIT, University of Washington, TU Darmstadt
one_line: Precursor. Phone-scan twin, then PPO with a BC term starting from 15 demos, then distill back. Real success averages 91%/77%/75% (poses/distractors/disturbances) vs 25%/11%/5% for BC.

title: Diffusion Meets DAgger: Supercharging Eye-in-hand Imitation Learning
one_line: Replaces DAgger's extra expert data collection with diffusion-synthesized off-distribution eye-in-hand samples; 80% pushing success from 8 demos vs 20% for BC (RSS 2024).

title: Diffusion-ES: Gradient-free Planning with Diffusion for Autonomous Driving and Zero-Shot Instruction Following
one_line: Test-time evolutionary search over a frozen trajectory diffusion model, mutating by partial re-noise and denoise. It matches the hand-designed SOTA planner on nuPlan (driving score 92 vs 92).

title: Offline Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Scales to Large Models (Perceiver-Actor-Critic, PAC)
one_line: Up to about 1B-parameter offline actor-critic with one BC-to-RL knob; self-improvement on real CHEF from 69.8% to 93.2%.

title: Fine-tuning Reinforcement Learning Models is Secretly a Forgetting Mitigation Problem
short: Fine-tuning Reinforcement Learning Models is Secretly a Forgetting Mitigation Problem
one_line: RL fine-tuning can forget pretrained capabilities on states not visited early; knowledge-retention methods mitigate this. NetHack Human Monk exceeds 10K points versus the previous neural-model best of 5K.

title: SERL: A Software Suite for Sample-Efficient Robotic Reinforcement Learning
org: UC Berkeley; University of Washington; Stanford; Intrinsic
one_line: Tuned real-robot RLPD stack with reward classifiers; 100/100 success on 3 tasks with 20-105 min of training.

title: RESPRECT: Speeding-up Multi-fingered Grasping with Residual Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Learns a residual policy on top of a DRL-pretrained multi-fingered grasping policy, reusing its components; about 5x fewer timesteps than from scratch, validated on the real iCub.

title: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Self-Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
short: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Self-Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: SSDF: self-supervised quality scoring of failed-trajectory segments using expert plus imperfect data; high-scoring segments augment offline BC training, improving success on ManiSkill2 and a real Franka, reward-free.

title: Learning a Diffusion Model Policy from Rewards via Q-Score Matching (QSM)
one_line: Trains a diffusion policy's score to match alpha * grad_a Q, avoiding backprop through the sampler; matches SAC/TD3 on DMC.

title: Guided Flows for Generative Modeling and Decision Making
short: Guided Flows for Generative Modeling and Decision Making
one_line: Adds classifier-free guidance to flow matching. Improves image and speech generation, and for offline-RL planning runs about 10x faster than diffusion with comparable returns.

title: RLIF: Interactive Imitation Learning as Reinforcement Learning
one_line: -1 reward on the step before each takeover plus off-policy RL; sim Walker2d normalized score 103.83±4.48 vs HG-DAgger 36.75±4.7 (averaged over three expert levels, same intervention rule), and it improves on suboptimal experts.

title: Distilling and Retrieving Generalizable Knowledge for Robot Manipulation via Language Corrections (DROC)
short: Distilling and Retrieving Generalizable Knowledge for Robot Manipulation via Language…
one_line: LLM system distills reusable knowledge from language corrections (plan-level and skill-parameter) and retrieves it later; half the first-round corrections of LLM code-generation baselines, few or none after two iterations.

title: Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning (IBRL)
one_line: Frozen BC policy and TD3 actor both propose; the critic picks, also inside the TD target. Real Hang task: BC 65%, RLPD 15%, IBRL 85%.

title: Model-Based Runtime Monitoring with Interactive Imitation Learning
short: Model-Based Runtime Monitoring with Interactive Imitation Learning
one_line: A latent dynamics model and failure classifier predict problems and request human supervision before failure. Evaluated as a human-robot interactive-imitation system in simulation and on hardware; the human decides whether to intervene.

title: Robot Fine-Tuning Made Easy: Pre-Training Rewards and Policies for Autonomous Real-World Reinforcement Learning (RoboFuME)
one_line: A MiniGPT-4 success detector rewards reset-free Cal-QL fine-tuning. Across five real tasks, mean task score rises from 50.4% offline to 76.2% after 2–4 hours; the aggregate mixes success rates and candy-sweeping completion.

title: RoboCLIP: One Demonstration is Enough to Learn Robot Policies
one_line: Rewards a PPO agent at episode end with a frozen S3D video-language model's similarity between its rollout and a single video or text demo; in simulated Meta-World/Franka Kitchen, 2-3x higher zero-shot task reward than GAIL/AIRL.

title: UniSim: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
org: Google DeepMind; UC Berkeley; MIT; U Alberta
one_line: A 5.6B video simulator. REINFORCE raises VLA success from 0.58 to 0.81 (pointing: 0.12 to 0.71), assessed qualitatively on 48 Language Table tasks using video rollouts inside UniSim itself.

title: Robotic Offline RL from Internet Videos via Value-Function Pre-Training (V-PTR)
one_line: TD value pretraining on action-free human video initializes a CQL agent; WidowX scenario 1 total 24/48 vs PTR 5/48.

title: Text2Reward: Reward Shaping with Language Models for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: LLM generates dense reward code from language goals, refinable with human feedback; matches or beats expert rewards on 13 of 17 ManiSkill2/MetaWorld tasks, 94%+ on six locomotion behaviors.

title: Q-Transformer: Scalable Offline Reinforcement Learning via Autoregressive Q-Functions
one_line: Per-dimension autoregressive Transformer Q-function trained offline on demos plus failures; 56% vs RT-1 25% on 72 real tasks.

title: Robotic Table Tennis: A Case Study into a High Speed Learning System
one_line: BGS, an ARS-derived search, trains a roughly 1,000-parameter policy in simulation for zero-shot real table tennis. Mean hit-plus-land score: 1.83/2 with measured latency modeled, versus 1.33 at half latency.

title: Diagnosis, Feedback, Adaptation: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Test-Time Policy Adaptation
one_line: Counterfactual demonstrations let users flag task-irrelevant concepts. The flagged concepts drive data augmentation to adapt policies under distribution shift, which reduced fine-tuning demos in user studies (ICML 2023).

title: DoReMi: Grounding Language Model by Detecting and Recovering from Plan-Execution Misalignment
one_line: LLM produces plans plus execution constraints; a VLM continuously detects constraint violations during low-level skill execution and triggers immediate replanning, raising success and cutting completion time on arm and humanoid tasks.

title: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
one_line: Queries an LLM on a hierarchical summary of multisensory robot experience to explain failures and guide a language planner's corrections; introduces the RoboFail dataset (CoRL 2023).

title: RoboCat: A Self-Improving Generalist Agent for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Self-improvement loop for a 1.18B visual-goal-conditioned transformer: fine-tune on 100-1000 demonstrations, collect new robot trajectories, hindsight-relabel goals including failed episodes, and retrain the generalist.

title: LIV: Language-Image Representations and Rewards for Robotic Control
one_line: VIP plus CLIP InfoNCE gives language-conditioned value and reward from EPIC-KITCHENS.

title: Deep RL at Scale: Sorting Waste in Office Buildings with a Fleet of Mobile Manipulators
one_line: PI-QT-Opt on a 23-robot fleet with sim and curriculum bootstrapping; 84.35% sorting vs a 71% hand-engineered policy.

title: IDQL: Implicit Q-Learning as an Actor-Critic Method with Diffusion Policies
one_line: Diffusion behavior policy trained by BC separately from a generalized IQL critic; at evaluation, picks the highest-Q of N sampled actions. D4RL total 1213.8 vs IQL 1070.4 (reported-results setting).

title: Finetuning from Offline Reinforcement Learning: Challenges, Trade-offs and Practical Solutions
short: Finetuning from Offline Reinforcement Learning: Challenges, Trade-offs and Practical…
one_line: Studies policy collapse when fine-tuning offline-RL agents online (data diversity, algorithm choice, replay distribution) and proposes conservative policy optimization for stable, sample-efficient online learning.

title: Vision-Language Models as Success Detectors (SuccessVQA)
one_line: Fine-tunes Flamingo 3B to answer 'did the robot successfully X?' on video clips; in-domain gear-insertion balanced accuracy 94-96% (bespoke ResNet 98-99%), but it degrades less under camera and distractor shifts; Ego4D remains hard (62%).

title: Cal-QL: Calibrated Offline RL Pre-Training for Efficient Online Fine-Tuning
one_line: Calibrated CQL that keeps Q at or above a reference value to avoid unlearning; 11-task average 44 → 90 vs CQL 42 → 71.

title: Self-Improving Robots: End-to-End Autonomous Visuomotor Reinforcement Learning (MEDAL++)
one_line: Forward and backward image-based actor-critics with classifier rewards for reset-free real practice; cube grasping from OOD starts 0.08 → 0.82 vs BC.

title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data (RLPD: Reinforcement Learning with Prior Data)
one_line: SAC with 50/50 offline/online batches, LayerNorm critics and ensembles; 2.5x the best reported result on sparse Adroit Door. The engine of SERL and HIL-SERL.

title: Policy Expansion for Bridging Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (PEX)
one_line: Freeze the offline policy, add a new policy, and let a shared critic choose between their proposals by Boltzmann sampling; curves only.

title: DreamerV3: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
one_line: Learns a world model and trains behavior by imagined futures. DreamerV3 combines normalization and robust value learning to use one configuration across more than 150 diverse tasks.

title: DADAgger: Disagreement-Augmented Dataset Aggregation
one_line: DAgger variant that queries the expert only on out-of-distribution states flagged by dropout-ensemble variance; matches DAgger on Car Racing and Half Cheetah with fewer expert queries.

title: Robot Learning on the Job: Human-in-the-Loop Autonomy and Learning During Deployment (Sirius)
one_line: Deployment-time weighted BC; real Gear Insertion 14/32 to 29/32 over three rounds.

title: Pre-Training for Robots: Offline RL Enables Learning New Tasks from a Handful of Trials (PTR)
one_line: CQL-based offline RL pretraining on diverse multi-task robot data, then offline and autonomous online fine-tuning; learns new tasks from as few as 10 demos on a real WidowX.

title: VIP: Towards Universal Visual Reward and Representation via Value-Implicit Pre-Training
one_line: A goal-conditioned value embedding from Ego4D via a dual RL objective; VIP-weighted RWR gets 100/90/60/90% on 4 real tasks.

title: Self-Improving Robots and the Importance of Data
short: Self-Improving Robots and the Importance of Data
one_line: Levine essay: a Roomba-scale fleet (~10 million service robots) would collect ~10 billion hours of embodied experience a year; offline RL on self-supervised, goal-conditioned tasks is proposed as the way to learn from it.

title: Diffusion Policies as an Expressive Policy Class for Offline Reinforcement Learning (Diffusion-QL)
one_line: Diffusion policy trained with a denoising BC loss plus a Q-maximizing term backpropagated through the chain; D4RL Gym average 88.0 vs CQL 77.6.

title: Graph Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Diverse Videos
short: Graph Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Diverse Videos
one_line: GraphIRL abstracts diverse (including human) videos into object-interaction graphs and temporally matches them to measure task progress as a reward; outperforms hand-crafted rewards on real-robot pushing.

title: Fleet-DAgger: Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Scalable Human Supervision
one_line: Allocates M humans across N robots; defines Return on Human Effort and claims up to 8.8x higher ROHE than baselines.

title: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
one_line: Dreamer on four real robots with no simulator: an A1 learns to walk in about 1 hour, while SAC on the same budget only rolls over.

title: Jump-Start Reinforcement Learning (JSRL)
one_line: A guide policy runs the first h steps and RL learns the tail, handing over earlier as success rises; sim indiscriminate grasping with 20 demos: QT-Opt+JSRL 0.91 vs QT-Opt 0.00.

title: Efficient Learning of Safe Driving Policy via Human-AI Copilot Optimization (HACO)
short: Efficient Learning of Safe Driving Policy via Human-AI Copilot Optimization (HACO)
one_line: Human-in-the-loop RL for driving: human takeovers during training yield proxy state-action values from partial demonstrations, giving safe, sample-efficient learning that beats RL and IL baselines.

title: Supported Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
short: Supported Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: SPOT: VAE density estimator models behavior-policy support, giving a simple density-based regularizer pluggable into off-policy RL; supports offline-to-online fine-tuning without architectural changes.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning (IQL)
one_line: Expectile value regression that never queries unseen actions; D4RL antmaze total 378.0 vs CQL 303.6.

title: ThriftyDAgger: Budget-Aware Novelty and Risk Gating for Interactive Imitation Learning
one_line: Robot-gated on novelty plus risk; sim peg insertion 73/100 autonomous success vs HG-DAgger 57/100, with fewer training interventions than HG-DAgger but more human-teleoperated actions.

title: Demonstration-Guided Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skills
short: Demonstration-Guided Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skills
one_line: SkiLD: demo-guided RL that follows demonstrated skills learned from offline data rather than primitive actions; substantial gains over prior demo-guided RL on simulated long-horizon maze navigation and robot manipulation.

title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots (adjacent)
one_line: Sim-trained base policy plus adaptation module lets an A1 quadruped adapt to new terrains in fractions of a second, deployed without real-world fine-tuning (RSS 2021).

title: PEBBLE: Feedback-Efficient Interactive Reinforcement Learning via Relabeling Experience and Unsupervised Pre-training
one_line: Off-policy preference-based RL: learns a reward model from human preference queries over behavior clips, relabels replay experience as it changes, and uses unsupervised pre-training for feedback efficiency.

title: XIRL: Cross-embodiment Inverse Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Learns task-progress visual embeddings from cross-embodiment demo videos via temporal cycle-consistency; negative embedding distance to goal serves as RL reward, generalizing to unseen embodiments (CoRL'21 oral).

title: LazyDAgger: Reducing Context Switching in Interactive Imitation Learning
one_line: LazyDAgger adds asymmetric takeover/release thresholds and noisy supervisor actions to reduce switching. On a physical ABB YuMi fabric task, execution succeeds in 8/10 trials versus SafeDAgger’s 2/10, with 21 versus 53 switches.

title: Learning Generalizable Robotic Reward Functions from "In-The-Wild" Human Videos (DVD: Domain-agnostic Video Discriminator)
one_line: A 'same task?' video classifier trained on human plus robot videos gives a reward from a single human demo; used with visual MPC, not RL.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Imitation Learning using Remote Teleoperation (Intervention Weighted Regression, IWR)
one_line: Balanced sampling of intervention vs robot data; Threading final 87.3±5.0 vs HG-DAgger 75.3±8.1 and Full Demos 76.7±2.3 (sim).

title: Parrot: Data-Driven Behavioral Priors for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Pre-trains a behavioral prior from successful trials across many tasks, then uses it to speed RL on new image-based, sparse-reward manipulation tasks; beats prior methods by a substantial margin.

title: PLAS: Latent Action Space for Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Offline RL whose actor outputs a tanh-bounded latent through a frozen CVAE behavior decoder, constraining actions through its learned data distribution; evaluated on simulated continuous control and real deformable-object manipulation.

title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Learned Recovery Zones
one_line: Separate task and recovery policies with a safety critic pretrained on offline data; 2-20x better constraint-violation/success trade-off in sim, 3x on a physical robot.

title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skill Priors
short: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning with Learned Skill Priors
one_line: SPiRL: jointly learns a skill embedding space and state-conditioned skill prior from offline data, then uses the prior to regularize max-entropy RL on new navigation and manipulation tasks (CoRL 2020).

title: EMaQ: Expected-Max Q-Learning Operator for Simple Yet Effective Offline and Online RL
one_line: Backup operator taking the max Q over N actions sampled from a behavior model, keeping the policy in the data's support with no explicit policy network. Matches or beats offline SOTA on D4RL and is competitive with SAC online.

title: Self-Supervised Policy Adaptation during Deployment
one_line: PAD: keeps updating the policy with a self-supervised objective at deployment, no reward needed; improves generalization in 31 of 36 environments, including real robot manipulation.

title: Learning from Interventions: Human-robot interaction as both explicit and implicit feedback
one_line: Expert Intervention Learning (EIL) uses both interventions and non-interventions as feedback on state quality and action optimality; learns collision avoidance from about one minute of expert control.

title: Critic Regularized Regression (CRR)
one_line: Offline critic-filtered BC (binary or exp weights). Humanoid Run: CRR exp 586±6 vs BC 382±2 and D4PG 1±1.

title: AWAC: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets
one_line: AWAC combines a TD critic with advantage-weighted actor regression for offline pretraining and online fine-tuning. Sparse simulated Adroit success after fine-tuning: door 95% at 800k steps, relocate 54% at 4M steps.

title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning (CQL)
one_line: Pessimistic critic that pushes Q down on policy actions and up on data actions; big wins on mixed-quality D4RL data.

title: The Ingredients of Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning (R3L)
org: UC Berkeley; University of Oxford; University of Washington
one_line: SAC from pixels plus a goal-image classifier reward and a perturbation controller for reset-free real-world practice.

title: Advantage-Weighted Regression: Simple and Scalable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
one_line: The base recipe: regress V, then do exp(A/beta)-weighted BC on buffer actions. Hopper-v2 3405±121 vs SAC 2769±552 and PPO 1391±304.

title: Scaling data-driven robotics with reward sketching and batch reinforcement learning
one_line: Human-drawn progress curves train a ranking-loss reward that relabels a 400+ hour robot log for offline distributional RL.

title: End-to-End Robotic Reinforcement Learning without Reward Engineering (VICE-RAQ)
one_line: A success classifier from 80 goal images plus 25-75 yes/no queries; 100% real success on pushing, draping and bookshelf, where a naive classifier gets 0%.

title: Extrapolating Beyond Suboptimal Demonstrations via Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Observations (T-REX)
one_line: T-REX learns a reward function from approximately ranked suboptimal demonstrations and extrapolates beyond them, often exceeding twice the best demonstration's performance on benchmark tasks.

title: Residual Policy Learning
one_line: pi = pi_base + f_theta with DDPG+HER on a frozen hand controller or MPC. On sim Push it reaches 0.9 success with about 10x fewer samples than learning from scratch.

title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control
one_line: TD3 residual on a hand-engineered controller. Real Sawyer insertion with misaligned blocks: 15/20 vs 2/20 for the controller, in about 8K samples (about 3 h).

title: HG-DAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning with Human Experts
one_line: Human takeovers supply labels for iterative imitation learning. In the real-car test’s first 5,000 samples, HG-DAgger records no collisions or road departures, versus DAgger’s one each and BC’s one collision and six departures.

title: CEM-RL: Combining evolutionary and gradient-based methods for policy search
one_line: CEM over actor weights, where half the population gets TD3 gradient steps before evaluation. HalfCheetah 10725 vs TD3 9630 at 1M steps.

title: EnsembleDAgger: A Bayesian Approach to Safe Imitation Learning
one_line: DAgger extension using neural-network ensemble variance as a confidence measure to decide when the novice acts versus the expert; tested on inverted pendulum and MuJoCo HalfCheetah (IROS 2019).

title: QT-Opt: Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Actor-free Q-learning with CEM on 580k real grasps; adding 28k on-policy grasps took unseen-object grasping from 87% to 96%.

title: Simple random search provides a competitive approach to reinforcement learning (Augmented Random Search, ARS). NeurIPS version title: "Simple random search of static linear policies is competitive for reinforcement learning"
one_line: Antithetic random search on linear policies, with reward-std scaling, state normalization and top-direction selection, is competitive on MuJoCo locomotion.

title: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
short: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
one_line: DDPG + HER plus a demo replay buffer, a Q-filtered behavior-cloning loss and optional resets to demo states; in simulation it learns multi-block stacking where HER and BC alone fail, often outperforming the demonstrator (ICRA 2018).

title: Learning Complex Dexterous Manipulation with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Demonstrations (DAPG: Demo Augmented Policy Gradient)
one_line: BC on 25 demos, then NPG with a decaying demo-likelihood term. Reaches 90% on Adroit tasks in 30-55 iterations (3.33-6.1 robot-hours), where sparse-reward RL from scratch never gets there on 3 of 4 tasks.

title: Leveraging Demonstrations for Deep Reinforcement Learning on Robotics Problems with Sparse Rewards (DDPGfD)
one_line: About 100 human demos kept permanently in DDPG's prioritized replay buffer; learns sparse-reward insertion without a shaped reward.

title: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
short: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Starts from one goal state and adaptively expands training starts outward, forming a reverse curriculum for sparse-reward simulated navigation and fine-grained manipulation (CoRL 2017).

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
one_line: Fits a Bradley-Terry reward model online from trajectory-clip comparisons. Evaluates 700 human queries on eight MuJoCo tasks; synthetic feedback nearly matches true-reward RL, with human feedback typically slightly less effective.

title: Parameter Space Noise for Exploration
one_line: Classic precursor. Episode-fixed weight noise for coherent exploration in DQN, DDPG and TRPO. DQN with parameter noise beats ES on 15 of 21 Atari games with 25x less data.

title: Deep Q-learning from Demonstrations
one_line: DQfD combines TD updates with supervised classification of demonstrator actions using prioritized replay of demo data; better initial scores than PDD DQN on 41 of 42 Atari games.

title: DART: Noise Injection for Robust Imitation Learning
one_line: Injects optimized noise into the supervisor's policy during demonstration to collect recovery data, an off-policy alternative to DAgger; 62% gain over behavior cloning on real robot grasping.

title: Evolution Strategies as a Scalable Alternative to Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Weight-space ES as a scalable alternative to RL. Humanoid reached a score of 6000 in 10 minutes on 1,440 cores vs 657 minutes on one 18-core machine.

title: Unsupervised Perceptual Rewards for Imitation Learning
one_line: Splits a handful of demo videos into steps and scores progress with features selected from a frozen ImageNet Inception network; this staged reward replaces an IMU door sensor for real-robot PI2 door opening, even from human-hand demos.

title: Query-Efficient Imitation Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (SafeDAgger)
short: Query-Efficient Imitation Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (SafeDAgger)
one_line: SafeDAgger extends DAgger with a safety policy predicting when the learner deviates from the reference, cutting expert queries; converges faster in a car racing simulator.

title: The CMA Evolution Strategy: A Tutorial
one_line: Reference derivation of CMA-ES. Default population lambda = 4 + floor(3 ln n); covariance is accumulated across generations.

title: Robots that can adapt like animals (Intelligent Trial and Error, IT&E)
org: UPMC/CNRS ISIR; Inria; University of Wyoming
one_line: MAP-Elites builds a simulation behavior map; Bayesian optimization searches it on a damaged real hexapod. Compensatory gaits are 3–7x faster than the reference gait under the same damage, found in a median eight trials.

title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning (DAgger)
one_line: Aggregates expert labels on the learner’s own states and retrains. In Super Tux Kart, the policy almost never fell off after five iterations, while supervised behavior cloning did not improve with more expert data.

title: A Generalized Path Integral Control Approach to Reinforcement Learning (PI2, Policy Improvement with Path Integrals)
one_line: Path-integral sample-perturb-reweight update with no gradient and no learning rate. The paper reports it learning about an order of magnitude faster than the gradient-based methods it compares against.

title: Policy Search for Motor Primitives in Robotics (PoWER: Policy learning by Weighting Exploration with the Returns)
one_line: Imitate once, then return-weighted parameter perturbation on the real robot. Ball-in-a-cup regularly succeeds after about 75 rollouts.

title: Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning for Fast Quadrupedal Locomotion
one_line: Finite-difference hill climbing of a 12-parameter gait on 3 real Aibos: 291 +/- 3 mm/s after about 3 hours. A roughly hand-tuned start worked best.
